body:
ICYMI: My opponent is REFUSING to testify to the 1/6 committee | |
---
| | | [ ](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=2888134284&e=4712f71bea)

| Friends,

[_**News just broke that my opponent Ronny Jackson has REFUSED to testify to the January 6th committee.**_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=300b9ad0d1&e=4712f71bea)

Ronny's refusal comes in the light of these troubling text messages exchanged between the extremist Oath Keeper militia.

**If you haven't seen them yet, here are the text messages, as reported in the[Texas Tribune](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=1662a467b7&e=4712f71bea):**
* [_“Dr. Ronnie Jackson - on the move. Needs protection. If anyone inside cover him,” a person texted at 3:08 p.m. and included a photo that could not be seen from the court documents._](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=f617657ddc&e=4712f71bea)
* [_“He has critical data to protect,” the person added._](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=23b3dab577&e=4712f71bea)
* [_At 3:10, Stewart Rhodes, the founder and leader of the Oath Keepers, responded to the text citing Jackson and instructed a person to “Give him my cell.”_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=b12f914977&e=4712f71bea)

**Ronny claims to have no knowledge of the people texting about him. But if that's true, why won't he testify?**
* Is he afraid of having to answer hard questions under oath?
* What "data" did the Oath Keepers think Ronny Jackson had?
* What did they want to use that "data" for?
* What role did the Oath Keepers expect Ronny Jackson to play in overturning the election?

[_**Ronny Jackson's constituents deserve these answers. **_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=ab6ee347b7&e=4712f71bea)

As your Representative, I promise you that I have never, and will never, contact with any anti democratic paramilitary organization.

And I can promise you that I will answer tough questions when my constituents deserve answers.

[_**If you think we need truth telling representation in Congress instead of possible militia sympathizers, then please, chip in $5 or $10 today. **_](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=7b9ec7537e&e=4712f71bea)

Thank you,
Kathleen Brown
Democrat for Congress
TX-13

* Evers wants to tout federal money for small businesses, but Evers kept Wisconsin’s economy locked down until the Wisconsin Supreme Court [stopped him](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=CFjYEVqyZtS1iJlrJm_4rYxIbfuSHe3XhJDqYSLowPSjx4k5HW9uSPxcs6X2-lDq-mHmvOwY4DoZrEfpJPzH1S_3idcmCoeCrusu-iPNDqU&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=evers_ad_e_solicit_v1&n=4).
* Evers has repeatedly sided with teachers unions over kids – refusing to lead on reopening schools.
* On Evers’ watch, Milwaukee [set a record](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=ez1BnRg01gPGR4qyG5PO2LV_3pMbUHIlFBrsZcCPouOKusPBTHLuiuFv5wkEyk2-3NNl8NZ-qkhPWMPmndCCz9kafxPLwWZ65qayDezXcSU8MQxk_xCErCxLEMQLSIoTeQbC8ujvnrqp5yXOvxaMvJIjXlvy0Gef_DG9EXaKYvM&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=evers_ad_e_solicit_v1&n=5) for homicides and the efficiency of the state crime lab has [plummeted](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=ez1BnRg01gPGR4qyG5PO2LV_3pMbUHIlFBrsZcCPouNBHja3sfdY8_xeAgIvnS9T5XQuv-_9mJzoeUtvAnWxG_pxfmlr8pYxuduuqKcosBGLdtLpjhQ7Y1tvJlqZCaIjwdAYamcb2ztVTHKnBb0UV1DMzKZa-U_sJvlg-zlAS5s&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=evers_ad_e_solicit_v1&n=6).

clean_body: | | | Peter, Honestly, I have been bracing myself for tonight’s news : A draft opinion was leaked and as of tonight, it very much looks like the Supreme Court will overturn Roe v. Wade in the near future. Let me be clear: abortion is healthcare. Every person should have full reproductive freedom. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your split contribution instantly between Fund Texas Choice, Jane's Due Process, Support Your Sistah at the Afiya Center, Frontera Fund, Texas Equal Access Fund, Clinic Access Support Network, Whole Woman's Health Alliance, Inc., The Bridge Collective, West Fund, and the Lilith Fund I’m running against the last anti-choice Democrat in the House – Henry Cuellar doesn’t believe in a person’s right to choose. But abortion is healthcare, no matter what Henry Cuellar thinks. I believe every single person has a right to the healthcare they need when they need it. It’s a personal decision that should be left up to a person and their doctor, family, or whomever they decide to bring into the choice. To see people like Henry Cuellar decide for others what is or isn’t healthcare is beyond unacceptable. It’s so important that we organize together and support organizations on the frontline of this critical issue. Thank you, Jessica Cisneros | To give by check: PO Box 660 Laredo, TX 78042

Wade_. **I want to make it clear: abortion is still legal and you can still get the care you need.** But this news is gutting. This isn’t a legal opinion – it’s a declaration of war. It is a violent, coordinated right-wing assault on our fundamental rights and freedoms. We cannot afford to wait for the right-wing SCOTUS to overturn Roe next month. Democrats have to act now. We need to codify our reproductive rights into law by abolishing the filibuster and passing the Women's Health Protection Act immediately. And we need to expand the Supreme Court. The future of our reproductive freedom depends on it. **Most of all, we need Democrats with the courage to show up and speak out. The silence and inaction from our electeds speaks volumes. That is why I’m running for Congress: I will never be silent when our rights are under attack.** [**Will you donate $15 to help us make our voices heard?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wNcOc6YQXgT3QRvIzDhxESannAZJlPggbFV6oaoR_HwyBdUjlkiNXgoewI3Fz3d735ZjodDB76ckV3s5IkWutgIKnByz6QhtaPSvXjPcsQKoMLGGQt1VkXF8tqg3bSpQdETPAsLJCUPLpqtZLJdkiWAGrtTYOLKw7qejz6hCnKXOcpox_JYfe4GQXc34i_szO4fBd5At7L1taWjG4n1QamotVrPtHjw0mdfb6_GJ-zs0-et4YfyFGxPg5MP8EXnryj6Zt7kOixNB2YmZ2d_VsZUV2LHRJa-nWV3V4H8y0UgqLDy88FJJV0VygYS6_K1TcC0Sb0-Sncp2wfLPs6cHhbU5eCTQHeCZASbO37v4E2KA/3lq/EUhhsjwaQQG3kAixngBx5g/h2/sP6C8j2OUbYiPNhuhNHy-ayCTabk_QwQY2jUGLZERIo) [Donate »](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wNcOc6YQXgT3QRvIzDhxESannAZJlPggbFV6oaoR_Hw6Pol5S8xfo01-WgXpm8lZ8ncx26zhV06XiupINVKYzjtgdrOqpU4Kxb34JaOHSYsNWpb10Xf-GaQE8HafzonlcfBlU077G2iKOWwmUpz2gD2zsssWvD1O12FUKHfC8LBKkzeqj_QrLuTQdcIA_jIRlSOtudcaX5bSPuMZbJUOwQFqwnKNHZaVqEhPEGTluWCR7EL9Sv2l6EsAptwxrAwIZTSFUtM3oDxN8HVCjFpcoz4OGo_ARebMfy1JHWDj_kOWfacPa7amx2jtmA9WGFS5g3Q2DXkUDpzdm3mTqsQ9iFMN_q1LvpukbXJw_2fo3Isg/3lq/EUhhsjwaQQG3kAixngBx5g/h3/8tXYqI8m892OAMd0wgMC_kkoQJBx-j9cP-t8Fs7aAEU) Tonight’s news is a reminder of how close we are to losing this sacred right. Wade. I want to make it clear: abortion is still legal and you can still get the care you need. But this news is gutting. This isn’t a legal opinion – it’s a declaration of war. It is a violent, coordinated right-wing assault on our fundamental rights and freedoms. We cannot afford to wait for the right-wing SCOTUS to overturn Roe next month. Democrats have to act now. We need to codify our reproductive rights into law by abolishing the filibuster and passing the Women's Health Protection Act immediately. And we need to expand the Supreme Court. That is why I’m running for Congress: I will never be silent when our rights are under attack. Tonight’s news is a reminder of how close we are to losing this sacred right. | | Friend,

If this is indeed the U.S. Supreme Court’s [decision](https://troycarter4congress.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=5823c28272&e=dd5c2df611), this is a dark day for individual rights in our nation.

Louisiana’s trigger ban will go into effect if Roe v. Wade truly is overruled. Thousands will be prevented from accessing critical healthcare, even in cases of rape or incest.

[__**Rush a $25 contribution right now to help me defend the people of LA-02.**__](https://troycarter4congress.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=7df5ff58bd&e=dd5c2df611)

Hello,

Moments ago, the Supreme Court’s draft decision to overturn Roe v. Wade
was leaked. This is incredibly difficult news and I’m outraged.

Overturning Roe would be catastrophic for Ohio, where Republicans have
introduced one extreme proposal after another to ban abortion before most
women even know they're pregnant.

Our work has never been more important than right now. A 50/50 Senate has
failed to protect abortion for people across the country. From the
minority, Republicans abused the filibuster to block the Women’s Health
Protection Act that would have codified Roe.

50/50 is not enough. If we want to make an impact on the issues that
really matter, we must expand our Democratic majority—and that means we
must win this race.

this campaign. If we can flip this seat, we can expand the Democratic
majority and protect the right to an abortion.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11877?t=1009&amount=25&akid=3563%2E3611125%2EFaU9T5 ]Donate

Mitch McConnell and Senate Republicans have made their plan clear all

Women and their families deserve the freedom to make the best decision for
themselves.

I know you’re angry. I am too. But let’s turn this anger into action.

Thank you,

Tim

body:
I went to the Supreme Court tonight — just moments after news broke that the conservative majority will reportedly overturn _Roe v. Wade_. Let’s be clear about this: **_Roe_ wasn’t the beginning of women getting abortions. It was the end of women dying from unsafe abortions.** I’m frustrated that we have had nearly 50 years to write reproductive freedom into federal law. Now, Democrats control the House, the Senate, and the White House — and they still can’t get this done. Tonight’s news could be Democrats’ last warning before the Supreme Court strips millions of Americans of their constitutional right to abortion. It’s time for them to stop treating abortion rights as an afterthought, end the filibuster, and codify _Roe_. If they don’t, more women will die. That’s exactly why I went to the Supreme Court tonight — because Wisconsin has a U.S. Senator who specifically asked the Court to overturn _Roe_ , and if the latest report is true, they’re about to. **[We must replace Ron Johnson with someone who’s going to fight like hell to defend our reproductive rights. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate, and it’s why I’m asking you to stand with me right now by chipping in what you can to support our campaign. | |
Dear Fellow American, Young people today grow up being told that their perception of reality is a matter of perspective. Recently, they are even told that women can choose to be men and men women. This denial of objective reality--including a denial of an objective good--is destructive of proper education, of religious faith, and of free government. Largely as an antidote to this destructive force, Hillsdale College is releasing its latest free online course, “C.S. Lewis on Christianity.” Taught by Michael Ward, a visiting distinguished fellow at Hillsdale and a professor of theology at Oxford University, this seven-lecture course covers Lewis’s philosophical defense of an objective good and his demonstration of its fulfillment in Christianity. **I am writing today to ask if you would consider helping us meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on May 16, so we can promote this new online course effectively, especially to young people.** ** ** Hillsdale produces its free online courses, as it does all its work, while refusing to accept government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. We are entirely dependent on private donations. With your tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of young people in this new free online course and expand Hillsdale’s other outreach efforts. Please help us reach our $500,000 goal. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cs-lewis-christianity](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20260%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lq8LLlBK3NjDCQBfoPSBTg&sysid=1)** Thank you for your friendship and support. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | I am an advocate of **life** and a proponent of **choice** , **privacy** , and **individual liberty**. I support proven measures to **reduce** abortion. **** **Advocating for life means:**
* Supporting children before and after birth
* Programs that assist working parents
* Increasing access to affordable education from Pre-3 on
* Affordable and accessible childcare
* Addressing childhood poverty
* Improving and promoting adoption services and foster programs
* Universal healthcare

**Protecting choice means:**
* Upholding Roe V. Wade
* Supporting reproductive services
* Family planning/contraception
* Providing access to safe and legal abortion
* Protecting a woman's right to privacy
* Proper sex education based on consent

Roe v. Wade, a decision protecting a woman's fundamental right to privacy, was the law of the land. As Ruth Bader Ginsburg stated, it is "a woman's right to control her own destiny, to be able to make choices without a Big Brother state telling her what she can and cannot do." Very often, religious beliefs are the foundation of anti-abortion views, and my or your religious beliefs should not be the basis for the laws of our country. As a physician, I can confidently say no one anticipates or wants to be in a position to decide to have an abortion. It can be a harrowing decision for everyone involved. **I can personally advocate for life and politically be pro-choice. These two positions are not mutually exclusive.** In the end, the government should not serve as the decider on a woman's medical decisions or religious beliefs. If the goal is abortion prevention, making it illegal is ineffective. It only makes it more dangerous. Comprehensive sex education and affordable and accessible birth control are proven to work.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44851925/343392352/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220503-b1_fr_full-MS_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220503-b1_fr_full-MS_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220503&&&&utm_content=b1_fr_full&&&&utm_term=MS_S1_C1&&&&amount=25&refcode2=ed45ed73-e0ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDQ1ZWQ3My1lMGNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YEsvEyt7XEqbmzsKyy8W3UAKyndN35_o4_YJKud6XNc=)

| **January 22, 1973:** The date Roe v. Wade held that the Constitution protects the right to an abortion. **May 2, 2022:** The date a Republican majority Supreme Court revealed their intention to overturn this federal protection and strip millions of women from their right to bodily autonomy. **I know you’re angry. You’re frustrated. I am too. But we can’t afford to miss this moment — it’s our duty to act.** **This morning at 10am ET, my running mate John King and I will be hosting a Facebook and Instagram Live discussion on actions the next Maryland Democratic administration must take to protect abortion access in light of the potential Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe and Casey.** | | | [WATCH ON FACEBOOK](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44851926/343392353/-1785982013?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDQ1ZWQ3My1lMGNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YEsvEyt7XEqbmzsKyy8W3UAKyndN35_o4_YJKud6XNc=&emci=b00b10ed-91ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ed45ed73-e0ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484)
---
| [WATCH ON INSTAGRAM](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44851927/343392354/1959498377?hl=en&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDQ1ZWQ3My1lMGNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YEsvEyt7XEqbmzsKyy8W3UAKyndN35_o4_YJKud6XNc=&emci=b00b10ed-91ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ed45ed73-e0ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484)
---
If you care about access to safe, legal abortion, now is the time to fight back against this horrific news. We can’t allow right-wing ideologues on the Court to take Maryland back to an era of dangerous back-alley abortions.
Since we can’t depend on the federal government to protect these rights, we need to push Maryland to lead by example for the rest of the country on how to support reproductive freedom. Abortion rights are codified here in Maryland, but many of our neighboring states are on the brink of slashing women's rights to govern their own bodies.
Maryland is poised to become one of the most southern states where abortion will remain completely legal and protected by law, and a King-Siri administration will lead the charge to support our neighbors seeking reproductive health care when their own states won't provide it.
No matter who you are or where you come from, each of us deserves the dignity to make choices for ourselves. **This decision from the conservative justices is more than abhorrent, it is a clear attempt to restrict women's rights. **
I’ve dedicated my life to working towards achieving equal rights for everyone here in Maryland and across the country — through my law career, at Planned Parenthood, and at the Women’s Law Center. And I know that right now, we have no choice but to take action.

body:
---
| | | | | | [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FSqZQYbTOdXbAvGhNWVPNcbr9cRdH_wzJqeaWYtJPe8a-_PaDMuHfVdt63Z4AwmdTXlY-yxZXJRr80S4EF9fp0VWzZ1elzUYTlDlI-vuwdhxbcHzRoQgaXpmLuSeMqwdi2rqT-H8UP8elktJMERiloXwCYNKMb4PDpcx4OomEH6U3Jkm-50FCw==&c=qEDiydxUXs0u95ydGwL3R-ijaRg8TmnDrj-XwcbRqGVuIW24s5p1NA==&ch=qMMMcsRdIJVSpCrGaPcFxWhcFsjWTZI0cNsRl8B4FNuP3meWCxYZ4A==)
---
| Peter \-
Remember when there were 30 days left in this crucial race and we announced we were in a statistical tie for FIRST? Now there are 13 DAYS left in this CRUCIAL race and we're announcing that we're in a statistical tie for first AGAIN.
Thanks to YOU and YOUR hard work, we're now not only in a statistical tie for FIRST place AGAIN, but even the mainstream media is paying attention to this campaign -- YOUR campaign. The Washington Post wrote an article about the upcoming midterms where they highlighted how realistic the possibility of US winning this race really is.
It's about time.
It's about time they see what YOU'VE seen all along. It's about time the media does their job, and tells people the REAL story, the story of how the people of Pennsylvania stood behind a seemingly unlikely candidate, and together they became some worrying competition for the tourist 'politicians' who want to come in and take this seat for their own gain.
Against all odds, we've been doing great. We continue to hit our goals, and rise in the polls. Our opponents have deep pockets and polls don't win alone, though. If we don't have the resources to win this nomination, Pennsylvania will go Democrat and we will lose the senate. It's that simple. I truly believe this is the most important race in our country today.
We need to be everywhere we can be. Every day more and more people discover us and lend their support. That happens because of us having the resources to put our message out there. Without your support, that's not possible. That's how WE win, and that's how YOU help us win. Through your contributions, we get to spread our message to the masses, which in turn creates more supporters. It's a winning tactic that our opponents haven't figured out yet, as they just seem hellbent on slandering each other's names, totally ignoring the needs of Pennsylvanians.
---

| If you listen to people they'll tell you what they need, and if you build your campaign around their needs, you're sure to win. All we need is the ability to reach out to more people. Please contribute at the link above. Time is running out, we're almost at the finish line and we can't stop now. I'm grateful for all you've done, and your hard work will pay off. We are down to the wire, though, and without your help we might just come up short. I sure would hate to be this close and have victory snatched right out from underneath us because we didn't close strong. I NEED YOU!
You'll be hearing from me more in the coming days. I'm going to fight your fight, but only YOU can make sure we get to DC.
Blessings, Kathy Barnette

#

Friend,
This is a somber moment for America. But not one to shy away from taking action.
Last night, _Politico_ reported that the Supreme Court has privately voted to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ once and for all.
Our fundamental rights are under attack by the far-right majority on the Court. That is why, last year, I introduced the _Judiciary Act_ , a bill to expand the Supreme Court by four seats so that it accurately reflects America, because Americans support reproductive freedom. We can — and must — take this action.
**Please help me convince my colleagues to abolish the filibuster so that we can pass the _Judiciary Act_ and the _Women's Health Protection Act_ , which would codify _Roe_. It is an unfortunate fact about our politics that public opinion is often ahead of where Congress is on any given issue. This is too important to wait.**
**[Friend, will you join me in calling on Congress to expand the Court? The six, far-right justices are wasting no time chipping away at our rights — and they won’t stop at _Roe_. If you're like me, you know how important it is for us as Americans to fight for and protect our God-given rights.
That's why when I see the needless regulation the Federal Government has in place to severely limit our right to keep and bear arms, I know we have to do something about it.
I'm the only candidate in the race for the First District who will truly stand up to protect the Second Amendment.
I served our beautiful country in the Marine Corps. to protect our rights and freedoms, and I'm a gun owner myself.
I know how long and difficult the process can be to legally acquire a firearm, and I'll work hard to make sure that it becomes easier for law-abiding citizens to own a gun
That's why I'm proud to be endorsed by the largest gun store in Southern Minnesota.
They know I'm the only candidate in this race who'll truly stand up for Americans' right to keep and bear arms, make it easier for law-abiding citizens to exercise their Second Amendment rights, and fight to do away with crippling Federal regulations on the legal sale of firearms.
If you're a proud supporter of the Second Amendment, then I'm the only candidate in this race for you.

clean_body: I’m the only candidate who'll stand up for your Second Amendment rights. | | | | == Hey Peter, If you're like me, you know how important it is for us as Americans to fight for and protect our God-given rights. That's why when I see the needless regulation the Federal Government has in place to severely limit our right to keep and bear arms, I know we have to do something about it. I'm the only candidate in the race for the First District who will truly stand up to protect the Second Amendment. I served our beautiful country in the Marine Corps. to protect our rights and freedoms, and I'm a gun owner myself. I know how long and difficult the process can be to legally acquire a firearm, and I'll work hard to make sure that it becomes easier for law-abiding citizens to own a gun That's why I'm proud to be endorsed by the largest gun store in Southern Minnesota. They know I'm the only candidate in this race who'll truly stand up for Americans' right to keep and bear arms, make it easier for law-abiding citizens to exercise their Second Amendment rights, and fight to do away with crippling Federal regulations on the legal sale of firearms. If you're a proud supporter of the Second Amendment, then I'm the only candidate in this race for you. name: Matt Dolan
subject: The Polls Are Open
body:
[](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=1c81ce1c3d21431991916d8f36be9e49&_m=ce5779c2702c46ea81029bbc6a6ea66a&_e=GpBAITUfKlK0UxPVzsO0c-8yIV1pYijs_w3zpuGdCEyuS1IcBYRGCoc_wvCNNvq9zaKJm0I5Z8Xrjd6mU4eWWhERS8hJm1d3MrOqRlH3xKZeKoXvnU1xYSkqcQTt9FrNRLUU8jj7w8HskZ0FXT4CZQ-qlwTZ5Bq589Hv1Ioq4nypkVHVFEsiXHAZ0gOhQfWoJgzmNxWn-ztDSEXQR2OH5v8w9cWWn8Jmk6Y5ZdkcL50yCbUlVqrJ2s_HtYX5BYI0G-s_s-U9jtOHcRIGCSvQ8DM_yxMGh8_FhAv0DTCSH4nl1H0tERcFFc-W_30lbOyA) My friend, It’s Election Day. **The polls are open from 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. and I humbly ask for your vote.** Last summer, I launched the "Ohio Matters Tour" to weigh the prospect of a run for the U.S. Senate. I did this in part because it was clear that we live in a time when most politicians are more concerned with "fighting" rather than working for Ohio. I quickly saw that instead of lecturing Ohioans, it was clear our state needed someone who is willing to speak a little less and listen a little more. Over the last seven months, Ohioans have opened their hearts, homes, and businesses to share their personal stories, successes, and challenges. Our state and nation presently face a complex and profound series of crises. From rising inflation and a migrant surge on our southern border, to the failed withdrawal and resulting national security and humanitarian catastrophe in Afghanistan, this moment calls for public leaders guided by the Constitution, their convictions, and a willingness to put Ohio first and get results. Your vote will help to ensure that I can continue my record of conservative results that have cut income taxes, funded our police, provided support to defend the Southern Border and implement President Trump’s 2-for-1 deregulation agenda in Ohio. Together we turned the focus of this race back to where it matters most: Ohio. Because Ohio matters. Now, we have one more task. **To vote.** Your vote will send a message in support of the rule of law, that we must continue our efforts to crack down on illegal immigration, preserve constitutional rights, and protect Life. Your vote will help strengthen local decision making when it comes to supporting our farmers, manufacturers, energy workers, and local industry. Your vote will make certain that I can continue to reverse the dangerous policies of the Biden Administration, fight to get our veterans the care they earned, and give our brave men and women in uniform the resources they need to keep America safe. **The polls are now open across Ohio. If you have not voted already, I would be honored to receive your vote.** Matt Dolan P.S. The polls are open today until 7:30 p.m - to find your polling location, [click here.](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=1c81ce1c3d21431991916d8f36be9e49&_m=ce5779c2702c46ea81029bbc6a6ea66a&_e=GpBAITUfKlK0UxPVzsO0c-8yIV1pYijs_w3zpuGdCEyuS1IcBYRGCoc_wvCNNvq9zaKJm0I5Z8Xrjd6mU4eWWhERS8hJm1d3MrOqRlH3xKb4vDuqw4d-RXnQz9zaWSaVVjhcVQ4ptiQloOLs1lc8_smdzLaHP8rx6IG4Phzq-MicxcqQyRLU3pG0ftpl5KOkxkc6XDUHgNxhpFGFyuDfWfLjifrhrQMgVhUX8Gym_af-2im8HvC0PtJVyZc9deNeVYBHlYpAD4UQbfi1ucVxTV3QcpkVcADii4Dhy0OrbfU8yIu-Eueztnbn8h_9BhMl) [](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=1c81ce1c3d21431991916d8f36be9e49&_m=ce5779c2702c46ea81029bbc6a6ea66a&_e=GpBAITUfKlK0UxPVzsO0c-8yIV1pYijs_w3zpuGdCEyuS1IcBYRGCoc_wvCNNvq9zaKJm0I5Z8Xrjd6mU4eWWhERS8hJm1d3MrOqRlH3xKaw2kL_9ccezJzDW5Lkq1YrwI4FryxWhBHKJ7ybx_L9EjH9W6EEbCnTjiO2gVqRW7MReih_i-f0wWfNrEHP0QANlxSHkBuVrdTjP1VVaR8jY5b9wgRqj43DUEH677hyxlcO9mJAlXNYSnJldk9d4uvd4lZr8VzxY9f5iXM_xH6b7-9N0bbfLjQNA0X3r3dhwZ7479RiFgDeARI33cinH-JY) [](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=1c81ce1c3d21431991916d8f36be9e49&_m=ce5779c2702c46ea81029bbc6a6ea66a&_e=GpBAITUfKlK0UxPVzsO0c-8yIV1pYijs_w3zpuGdCEyuS1IcBYRGCoc_wvCNNvq9zaKJm0I5Z8Xrjd6mU4eWWhERS8hJm1d3MrOqRlH3xKYBhguyzfAYtDYhk8kFut3nHDMpqWuSQ3XfzHpN4tB8HvVekEp03-ZlaeYWJPdZ0DZ6nI03meBnvBHyy7CAotWdExnW6bl2SPdwRu9tZMkJyuxnaXabwmXZ04JPXigOIFHTfEeEqoA_KTArR_h2_KBGnZZ5xWc7SpUi-28EgsEzHvkTV-XEQyzI1G4_9Ph3LcOeSTO7L7NGsOJvhKQR5Fiv) [Click here to unsubscribe.](http://links.iterable.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=1c81ce1c3d21431991916d8f36be9e49&_s=ce5779c2702c46ea81029bbc6a6ea66a&_t=sdBfq9FL97xROR1s3tg0ssE3buZjOW0Hcc6orDIvuzTue_jZUHWMFd5z6KIHWJ1mTa5VbgCvx4Dge-MhKKPX5beNO_292nDGBUxHrvfgWwixB1eKdNYgNKP8WqqsB8XvZ_kj1aflVSuPPLjdXFz0_SEdqTUV91CU8JcYxoSUOs4%3D)

# THE BECKWITH BRIEFING

#### News & Notes
from the Campaign
---
| | **Vote for me May 21st to stop the Biden Administration’s government overreach.**
---
| Joe Biden has been steadily working his way down a to-do list of budget-busting overreach that will **insert the government into nearly every aspect of your life**. District 10 voters don’t want more government in their lives, but Jennifer Wexton isn’t listening. I am. **Vote for me on May 21st** ; together, we can stop the overreach.

---
| Biden's Overreach | What I'll Do
---|---
**Your Finances.** Biden issued an [Executive Order](https://davebeckwithforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fae606123cc47ee5c50436c39&id=649e805f5b&e=70e89e3dc3) to pave the way for a government digital currency to monitor and control what you buy. | **I’ll fight every effort to take away our economic freedom that built nearly 250 years of American prosperity and choice.**
**Your Free Speech.** Biden just stood up a “Misinformation Governance Board” that will allow partisan, unelected bureaucrats to censor your free speech. [This infographic](https://davebeckwithforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fae606123cc47ee5c50436c39&id=d50aff68ca&e=70e89e3dc3) shows the current Administration’s definition of ‘misinformation’ and how to stop it. | If Biden won’t disband this Board, I’ll fight to defund it. I’ll invest in non-partisan public-private collaborations to fight foreign meddling in our affairs, but **I’ll stand against any effort to muzzle Americans’ right to express their opinions.**
**Your Privacy.** Under Biden, the FBI made [3.4 million searches without a warrant](https://davebeckwithforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fae606123cc47ee5c50436c39&id=c9c97bb1c8&e=70e89e3dc3) while investigating threats like the Colonial Pipeline hack. Can this Administration be trusted to keep partisan politics out of these searches? | The FBI’s legal authority for these unwarranted searches expires in 2023. There are many in Congress that will want to extend it. **I’ll fight to limit any government activities that risk your privacy.**
| This is a lot of scary stuff, but I know you won’t let the radical left bully you into fear.**Now is the time to stand up, to push back, and defend your rights to privacy and liberty – and it starts with sending me to Congress** where I will fight for you. Vote for me May 21st – I’m a 30-year Air Force veteran, an engineer, a 20+ year homeschool dad, and a man of lifelong faith. I’ve got what it takes to lead us to a bright future, free of government overreach!
---
| Remember: there is only ONE location for in-person absentee voting on May 12th! See the info below and check out my [website ](https://davebeckwithforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fae606123cc47ee5c50436c39&id=292fde039a&e=70e89e3dc3)for all the details to make sure you don’t miss your chance to vote for me!
---
|
---
| | Voting Information
---
| **Don’t miss your chance to vote for Dave!**
* **The VA10 Firehouse Primary is May 21st!** Mark your calendars!
* Absentee voting is in person only on Thursday, May 12th from 4PM - 8PM at the Middleburg Barn – check out my [website ](https://davebeckwithforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fae606123cc47ee5c50436c39&id=bbdf61fea5&e=70e89e3dc3)for the details on absentee voting.
* Primary voting on May 21st is from 9AM - 4PM and only at 11 designated locations!
* **Congressional Districts have changed!** You may now be in District 10! Check out my [website](https://davebeckwithforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fae606123cc47ee5c50436c39&id=6277b078e9&e=70e89e3dc3)[ ](https://davebeckwithforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fae606123cc47ee5c50436c39&id=894a79d628&e=70e89e3dc3)for an interactive district map, list of polling places, and registration info.

name: Nikki Fried
subject: I'm speechless
disclaimer_text: paid for and approved by Nikki Fried, Democrat, for Governor
body:
Peter,

Last night, Politico reported that the Supreme Court is voting to overturn Roe v. Wade .

When I read the news, I was speechless. Today, I’m furious .

There’s no overstating how serious this is, Peter.

This ruling puts women’s lives at risk. It undermines women’s basic human right to make our own decisions. It sets women’s rights back 50 years. And it sends a message to women and girls across the country that our lives aren’t our own — that a room full of out-of-touch men has more power over our health and well-being than we do.

This is our wake-up call, Peter — it has to be. Because we can’t live in a country where our fundamental rights and our basic protection under the law can be tossed aside with the tides of partisanship.

We need to do everything we can to make sure women have safe, accessible reproductive care when they need it most. We need to rally support at every level of government for leaders who will fight like hell to protect women and protect abortion rights.

And we need to defeat anti-abortion politicians like Ron DeSantis — because if we don’t, there’s no doubt DeSantis and his allies will fully ban abortion the second this decision becomes official.
When I saw the news, I was speechless. But now, I’m ready to speak up and fight back harder than ever before.

I’ve never wavered in my support for women’s rights and a woman’s right to choose, and I never will — no matter what.

Thank you for standing with me in this fight.

— Nikki

subject: Just your endorsement

body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Patriot,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask, Patriot, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.

name: Tim Ryan
subject: Roe v. Wade
body:
Derek,
Last night, the Supreme Court’s draft decision to overturn Roe v. Wade was leaked. This is incredibly difficult news and I’m outraged.
Overturning Roe would be catastrophic for Ohio, where Republicans have introduced one extreme proposal after another to ban abortion before most women even know they're pregnant.
Our work has never been more important than right now. A 50/50 Senate has failed to protect abortion for people across the country. From the minority, Republicans abused the filibuster to block the Women’s Health Protection Act in order to codify Roe.
50/50 is not enough. If we want to make an impact on the issues that really matter, we must expand our Democratic majority—and that means we must win this race .
I wouldn’t say this if I didn’t mean it: one of the most important things you can do to fight for reproductive rights is make a split donation between this campaign and CommonGood. If we can flip this seat, we can expand the Democratic majority and protect the right to an abortion. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20220503_CGVA_Ryan]

DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20220503_CGVA_Ryan&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20220503_CGVA_Ryan]
Today is Ohio’s primary election and the stakes of our battleground Senate race have never been higher . Every single one of my GOP opponents supports dangerous, restrictive anti-abortion laws.
JD Vance called pregnancy from rape “inconvenient” and Josh Mandel supports Ohio’s extreme heartbeat legislation and other dangerous bills across the country that would allow people to sue anyone who helps someone get an abortion.
It’s despicable and we can’t let them anywhere near the United States Senate. Our only choice to protect reproductive rights is to win this race and expand our Democratic Senate majority.
Our fight has never been more important. Please, if you can, split a contribution between our campaign and CommonGood at this critical moment. Your support will go toward winning the Senate majority and protecting this right. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20220503_CGVA_Ryan]
Mitch McConnell and Senate Republicans have made their plan clear along: pack the courts with right-wing judges, empower state legislatures across the country to pass extreme, dangerous anti-abortion bills, and overturn Roe.
We cannot let them get away with it.
Women and their families deserve the freedom to make the best decision for themselves.
I know you’re angry. I am too. But let’s turn this anger into action.
Thank you,
— Tim

| | Dear Peter, Today is Election Day! I wanted to send you one final reminder to vote for me, Jane Timken, for U.S. Senate. I know you are considering several options in this race, but I am the best candidate because **I am the true, America First candidate in the Senate race with the tenacity to stop the Biden agenda in its tracks.** I have been fighting for Ohio conservatives for years as the Ohio GOP Chairman who helped deliver Ohio for President Trump, and I am ready to take that same fighting spirit to Washington.
---
---
At the beginning of this campaign, I invested in a grassroots strategy that I know works in Ohio because it did in 2018 and 2020. After over a year, our team has contacted **over 1.5 million** Ohio primary voters and garnered [over 200 conservative endorsements from across the state](http://links.janetimkenforohio.com/u/click?_t=d33702f99bd24ab29d9d703faac4f8a3&_m=b96e6df871fe406198b92e224d53dece&_e=jTSE4uXPApvROlqxonFlpRLAy0ENAVOrNiSwE3hIon3l_btCI9vd3Bk4pVc0haMgOFgHO_41RYnLt6ow7ZfOQSORfOQocTy_afsJ7nJ0OrxClVOsX5I_nwLc1dux1vYj-6uL7MeInE3EYkxeyxI1WorOkYKPCw2CWHuZ-5QA10cktuE_1vCjJ2AGpKBSIpWI6lXI5u7UMl-fpMRkJhV81qtMMhUTRX8545-ud4fo71UoTTMtGlXZxYPYVpncNbtf3YKVIBwUzpIkqLNmYt2LLIPB5jJTxL9eegosE3tz_Ik%3D). There are many candidates in this Senate race in it for themselves, but trust me when I say: I am in it for YOU. body:
Hi Peter,
A leaked U.S. Supreme Court opinion has shown that the court plans to overturn Roe v. Wade – meaning that performing an abortion will become a felony in places like Texas and across the country.
Because of this, we are redirecting our campaign today entirely to helping support the organizations that can help us stop this from happening across our country. Can you help us support abortion access in Texas by making a donation now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/support-abortion-access-tx?refcode=05.03_email]
SUPPORT ABORTION ACCESS >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/support-abortion-access-tx?refcode=05.03_email]
100% of donations through this page will go toward Texas abortion funds and abortion advocacy organizations.
We CAN and MUST stop abortion from being banned. Roe v. Wade’s origins are from Texas. Sarah Weddington sued Dallas District Attorney Henry Wade to take down Texas’ anti-abortion statutes at the Supreme Court in the 1970s. Activists and leaders from the South can lead the way, today, to protect abortion access.
In Congress, I’ll support codifying Roe , eliminating the Hyde Amendment, and making sure that everyone who needs abortion care has the access they need. But right now, we can support those in Texas fighting back and those who need abortion care.
Can you join me in donating to support abortion access today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/support-abortion-access-tx?refcode=05.03_email]
With you in this fight,
- Greg

body:
Good afternoon,

The campaign is going strong, and we are gaining more and more momentum by
the day! We are less than three weeks out from the Republican primary,
which is on Saturday, May 21st.

*Volunteering*

*Knocking Doors*
We need you to knock on the doors of fellow Republicans in your
neighborhood to spread Brandon's message and GOTV! It's super easy, and we
can pair you with another person. Even if it's just for an hour, we'd love
for you to get involved.

Similar to knocking doors, we need you to help GOTV and call fellow

Tristan

body:

Peter,

Last night, _Politico_ reported from a leaked draft opinion that the Supreme Court voted to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ – the landmark 1973 decision which ruled that every person had the right to make their own personal reproductive health care decisions.

While it is not yet confirmed, if the reports are true and this backwards ruling is enacted, it will be a horrible tragedy for millions of women who deserve access to abortion care.

This decision would open the floodgates for Republican politicians across the country to make abortion illegal. And it's not just in red states. Here in Rhode Island, I'm running for Congress against Allan Fung, a politician who accepted the endorsement of RI Right to Life, a group that wants to make abortion illegal in our state.

Make no mistake: I will always fight for the right to choose. As Treasurer, I worked to pass the Reproductive Privacy Act which codified Roe into Rhode Island law and I support the Equal Access to Abortion Act because a women’s right to reproductive healthcare should not depend on what type of health insurance she has.

In Congress, I will fight to ensure reproductive rights are protected for all and will support the Women's Health Protection Act to codify _Roe_ into federal law nationwide and block states from enacting medically unjustified barriers to accessing abortion care.

**[If you're committed to protecting access to reproductive care, please consider making a donation to Planned Parenthood of Southern New England to support their important work to provide reproductive care to thousands of Rhode Islanders.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44862820/343437923/-1121301879?sourceid=1000061&affiliateID=090220&_ga=2.254362568.1587935773.1651587133-1056340990.1651587133&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZmE4N2Q0OS1mMGNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_aT4ea5zNElk_mtpbxUqZguC6VjzEn1OSgwvEgOi1I0=&emci=af084325-edca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=3fa87d49-f0ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15384964)**

Thank you,

Seth

# An uptick of endorsements!
---
|
---
Proud to have received an endorsement from Chelsea White-Hoglen. Chelsea is a community activist and advocate, especially for Appalachia.This is some of what she had to say in giving her endorsement:
I am proud to endorse [Jay Carey for Congress](https://jaycareyforcongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=12fcf73a455ed3a3ff101405d&id=3c233b8ad8&e=9cbf9f5985)[ ](https://jaycareyforcongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=12fcf73a455ed3a3ff101405d&id=178d6f4981&e=9cbf9f5985)in the Democratic Primary for CD11.
This is the first time I have ever made an endorsement in the Democratic Primary for WNC's Congressional District 11. Normally, I don't feel that any of the candidates adequately measure up to the type of person I am proud to vote for and associate my name with. This year, I feel differently after much deliberation and careful consideration of those who are running across the board and the ways that I have seen them show up over the last 1.5 years.
So what's different about Jay? Why am I endorsing him over the other candidates in the race?
**1\. Authentic Organizing & Connection with the Community**

I met Jay in July of last year and have since seen him make an intentional effort to connect with the people of Western North Carolina as more than just a candidate. Immediately after Tropical Storm Fred hit, while I was organizing relief efforts in Cruso, Jay got in touch and asked how he could be of support. Driving over from Hendersonville sometimes multiple days in a row to do the dirty work in the muck and mud, organizing fundraisers in his community to spread the abundance into the community that had just been devastated, and following the lead of those who were directly impacted on the ground. Trying to be a genuine support to those of us struggling to recover from the disaster, rather than use the opportunity to leverage his campaign or as a photo op...

The first reason that I am endorsing Jay Carey is because he has proven his character to me. His character drives me to believe that he's willing to do the hard work to build deep relationships and show up with integrity and authenticity that we deserve from those who represent us.

**2\. Walking the Walk**
Jay Carey is the only candidate that I have seen out of the six show up to fight for the issues that impact our community outside of his campaign for congress: from recovery efforts in Cruso to direct actions related to the climate crisis, to supporting BLM, to holding our local electeds accountable.
The second reason that I am endorsing Jay Carey is because I trust that Jay will continue to walk the walk in the same way that he has shown me already.

**3\. The Only REAL Progressive in the Primary that Understands the Bold Solutions that Our Rural Communities Want & Deserve**
There's a false narrative that our rural neighbors will only support moderates but, from my experience personally knocking on thousands of doors conducting listening surveys and deep canvasses among our neighbors from Murphy to Marshall and everywhere in between, that's the exact opposite of what I have heard from folks. (See more from one of these surveys in my 2017 report "No One's Ever Asked Me Before" here:[ ](https://jaycareyforcongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=12fcf73a455ed3a3ff101405d&id=7350cdc205&e=9cbf9f5985)[https://bit.ly/dhnc2017](https://jaycareyforcongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=12fcf73a455ed3a3ff101405d&id=1e99ec6cb9&e=9cbf9f5985))

So the third reason that I am endorsing Jay Carey is because he is the only candidate that I have seen who has been willing to take a BOLD stance on the solutions that our rural communities need and deserve...
**I'm voting for Jay Carey and encourage you to do the same.**

Driving over from Hendersonville sometimes multiple days in a row to do the dirty work in the muck and mud, organizing fundraisers in his community to spread the abundance into the community that had just been devastated, and following the lead of those who were directly impacted on the ground. Trying to be a genuine support to those of us struggling to recover from the disaster, rather than use the opportunity to leverage his campaign or as a photo op... The first reason that I am endorsing Jay Carey is because he has proven his character to me. His character drives me to believe that he's willing to do the hard work to build deep relationships and show up with integrity and authenticity that we deserve from those who represent us. 2\. Walking the Walk Jay Carey is the only candidate that I have seen out of the six show up to fight for the issues that impact our community outside of his campaign for congress: from recovery efforts in Cruso to direct actions related to the climate crisis, to supporting BLM, to holding our local electeds accountable. The second reason that I am endorsing Jay Carey is because I trust that Jay will continue to walk the walk in the same way that he has shown me already. 3\. The Only REAL Progressive in the Primary that Understands the Bold Solutions that Our Rural Communities Want & Deserve There's a false narrative that our rural neighbors will only support moderates but, from my experience personally knocking on thousands of doors conducting listening surveys and deep canvasses among our neighbors from Murphy to Marshall and everywhere in between, that's the exact opposite of what I have heard from folks. (See more from one of these surveys in my 2017 report "No One's Ever Asked Me Before" here:) So the third reason that I am endorsing Jay Carey is because he is the only candidate that I have seen who has been willing to take a BOLD stance on the solutions that our rural communities need and deserve... I'm voting for Jay Carey and encourage you to do the same. | | | | | An email of support: Thanks for coming out to Clay County last week. Although any of the candidates we met on Saturday would be better than those bozos being run by the Republicans we felt like you are the most likely to be electable. Not to mention that in having read over your website and various position points I am in agreement with your positions. We’re not rich but hopefully $100 will be helpful at this time. I’ll pop over to the contribute page Good luck Sincerely - Pat W. | Tiny Bridge Farm supports Jay Carey for Congress and we can support them: Flat Rock Farmers Market on Thursdays 3-6pm beginning 4/28 3-6pm thru October Hendersonville Farmers Market on Saturdays 8am-1pm beginning 5/7 thru October | | Early Voting Ends May 14th We are still Getting Out The Vote! ---
| Surging Constitutional Warrior defines race as between a bold, unafraid conservative fighter and a say-anything squish With all weapons of his opponents pointed at his back during Sunday's Atlanta Press Club debate for the Sixth Congressional District, Jake Evans emerged as the undisputed winner, easily dispatching the false attacks and defining the race as between a true America First conservative and a squish endorsed by the most liberal Republicans in Washington. "Sunday's debate erased any doubts that my opponents know that my campaign is the one that's surging," Jake said. "They're falling further and further behind, and their attacks are getting more and more desperate." Jake was the ONLY candidate to field multiple candidate-to-candidate attacks about his support for law enforcement and his fight for President Trump's campaign to ensure only legal votes were counted that he took all the way to the Supreme Court. Jake took faltering Rich McCormick to task for seeking the endorsement of the Main Street Republican Partnership, the moderate wing of the GOP caucus whose membership is known to vote with the Democrats. "Rich, you courted and were endorsed by the most liberal faction of the Republican caucus. Some people call it the Trump impeachment caucus and you have stood by this endorsement. Most RINOS don't show their horn until after they get elected. Rich, the voters of the 6th district deserve to know what squishy commitments you made to the Liberal Mainstreet Republican Partnership. What did you tell them to earn their support?"
McCormick was unable to explain away his efforts to tell everyone in Washington what they wanted to hear to earn their support. He tried to suggest that he would accept support from anyone that would join with him, but failed to explain how he convinced the moderate caucus to back him. [LISTEN HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UhHliUFrmWywujyhXBwOBUPBkwvsdaxo0Mb8vPbfWG04mDUrzofJST6_PsfcZXEqkzbH6Eh4y3X3m6Q-DPF9RsdRQNNXyK79tl2Z-YRhVchr85JkwfV7-jxIus7H4P0w7MECrOXqv0fejC5VXIn5KQ==&c=EwMbSSd5QFlw0dYC9DhbCmvXBhYFN1urJXED4j2z8c7VGEt-fhbgBA==&ch=Gx1-XmLl8k4HY2Zzc93uwT8SxejJp0O7Ir1pOTa1i9s5envRhvglKg==)
"Rich McCormick knows his campaign is in danger and all the others know their time is running out. This campaign is a choice between a conservative fighter endorsed by those closest to President Trump - from Newt Gingrich to Sean Hannity to Richard Grenell - and a weak-kneed Republican who tells every group what they want to hear - even RINO groups. We don't need more politicians out for themselves. We need unapologetic conservatives that will fight to restore America First principles and never bow to the Woke Mob or liberal media. That person is Jake Evans", Campaign Manager John Mason Long stated.

---
Friend,

I'm horrified.

Multiple media outlets have obtained a draft decision authored by Supreme Court Justice Samuell Alito characterized by Politico as "a full-throated, unflinching repudiation of the 1973 decision which guaranteed federal constitutional protections of abortion rights". Alito is joined by at least four other conservative justices (Chief Justice Roberts's opinion is unknown at this point).

**In other words, Roe v Wade has been overturned.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44863567/343441336/41694283?refcode=X_050222_BREAKINGNEWS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NGM0OTNjNy1mMWNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gccfuLwRzgnz-5CVTkbTeiX5G6Xgi9sO0cq22KfQ8yo=)
---
Republicans knew this decision was coming and in states like Arizona, passed legislation ensuring abortion would be criminalized in the event Roe was overturned.

**So what happens now?**

This attack on personal freedom is unprecedented and requires an historic response from the majority of Americans who believe in abortion rights. What we do next could very well shape the course of our country for generations to come. With one, united voice we must declare that abortion rights are human rights, and we won't give them up without a fight. And above all, **we must push Congress to pass federal legislation protecting abortion rights.**

Now is the time to get behind **unapologetically**** pro-choice** leaders and candidates who will fight for abortion rights for all who may become pregnant. I'm proud to be such a candidate and**** I'm asking for your help. **Send me to Congress and I will fight like hell to pass federal legislation to protect abortion rights.** I hope you will join me.

In the fight,

Joe Biden was able to pay the bills after earning millions of dollars through his and his wife's companies after leaving office as vice president. His financial filings show that he declared almost $7 million more income on his tax returns than on his government transparency reports, [leaving $5.2 million unexplained,](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) a new analysis of those records reveals. The discrepancy – combined with emails on Hunter's abandoned laptop – suggests that the senior Biden would have a 10% share in Hunter's mega-deal with the Chinese. The story of Hunter's laptop, long suppressed by legacy media, has led to a new and more troubling question: Did Joe Biden receive money from Hunter's foreign business deals?

Just prior to this latest revelation, a [poll](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1Mjc1JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/OsHXUNKdS7mskLnt8IoTwA) found that 63.7% of voters — including 34.3% of expected Democrat voters — believe Biden to be "likely" compromised and/or conflicted "when dealing with China."

Joe Kennedy, a retired Marine and high school football coach, used to pray on the field after every game. At first, he prayed alone, but over the years, players on his team and the other team had started to gather with him after games. After finding out about Kennedy's prayers, administrators at his school attempted to make him stop and even implemented a new policy to ban him from praying on the field. Instead of allowing himself to be silenced, Kennedy sued the school district. After years of legal battles, the Supreme Court finally heard Kennedy's case and will issue a decision in the coming months. A ruling in Kennedy's favor would be a victory for religious freedom and help ensure that public school employees are protected from attacks against their faith at a time when students are bombarded by radical doctrines.

Grocery prices rose [9%](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1Mjc1JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/_zoBrREemT3I5viOSsKjJA) in March because of inflation, and the CEO of Goya recently [warned](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1Mjc1JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/GxnyJdvf1EjcCJ8Ufeh8WA), "We are on the precipice of a global food crisis." Biden caused out-of-control inflation by pursuing aggressive regulatory efforts that hurt food and energy producers, paying millions of Americans not to work and recklessly spending trillions on vanity projects.

If Biden and his allies [don't reverse course](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), the American people will reap the consequences of their disastrous policies. Sen. Kelly Loeffler argues, "We are walking a tightrope between prosperity and a bleak future of fuel and food shortages," adding that "we will be coping with the consequences of Biden's reckless policies for years to come."

In a post-Roe America, ballot measures are our last line of defense | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44867620/343449767/765663662?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRlAvMS84NTQ3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2VlM2IyZi1mNWNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-xgAvU-Gyb5gf15g19MLFtDX3JycQKHZjChlN5yF2Cc=&emci=e9888bfb-eeca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=c7ee3b2f-f5ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=561582) | Hey there, It’s Hannah, the Campaigns Director for the Fairness Project. By now you’ve likely heard the news on Roe — the Supreme Court is poised to gut the landmark law that guarantees abortion rights to millions across the country. **At the Fairness Project, our mission is simple:** Help as many progressive ballot measure campaigns _win_ every election cycle as possible. _But we have limited resources, and part of my job is deciding which campaigns we can support. _ Earlier this year, we decided to invest in a first-of-its-kind ballot measure campaign in Michigan to proactively protect reproductive rights and abortion access. **And with the latest news, we’re ready to put every resource we can behind other ballot measures like our campaign in Michigan to codify reproductive rights in states that could lose access once Roe is formally overturned.** **But with just 7 months until the November midterms and primaries in many states just around the corner, our slate of 2022 campaigns is stacked and many of our resources have been allocated for the cycle.[_If you can, will you donate whatever you can today to help us run more campaigns like our fight in Michigan to protect abortion access in a post-Roe America?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44867621/343449768/-1213192302?refcode=E15379-20220503-RoeDecision-SL-AbortionReproductiveRights-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRlAvMS84NTQ3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2VlM2IyZi1mNWNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-xgAvU-Gyb5gf15g19MLFtDX3JycQKHZjChlN5yF2Cc=)** Friend, we knew Roe was on the chopping block, and now with this leaked news, our worst fears have become reality. **SCOTUS’ leaked opinion has made it clear: If we want to protect our reproductive rights, we need to do it ourselves.** **The path forward is in the states.** I’ve seen the polling, and I know how these things go. I know we can win this campaign in Michigan, and with your help, I know we can run _and win_ ballot measures in other states to proactively protect abortion access too. By now you’ve likely heard the news on Roe — the Supreme Court is poised to gut the landmark law that guarantees abortion rights to millions across the country. At the Fairness Project, our mission is simple: Help as many progressive ballot measure campaigns win every election cycle as possible. But we have limited resources, and part of my job is deciding which campaigns we can support. Earlier this year, we decided to invest in a first-of-its-kind ballot measure campaign in Michigan to proactively protect reproductive rights and abortion access. And with the latest news, we’re ready to put every resource we can behind other ballot measures like our campaign in Michigan to codify reproductive rights in states that could lose access once Roe is formally overturned. But with just 7 months until the November midterms and primaries in many states just around the corner, our slate of 2022 campaigns is stacked and many of our resources have been allocated for the cycle.= Friend, we knew Roe was on the chopping block, and now with this leaked news, our worst fears have become reality. name: Peter Franchot
subject: Defending Abortion Care in Maryland
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
Last night, Politico reported on a draft majority opinion signaling that the Supreme Court is poised to completely overturn Roe v. Wade in a stunning reversal of decades of legal precedent. While the Court has not yet released their final opinion, the gravity of this situation cannot be overstated. If this outrageous draft opinion is adopted, then millions of women across the country will instantly lose access to abortion care.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/SRrAoUrSEEunFRDFU4J_5w2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/SRrAoUrSEEunFRDFU4J_5w2]
As we grapple with the possibility of a post-Roe v. Wade future, we must take urgent action to protect and expand access to abortion at the state level. It is not enough to maintain the status quo – we must push back against these attacks on reproductive rights with bold policy action. When I joined with abortion rights advocates on Lawyers Mall in Annapolis last year, I called on lawmakers to enshrine abortion rights in the state constitution. I am once again renewing my call today.
This draft opinion makes clear how imperative it is that we take this step. If you agree with me, then will you add your name to my petition saying that we must enshrine the right to an abortion into the Maryland state constitution? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/SRrAoUrSEEunFRDFU4J_5w2]

body:
Overturning Roe v Wade isn’t about me. It’s about all of us.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44868775/343451576/397881982?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDQ0MWU1Yy1mNmNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIq_YX7_LE04Rm9w8sHxVBXStkT-Nzi6D0DzKlJzau0=&emci=8e5ef28a-e5ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=5d441e5c-f6ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=799895)
---
| Peter,

Overturning Roe v Wade isn’t about me. It’s about all of us. I don’t have to tell you how important access to safe abortion is, and I don’t have to tell you what it means to women across the country with regard to our personal reproductive rights. **What I will tell you is this - the highest court in the land seems poised to send a signal to women across the country that we’re not full citizens, that we don’t have rights to our own bodies, that government should be able to inject itself into the doctor-patient relationship.** Where that ends, well, that’s a scary thought, but this is how it begins.

When I go to Congress, I’ll fight until I drop to codify Roe v Wade and ensure that all women have access to safe abortions. But you already know that. My voting record in the state senate has proven it. I have a track record of standing up to Republicans on this issue. [_**So today, I’m not asking you to donate to me; I’m asking you to consider making a donation to Emily's List, the largest support of pro-choice, female candidates in the country.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44868776/343451577/397881982?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDQ0MWU1Yy1mNmNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIq_YX7_LE04Rm9w8sHxVBXStkT-Nzi6D0DzKlJzau0=&emci=8e5ef28a-e5ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=5d441e5c-f6ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=799895)

---
When Roe v Wade is kicked back to the states, I can assure you that the extreme Republican legislatures across the country will move swiftly to attempt to pass Texas-style legislation. As a State Senator, you can count on my vote against any legislation that limits access to abortion, and we can uphold a veto. But, there are so many other states that can’t say the same. Donating to Emily’s List will help us elect pro-choice Democratic women up and down the ballot across the country to ensure that we are able to fight back at every level of government.

This is urgent. The only thing stopping a complete dissent into the dark ages is flipping seats across the country from the state legislature to Congress. [_**If you’re able, please consider a donation to Emily’s List today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44868778/343451579/397881982?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDQ0MWU1Yy1mNmNhLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zIq_YX7_LE04Rm9w8sHxVBXStkT-Nzi6D0DzKlJzau0=&emci=8e5ef28a-e5ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=5d441e5c-f6ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=799895)

And please know that when I get to Congress, I’ll have your back there too, just like I have in my 24 years of service in this district.

Valerie

**This is appalling and dangerous. Women's right to an abortion and freedom to make choices about their own bodies must be protected.

This past weekend the [Republican Party of Virginia](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dgFlMoFbqddtisFSZZSVPLcb7qFL5I3k4I5wt6wZ4-H5IAHMv4TrAHVC8Xy-mWq8k8-k29GNFqL9XolomA9SnhcwM_R6QjJ89-cdPOhpUcbU7ekoAXVsuUSL-pOiShJFVAS3KVMEyik=&c=UQ-69qWxdgB1zDicZX1dJPxxKfPnRHjkJ7YKpM1S50CUe8pKU8zxyw==&ch=BOUlZxf6YNA7BHNOqfyomgCSEAbRpFg_-ZbjU_wLmTAUrKHkKrDw3w==) held their annual statewide gathering, The Advance (Republicans never retreat!) in Herndon. One of the breakout sessions I attended was on the importance of religious freedom and the participants included religious leaders from the Christian, Jewish, Hindu and Muslim communities.

One of the panel's participants was my grandfather, former Congressman Frank Wolf, who has been an international leader and fighter for human and religious rights, [written a book](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dgFlMoFbqddtisFSZZSVPLcb7qFL5I3k4I5wt6wZ4-H5IAHMv4TrADUXjl9qQ9x1EoWUwHn9C4huiYH-IQbUA8bunJ_OyzZj5A7GEM7nCgYav-4CvOuhbQLxct71XEXwlRPHyi8IhKYL0wQtOn8piW_zGUr1KuAm4IjiC6ftHF7e-5s-aRb3Ioy8Ry2SV5DvjxTP2_yFKKEs24oqUOA_zuz7VO7D1l-E&c=UQ-69qWxdgB1zDicZX1dJPxxKfPnRHjkJ7YKpM1S50CUe8pKU8zxyw==&ch=BOUlZxf6YNA7BHNOqfyomgCSEAbRpFg_-ZbjU_wLmTAUrKHkKrDw3w==) on this important subject and was honored in 2016 with a law named "[The Frank R. Wolf Religious Freedom Act](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dgFlMoFbqddtisFSZZSVPLcb7qFL5I3k4I5wt6wZ4-H5IAHMv4TrAL5rol-erQA8myWcy8YM9j5F2oL5BoEwipkQIbpj_HvTIS-C93VjHGMdHjjFo5YvKvOggLm6K82bqNoihcbr-ud0wdp1u1kn7xk3Ko-Rc_g3daa7RrUIVNY2SY-2-PH1cKhqtONYADE8&c=UQ-69qWxdgB1zDicZX1dJPxxKfPnRHjkJ7YKpM1S50CUe8pKU8zxyw==&ch=BOUlZxf6YNA7BHNOqfyomgCSEAbRpFg_-ZbjU_wLmTAUrKHkKrDw3w==)".

Over the last month, we have celebrated across the 10th District, Easter, Passover and Ramadan. I was privileged to be able to attend services at many of our houses of worship and spoke with dedicated followers of many faiths. Our country was founded on the right to freely practice your faith while many across the world are persecuted, and in places like China, imprisoned or face death, for their beliefs. (Please see below my work as Co-Founder of the [Athenai Institute](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dgFlMoFbqddtisFSZZSVPLcb7qFL5I3k4I5wt6wZ4-H5IAHMv4TrABk-_LgTciOd2Dm_1HanxSnQu3K2E_6G_WT-hKmdVwdyqL72ldpPbNTgH2jG6rTKgz_QARhLMcBXSAwrZ2gdwHE=&c=UQ-69qWxdgB1zDicZX1dJPxxKfPnRHjkJ7YKpM1S50CUe8pKU8zxyw==&ch=BOUlZxf6YNA7BHNOqfyomgCSEAbRpFg_-ZbjU_wLmTAUrKHkKrDw3w==) to have our universities divest from China's human rights abuses).

Our churches, mosques and synagogues are the cornerstones of our communities. From the beginning of my campaign, i have focused on Country, Community and Common Sense.

As your representative in Washington, I promise to continue the fight for every individual's right to religious freedom and their ability to worship.

**This fight is personal to me.** My husband and I tried to grow our family years ago and experienced a miscarriage. I was still producing the pregnancy hormone, so we were presented with two choices: surgery or a shot that some consider a medical abortion. We chose the shot, and I am here today because of great healthcare.

body:
Data science and political science: a match made in heaven. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/546fac750fff/pushing-and-polling?e=10c1db3257)
---
| | [ ](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=0fd35548bb&e=10c1db3257)
---
|
---
| Friend,

The margin of error, percentage points, and sample size, oh my!

**If you’re an engaged voter,** political polls may be a familiar resource! Whether polls strike joy, fear, or curiosity into your heart, they are an **essential tool for voters to evaluate a race’s candidates** **and their current public standing. **

In short, political polling is a **method of data collection used by political scientists to find out what voters are thinking.** Individuals and organizations devise questions for voters to answer about their **voting intentions, political alignments, and sentiments about candidates.**

Despite the impact that political polls can have on public opinion, the **methods of data collection** used in political polls can **render their results hard to interpret.**

Suppose you are an engaged voter, looking to become more engaged, or want to evaluate your local elections more effectively. In that case, **political polls are a great place to start—and you don’t need a degree in data science to use them.**

So, **what should you be looking for** in political polls, and **what should you do** **with that information** once you have it? **Here are a few tips: **
---
|
## **Questions and Topic: What’s The Point?**

**The first and most important step** in reading political polls is figuring out a poll's purpose**—what are they measuring? **

Do they measure **which candidate voters think is the funniest?** How many voters will **show up for election day? **

Typically, political polls will use a simple **question-and-answer format.** The individual or organization conducting the poll will **send their survey questions to a set of respondents,** and their answers are collected and tabulated into **percentages and other statistics. **

One vital thing to consider when understanding the purpose of a political poll is **whether or not it is a hypothetical poll.** These questions will relate to **a voter's future intentions. **

**Take[this 2022 poll](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=109d5403f0&e=10c1db3257) from Deseret News and the Hinckley Institute.** The question posed here is, "In the upcoming Republican primary for the U.S. Senate race, **if the election was held today, who would you vote for?"**

This question measures **a hypothetical, a future intention.** These are the results you can use to **see which candidates lead the race.** Compared to earlier polls, voters can use these answers to **evaluate whether or not public opinion has changed** throughout a campaign.

When researching candidates and your local elections, look for polls that**answer real questions you have,** or tailor your search to polls that **ask questions you think are important. **
---
|
## **Sample Summary: Who Gets A Say?**
Once you understand the poll's purpose, **find out who's responses were used to achieve the results!** Whether you found a poll through a news outlet or read the result data, you'll usually**find the sample breakdown in the poll summary. **

Were the poll's answers**collected from a diverse set of respondents?** Are the answer's **more or less impactful** when answered by a **particular group of people? **

**In another[2022 poll](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=9a63f8f0c4&e=10c1db3257) from Deseret News and the Hinckley Institute,** surveyors asked respondents to **rate their approval of Sen. Mike Lee's work** in his two terms. Here, the poll surveyed **registered Utah voters across the political spectrum,** and overall, Sen. Lee garnered **a** **mere 42% job approval. **

Looking at the sample summary and the responses for each group **helps paint a complete data picture.** You can see which political demographics feel represented and which ones don't,**even within the same party. **
---
|
# **Good Polls, Bad Polls, Ugly Polls: Who should I believe? **
Political polls come in a few different flavors.

Some are sweet, **tailored to position one candidate as the best,** and some are salty, **compiled by an objective source to provide accurate results. **

When evaluating political polls as credible or useable, **there are a few variables to consider. **
---
| |
## **Internal or External: ****Was this poll paid for and promoted by a particular candidate, and is it for public use or campaign use?**
* Usually, **polls released by journalists and major publications are external,** while poll data coming **exclusively from one campaign is internal. **External polls, while public, are **not always objective.** Check who **paid or promoted the original survey** and if the individual or organization i**s on a campaign. **

## **The Margin of Error:** **If you were to repeat a poll using the same variables, how likely would the results be the same?**
* The margin of error is **a standard of measurement** used to **evaluate the reliability** of research data. This +/- percentage, **usually included in the poll summary,** shows researchers how likely a poll's results would match results of a **replicated survey. **

## **Confidence Level: How often would the margin of error be consistent in a replicated poll? **
* Data scientists use this measure **alongside the Margin of Error.** Together, they describe **the total reliability of a poll.** If the Margin of Error is +/- 3%, and the confidence level is 95%, **a replicated poll would show the same results, 95 out of 100 times within three percentage points. **

---
| As a voter, **you have numerous tools available to you** for evaluating your local candidates. This information is public, **and it’s yours to use. **

**Reading these statistics doesn't require a data science degree, and you don’t have to be a political scientist. **
