clean_body: Data science and political science: a match made in heaven. | | | | | | | Friend, The margin of error, percentage points, and sample size, oh my! If you’re an engaged voter, political polls may be a familiar resource! Whether polls strike joy, fear, or curiosity into your heart, they are an essential tool for voters to evaluate a race’s candidates and their current public standing. In short, political polling is a method of data collection used by political scientists to find out what voters are thinking. Individuals and organizations devise questions for voters to answer about their voting intentions, political alignments, and sentiments about candidates. Despite the impact that political polls can have on public opinion, the methods of data collection used in political polls can render their results hard to interpret. Suppose you are an engaged voter, looking to become more engaged, or want to evaluate your local elections more effectively. In that case, political polls are a great place to start—and you don’t need a degree in data science to use them. So, what should you be looking for in political polls, and what should you do with that information once you have it? Here are a few tips: | Questions and Topic: What’s The Point? The first and most important step in reading political polls is figuring out a poll's purpose—what are they measuring? Do they measure which candidate voters think is the funniest? How many voters will show up for election day? Typically, political polls will use a simple question-and-answer format. The individual or organization conducting the poll will send their survey questions to a set of respondents, and their answers are collected and tabulated into percentages and other statistics. One vital thing to consider when understanding the purpose of a political poll is whether or not it is a hypothetical poll. These questions will relate to a voter's future intentions. Take from Deseret News and the Hinckley Institute. The question posed here is, "In the upcoming Republican primary for the U.S. Senate race, if the election was held today, who would you vote for?" This question measures a hypothetical, a future intention. These are the results you can use to see which candidates lead the race. Compared to earlier polls, voters can use these answers to evaluate whether or not public opinion has changed throughout a campaign. When researching candidates and your local elections, look for polls thatanswer real questions you have, or tailor your search to polls that ask questions you think are important. | Sample Summary: Who Gets A Say? Once you understand the poll's purpose, find out who's responses were used to achieve the results! Whether you found a poll through a news outlet or read the result data, you'll usuallyfind the sample breakdown in the poll summary. Were the poll's answerscollected from a diverse set of respondents? Are the answer's more or less impactful when answered by a particular group of people? In another from Deseret News and the Hinckley Institute, surveyors asked respondents to rate their approval of Sen. Mike Lee's work in his two terms. Here, the poll surveyed registered Utah voters across the political spectrum, and overall, Sen. Lee garnered a mere 42% job approval. Looking at the sample summary and the responses for each group helps paint a complete data picture. You can see which political demographics feel represented and which ones don't,even within the same party. | Good Polls, Bad Polls, Ugly Polls: Who should I believe? Political polls come in a few different flavors. Some are sweet, tailored to position one candidate as the best, and some are salty, compiled by an objective source to provide accurate results. When evaluating political polls as credible or useable, there are a few variables to consider. | | Internal or External: Was this poll paid for and promoted by a particular candidate, and is it for public use or campaign use? Usually, polls released by journalists and major publications are external, while poll data coming exclusively from one campaign is internal. External polls, while public, are not always objective. Check who paid or promoted the original survey and if the individual or organization is on a campaign. The Margin of Error: If you were to repeat a poll using the same variables, how likely would the results be the same? The margin of error is a standard of measurement used to evaluate the reliability of research data. This +/- percentage, usually included in the poll summary, shows researchers how likely a poll's results would match results of a replicated survey. Confidence Level: How often would the margin of error be consistent in a replicated poll? Data scientists use this measure alongside the Margin of Error. Together, they describe the total reliability of a poll. If the Margin of Error is +/- 3%, and the confidence level is 95%, a replicated poll would show the same results, 95 out of 100 times within three percentage points. | As a voter, you have numerous tools available to you for evaluating your local candidates. name: Pro Life Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7im7b61vqg0fb4nhbmrcl3a1l11et5f78i5bgto_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uurjed5melhr4d36meqjecb5m9h34o5l6tin4dlks9p30sb0mmp6ad3kcapm2s77q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shhcoor9d9m6up74phmc2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5chim9pj3c9ge49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcr0oe114hh03ja2d91urt1fqres8c2ghmns63e8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cliecor2c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Bill McSwain for Governor: Second Volunteer Day of Action Is On Saturday!
May 03, 2022 Good morning, McSwain supporters!

Last weekend we held our first Day of Action to support Bill in Chester County! We had a lot of success asking for voters to consider voting for Bill McSwain. Here is a picture of us at a voter’s door!

name: Imani Oakley
subject: Roe v. Wade is going to be overturned
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oakley for Congress
body:
Peter —

Last night, Politico broke the story that the Supreme Court has voted down Roe v. Wade , gutting abortion rights.

I won’t lie to you, I’m angry as hell. This is a horrific attack on women — especially working class women of color — and a devastating reminder that our bodies aren’t our own in a country dominated by conservative men.

But let me be clear — this decision isn’t final yet, and if Roe is overturned, abortion should remain legal in New Jersey. So right now, our focus needs to be on protecting abortion access, supporting providers of reproductive healthcare, and lending our support to communities across the country where the GOP is set to ban abortion fully the moment Roe is overturned.

I’ve spent years standing up for abortion rights, fighting to secure safe, accessible reproductive care for women of color, and speaking out when abortion rights have come under attack. And that will never change. So today, I’m asking you to stand with me and commit to the fight for abortion rights — because the stakes just got so much higher.

With Roe gone, we’re going to see attacks on abortion rights like we haven’t seen in over 50 years. And Rep. Donald Payne Jr. couldn’t even be bothered to show up to the New Jersey Women’s March whose theme was protecting abortion rights.

If it wasn’t clear before, it’s clear now — we can’t afford to have do-nothing Democrats like Payne Jr. in Congress, refusing to take a stand and fight for abortion rights.

If he won’t even protect abortion rights in his own district, he can’t be trusted to do what needs to be done once Roe is overturned and the fight for abortion rights comes down to Congress and state legislators.

There’s no way around it: women — and working class women of color in particular — are going to die if this decision comes to pass. And a representative who doesn’t take that seriously isn’t just negligent, but dangerous.

Our primary is just over one month away, and this is our chance to replace Rep. Payne Jr. and vote for the proud, unapologetic progressive leadership that we need to protect abortion rights and fight for what’s right.

Thank you for standing with me.

— Imani

| | | **Join Amanda For a Central Pinellas Small Business Roundtable **
Hi Friend!

Calling all small business owners! We want to hear from you!

As the Community Conservative, endorsed by more mayors than anyone else in this race, Amanda has been campaigning across Pinellas County and hearing from business owners who are frustrated under the Biden Administration’s policies, and would like to connect with Pinellas County small business owners on ways to address their concerns.

We are so excited to announce that she will be at Joe's New York Style Pizzeria on Thursday, May 12th at 6 p.m. for a Central Pinellas small business roundtable. Amanda wants to hear from you!

Here are a few of the topics the discussion will focus on:
* **Small Business Job Providers**
* **How Congress can make a difference for small businesses**
* **How your Congress member can influence local politics for more favorable business conditions**
* **Hiring Struggles**
* **Fuel costs and it’s impact on your business **

**With the new Florida districting maps complete, FL-13 is now a favored flip for the GOP, with the district going all the way up to the Pasco line. ** Amanda has raised over $700,000. She is the only candidate on the ballot, having obtained all of the required petitions. Amanda has a great message of hard work and achieving the American Dream that we know will resonate with the new members in our district.

**Please sign up to be one of the small business owner panelists: Skylar@amandamakki.com

We hope to see you on Thursday, May 12th at 6 p.m.!**

Special thanks to Lazarro Wilmouth of Joe's New York Style Pizzeria for hosting!

Team Makki

P. S. If you’d like to host a meet and greet for Amanda, please e-mail Nancy@amandamakki.com

**** Friend, It's Teacher Appreciation Week, and the sad truth is that most teachers don't feel appreciated most of the time these days. When we truly appreciate teachers, we elect them to public office and empower them to put their experience to work in making education policy. When we truly appreciate teachers, we give them the opportunity to work together with parents to make sure schools are focused on what students need, not battlegrounds for political drama and conspiracy theories. 3. [Donate](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44874002/343466542/-1122467785?refcode=em20220503taw_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1NzI0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgzZWIyODA4LWZmY2EtZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VS4jUdPwsvuzykeZuaXer1awtt-V0k4EfybdrGFMVfM=) whatever you can so that we can all support more great educators in their campaigns and help them win more often.

Dear
Fellow American,

Perhaps
no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny
than Winston Churchill.

Not only
did he diagnose the threat of modern technology, but he also
spoke most effectively against the idea of socialism.

So, it
should come as no surprise to learn that so many "academics" and
activists are working to smear Churchill's legacy. That's why
studying an accurate account of his accomplishments is more
important than ever.

And right
now, you can do just that when you get a copy of one of Hillsdale
College's most popular online courses, "Winston Churchill and
Statesmanship," on DVD.

Thousands
of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its
release, and now you can add it to your personal library or give
it as a gift.

When you
view this close study of Churchill's words and deeds, you'll
learn timeless lessons that teach:

The
principles and virtues required for great statesmanship.
How
to deal with the threats and opportunities presented by modern
technology.
How
to confront the threat of socialism.
How
to serve the cause of our own country as it appears today.

I am so
excited to offer you this powerful DVD set. And it can be yours
today when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more to
Hillsdale College.

You can
reserve your copy using this secure link:

https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/

As a
student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill
will teach you more about this subject than many other books and
videos available today. And they will reveal profound lessons
that apply to today's urgent problems.

Only a
limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you'll
take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give
it as a gift-before they're gone.

You can
use this secure link to reserve your copy of "Winston Churchill
and Statesmanship" on DVD right now:

https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/

Please
enjoy this essential study of Churchill's words and deeds.

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director

Hillsdale

name: Derek Kilmer
subject: Demand the Senate pass the Women's Health Protection Act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
The urgency to codify reproductive rights into law is no longer abstract. If _Roe_ is struck down by the court, it will be life or death for many people nationwide.
As you may have seen, last night _Politico_ reported on a draft opinion from the Supreme Court that showed the court is on the verge of totally overturning _Roe v. Wade_.

Peter - the urgency to codify reproductive rights into law is no longer abstract. If _Roe_ is struck down by the court, it will be life or death for many people nationwide.

Last year, I proudly co-sponsored and voted to pass the Women's Health Protection Act to enshrine the right to choose under the law. It will prohibit bans, mandatory waiting periods, and other restrictions on a person's reproductive rights. And it will ensure everyone -- no matter where they live or their economic status -- has access to safe and legal reproductive care.

**[Today, I am calling on the Senate to pass the Women's Health Protection Act and codify the right to reproductive health care into law. Add your name today to stand with me and demand the Senate act in the urgency of this moment.](https://act.myngp.com/el/9bb__KlxtMdHhzpI2rmmfRpr4pfGlIDH_wFFeSis6VM=/KQQT-6lsOIfQ4YSnTmvMMKFD5tKe9560r9JzTcHIJOs=?ms=em22_220503_roerr_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&refcode=em22_220503_roerr_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&source=em22_220503_roerr_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220503_roerr_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

I've always been guided by the principle that health care decisions should remain between people and their doctors. Now more than ever, we have to stay vigilant in the fight for reproductive rights. Our civil rights are on the ballot in 2022 as we work to defend a pro-choice majority in Congress.

**[Today, please join me in adding your name to call on the Senate to codify reproductive rights into law>>](https://act.myngp.com/el/9bb__KlxtMdHhzpI2rmmfRpr4pfGlIDH_wFFeSis6VM=/KQQT-6lsOIfQ4YSnTmvMMKFD5tKe9560r9JzTcHIJOs=?ms=em22_220503_roerr_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&refcode=em22_220503_roerr_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&source=em22_220503_roerr_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220503_roerr_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

It's an honor to serve you,

Derek Kilmer

This is alarming -
For 50 years, _Roe v. Wade_ has protected a woman’s constitutional right to an abortion. But last night, _POLITICO_ reported that the Supreme Court is planning to overturn _Roe_.
Today, I think about my grandmother, who grew up before women had the right to vote. I think about my mother, who served on the board of her local Planned Parenthood and watched from the frontlines as _Roe v. Wade_ became law.
I think about the generations of women who came before me to secure these fundamental rights, and the generations that will come after. And while this news is devastating, I know one thing is for sure: We cannot go backward.
**The time to act is now. We must codify _Roe v. Wade_ and protect the right to an abortion.**

Republicans want to take this choice away. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44874635/343469738/-419434573?refcode=fl_em_fr_20220503emilyslistsplit_yc_allop_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDY3Njk1Yi0wMmNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZT-O4EPjVQRdpZkzNi-FrysBJO7FVQpL2btaf5_jXVE=)
---
Peter, The leaked draft revealing that the conservative Supreme Court majority has decided to overturn _Roe v Wade_ confirms what we’ve known for a while – Republicans are on a crusade to ban abortion across the country, overturning decades of precedence to strip millions of the essential freedom of choice. As a doctor, I’ve sat next to pregnant people and provided them with expert medical support to make a decision for their families, their future and their lives. Republicans want to take this choice away. Right now, it’s critical we support medical providers on the frontlines of abortion care for millions in need. It’s also critical we retire and replace elected officials who prioritize backtracking on 50 years of choice over sound science and other pressing policy work needed to support working families. **[Split a donation to my campaign and EMILY’s List to elect pro-choice women to the upcoming Congress who will fight to pass strong protections for our reproductive freedom.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44874636/343469739/-419434573?refcode=fl_em_fr_20220503emilyslistsplit_yc_allop_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDY3Njk1Yi0wMmNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZT-O4EPjVQRdpZkzNi-FrysBJO7FVQpL2btaf5_jXVE=)** I was proud to help lead the fight to guarantee Coloradans the right to choose by passing the Reproductive Health Equity Act just this year. The Supreme Court is preparing to overturn Roe v Wade and with it 49 years of precedent. Make no mistake: This is a direct attack on women. It is a partisan Supreme Court taking us back in time. And it will be the Republican party’s legacy.
The government has no business regulating women's health care. If Republicans will overturn Roe and allow states to ban abortion, what's next? Banning birth control?
Every woman I know has been dreading – fearing – that this day would come. But I bet my opponent Chuck Grassley is gleeful.

Derek,
I’m about to take the stage at the EMILY’s List gala where I’m going to speak before some of the most dedicated pro-choice Democratic women from across the country about the fight ahead of us. It couldn’t be happening at a more urgent time with the leaked draft on the SCOTUS decision regarding Roe v. Wade.
Tonight, I have one simple message: Now is the time to fight for women’s reproductive rights. Before I go into the details of my speech, will you split a donation right now between my campaign and CommonGood so we can keep our Democratic Senate majority and defend the right to choose? It’s never been more urgent. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20220503_CGVA_CCM]
For nearly 50 years, women in America have been able to control their own bodies and destinies thanks to the protection of Roe v. Wade. Then, Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell packed our courts with far-right judges who are carrying out the mission of a minority of anti-abortion extremists in this country.
Some of these extremists even support banning abortion when a woman’s life is at risk. It’s terrifying, and their attacks won’t just stop there.
If my opponent defeats me and Republicans flip the Senate, he’ll be an automatic vote for legislation banning abortion nationwide.
We can’t let that happen. We can’t let these extremists take away our rights. We must act now.
Women must be able to make their own decisions over their bodies. If you agree with me, then split a donation between my campaign and CommonGood right now so we can win this critical fight to protect women’s reproductive rights. Some of these extremists even support banning abortion when a woman’s life is at risk. It’s terrifying, and their attacks won’t just stop there. If my opponent defeats me and Republicans flip the Senate, he’ll be an automatic vote for legislation banning abortion nationwide. We can’t let that happen. We can’t let these extremists take away our rights. We must act now. Women must be able to make their own decisions over their bodies. If you agree with me, then split a donation between my campaign and CommonGood right now so we can win this critical fight to protect women’s reproductive rights. I hope that by the time I step off that stage, you’ll have made your position loud and clear. ¡La lucha sigue! The fight continues! Catherine (This is a sponsored send hosted by CommonGood. # THE AMERICA FIRST CANDIDATE
-SAVE AMERICA NOW-

###

**IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** Mike Blasi For Congress [info@mikeblasiforcongress.com](mailto:info@mikeblasiforcongress.com)

1-(470) 645-3724 **-MIKE BLASI ANNOUNCES SUSPENSION OF CAMPAIGN-**
**FREEHOLD, NJ** (on April 29, 2022) - Friday Mike Blasi, Republican candidate for Congress in New Jersey's 4th District announces that he will be suspending his campaign.

[CLICK HERE TO READ AS A PDF](https://MikeBlasiForCongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed3ab556783898df4fb1eb6a1&id=1d1cfb5532&e=5c7b109522)
Some time ago, I looked at my district and my eyes were opened to the damage an absentee representative can do. Chris Smith, who had in time past been a bulwark for many conservative principles, had become like a distant cousin. You know he's out there somewhere, but you never hear from him, you never see him, and he's never around when you need him. Over the years, I have seen our second amendment rights erode away, voting integrity become a joke, ideological smut being crammed down the throats of our children, and law and order begin to break down, all while government continued to bloat into the insatiable monster it has become.

And what has Chris Smith been doing about all this? Nothing. He has been noticeably silent on ALL of these issues. Even his once-strong pro-life record, which he built a 42 year career around, has begun to crack with his refusal to back the repeal of Obamacare. Apart from the “R” next to his name, Chris Smith is practically indistinguishable from a Democrat, and he continues to back Democrat policies like Biden's massive “infrastructure” bill.

My love for District 4 and commitment to unseating Chris Smith are what led me into this race. These reasons are also why I have made the difficult decision to suspend my congressional campaign. I want to see progress on the issues that I know matter to the people of this district. This race has never been about me. Having three candidates in the race guarantees Chris Smith an easy victory. As upsetting as this is, I will always do what is in the best interest of the people of District 4.

I owe a big THANK YOU to all of my campaign staff and volunteers that put in countless hours. I also want to thank my family, friends, and the great people of District 4 who supported me, and gave of their precious time and hard earned money to seeing this dream become a reality. You keep me going. Because this is NOT the end! I am still committed to working tirelessly with you, and everyone who believes, like me, that career politicians don't serve our best interest. That small business needs to thrive, and big government needs to go on a diet. That law enforcement should be given the tools, training, and support they need to provide for public safety. That the sacred right of the vote MUST be protected and above reproach. That parents should have school choice, and are THE authority in the raising and educating of their children.

I look forward to continuing this fight with you. Together we can, and we will, ensure District 4 lives up to the mantra of the state of NJ, Liberty and Prosperity!

God bless District 4, and God bless America! ###

body:
What can your next Texas Attorney General do about this abandonment of guaranteed reproductive rights? I can and will do all of the following... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jaworskifortexas/2022-13652998?e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | [ ](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=32c469e765&e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | , **We’ve never before been shown a preview of a SCOTUS opinion. The famously secretive Court goes to extreme measures to guarantee a closed circuit, but this leak, given the titanic issue in question — reversal of Roe vs. Wade — is explosive.**

What can I, as your next Texas Attorney General, do to address this shocking reversal, this abandonment of fifty years of guaranteed reproductive rights?
**I can and will do all of the following:**

**1)** I will initiate litigation in federal court to preserve a woman’s right to end an unwanted pregnancy pursuant to the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment;

**2)** I will initiate litigation in state court to preserve a woman’s right to end an unwanted pregnancy under the Texas Constitution;

**3)** I will pursue state court remedies to defeat SB8, the egregious law known as “The Heartbeat Act”;

**4)** I will issue an Attorney General opinion finding SB8 unconstitutional;

**5)** I will defeat “trigger laws” in state court; I will intervene in any case brought by vigilante claimants in Texas state court under SB8 and defend reproductive choice;

**6)** I will testify in the Texas Legislature for reproductive rights; and

**7)** I will tirelessly use my political capital to organize voters to elect legislators who support reproductive rights. You have my word.

If the life altering matter of reproductive rights is no longer protected by the United States Constitution and is indeed sent back to the fifty states to manage, then let’s make Texas a state, through its courts and its laws, that secures reproductive rights.

The May 24 runoff election is in three weeks. In-person early voting is available from May 16-May 20. The stakes could not be higher. I am respectfully asking for your vote.

**Joe Jaworski**
Candidate, Texas Attorney General

Friend,

Like many of you, I woke up devastated, but resolved to continue our fight for reproductive freedom.

In the wake of last night's horrifying news that the Supreme Court privately voted to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , I immediately thought of the life-changing experience a close friend shared with me. I asked her if she'd be willing to share it with you today:
> _"The year was 1970, just a month before abortion became legal in New York, but I couldn't wait. I was 18, young and alone. Through word of mouth, I found my way to two people performing illegal abortions in their apartment in another state. I got scared and tried to leave. The abortionist wouldn't let me go, possibly for fear of being arrested, and forced me to have the abortion in a dirty bathroom. It took another 18 years before I was emotionally ready to become a mom and have my daughter. Even then, I never got over it.
>
> I've kept this to myself for half a century, but I share my story today because people need to be reminded of how it was before Roe. **We must resolve to never return to the backrooms.** "_
My friend lived through this trauma the year before I was born. Two decades later, when I faced down an unplanned pregnancy of my own, I was able to _choose_ to have my oldest daughter with the support and resources of a local Planned Parenthood.

Thanks to the generations who fought for reproductive freedom before me, I had the right to choose and the support that every woman deserves when making such a consequential decision. Now, we must fight for the young women of today and tomorrow -- for their bodily autonomy, constitutional rights, and safety.

**Please, join me in this critical mission by pitching in today:**

clean_body: | = Friend, Like many of you, I woke up devastated, but resolved to continue our fight for reproductive freedom. In the wake of last night's horrifying news that the Supreme Court privately voted to overturn Roe v. Wade , I immediately thought of the life-changing experience a close friend shared with me. I asked her if she'd be willing to share it with you today: "The year was 1970, just a month before abortion became legal in New York, but I couldn't wait. I was 18, young and alone. Through word of mouth, I found my way to two people performing illegal abortions in their apartment in another state. I got scared and tried to leave. The abortionist wouldn't let me go, possibly for fear of being arrested, and forced me to have the abortion in a dirty bathroom. It took another 18 years before I was emotionally ready to become a mom and have my daughter. Even then, I never got over it. I've kept this to myself for half a century, but I share my story today because people need to be reminded of how it was before Roe. We must resolve to never return to the backrooms. " My friend lived through this trauma the year before I was born. Two decades later, when I faced down an unplanned pregnancy of my own, I was able to choose to have my oldest daughter with the support and resources of a local Planned Parenthood. Thanks to the generations who fought for reproductive freedom before me, I had the right to choose and the support that every woman deserves when making such a consequential decision. Now, we must fight for the young women of today and tomorrow -- for their bodily autonomy, constitutional rights, and safety. Peter. A leaked report that came out last night seems to show that the Supreme Court is prepared to overturn Roe v Wade despite the precedent it has set for the last 50 years. This is terrifying for women all over this country, and especially for those that live in Republican-controlled states. We must call on Congress to codify Roe v Wade NOW to protect this threat to women’s rights. We must also continue to do everything we can to elect pro-choice candidates to Congress that are committed to protecting the right to choose. | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44877082/343481525/-1792277655?refcode=220503-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmJmN2QzNi0wYWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sqPD5p6NHmpjR4hbe_457QJb4FxDASzaQkiAv6vpF9Y=) Peter. We must call on Congress to codify Roe v Wade NOW to protect this threat to women’s rights. We must also continue to do everything we can to elect pro-choice candidates to Congress that are committed to protecting the right to choose. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44877083/343481526/-1792277655?refcode=220503-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmJmN2QzNi0wYWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sqPD5p6NHmpjR4hbe_457QJb4FxDASzaQkiAv6vpF9Y=) That’s why we are proud to be working hard to elect Wiley to Congress. He’s a strong womens choice advocate that we need in DC. There are folks who have spent years working on plans of action for this moment. _And although we hate that this moment has come, we’re ready to fight it._ This decision is not yet final, but already, organizations around the country are mobilizing to help those who need reproductive healthcare. Please join us in the fight by sending a donation to those organizations to help them continue their critical work: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/national-network-of-abortion-funds-1](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44877084/343481527/214285230?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmJmN2QzNi0wYWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sqPD5p6NHmpjR4hbe_457QJb4FxDASzaQkiAv6vpF9Y=)** This is a decision that would harm women, cost lives, and set a dangerous new precedent. body:
The Roe decision is facing imminent danger from the Supreme Court's conservative majority.
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44878201/343486834/396464211?refcode=em-logo&refcode2=8a882b09-0ccb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&contactdata=fXrJRk3Pa34neegdF%2FiTBbqKSKG3O%2BHCCB0EQlZPh2JPGbVP64Pz%2BFPVIKB0sOee&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YTg4MmIwOS0wY2NiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=phP1qFULkWozLv05UvJS9734G8j8TS_xsemohjjaqG8=)
Last night's leaked release of Supreme Court Justice Alito’s draft majority decision overturning Roe v. Wade is a clarifying moment for Americans.
If this decision becomes final it will end the constitutional right to reproductive freedom, including access to safe and legal abortions — with immediate implications for women in states that have already passed "trigger laws" outlawing abortion if Roe is overturned.

subject: I will use every tool at my disposal to protect reproductive freedom.

body:
I am inviting every single candidate running for office in Los Angeles to join me in making this pledge:

Team —

Last night _Politico_ released a draft opinion that shows the Supreme Court is on the verge of overturning _Roe v. Wade_.

This is a devastating and heartbreaking moment for our country. The end of _Roe_ means the end of safe and legal abortion for millions of people, with low-income women of color being hit hardest. This rejection of decades of established law and precedent will mean life or death for many pregnant people across the country.

This has to be a call to action to fight for women's freedom and all of our freedoms — at the national level and at the local level. I've always fought to protect reproductive freedom, and I will do everything in my power to protect access to safe and legal abortions.

**Here's my promise: as mayor, I will use every single lever of power to ensure that Los Angeles is a safe haven for reproductive freedom.** And I'm calling on every single candidate running for mayor to join me in making this pledge.

This is why representation matters. Women need a voice. Women need choice. Women need freedom.

Thank you,

Karen

body:
| | | |
---
| Dear Friend,
This morning, Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen released the following joint statement to press regarding published reports that the U.S. Supreme Court may be prepared to overturn the Roe v. Wade decision:
---
|
---
| "We do not form core policy decisions based on leaked first drafts of Supreme Court opinions. Rather, we form them based on deeply-held personal beliefs and a commitment to Constitutional rule of law.
Thus, today, we join together as we have throughout our campaigns in our respect for the dignity of human life and our belief that decisions on non-federal issues are best left to the states. As the Framers of our government recognized, state government is where the appropriate balance on important issues can be most appropriately determined.
We both believe in and reaffirm the need to protect human life wherever and whenever possible. We also reaffirm our concurrence with Governor Baker's veto of the so-called "Roe Act" last year (a state law which expands access to late-term abortions), recognizing that extreme bill as a radical move too far by state legislators here in our state. We have both been consistent in these positions throughout our campaigns and our time in public office, and we remain solid in our beliefs now.
To the extent there is credibility to current reports sourced to the Supreme Court, we will await the Court's formal decision later this Spring and assess it at that time."
---
|
---
| Geoff and Leah can always be trusted to be on your side and to take a stand for what's right, including on controversial issues like abortion.
That's unlike Geoff's opponent, who when asked about abortion in his announcement piece in the Boston Globe, was quoted saying he's not really an activist on such issues and reaffirmed that he voted for Hillary Clinton in 2016.

Can Geoff and Leah count on you to stand with them?

---
| | Chelsea White- Hoglen is an activist and advocate with a focus on our Appalachia community. Here are a few reason she endorses Jay Carey for Congress:"I am proud to endorse [Jay Carey for Congress](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/86O29uwD2/c?w=hfd032NatY_RIUDPWs8CEHJ4Ct98lVIXKdZSqCQTBFE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL0pheUNhcmV5Rm9yQ29uZ3Jlc3M_) in the Democratic Primary for CD11.This is the first time I have ever made an endorsement in the Democratic Primary for WNC's Congressional District 11. Normally, I don't feel that any of the candidates adequately measure up to the type of person I am proud to vote for and associate my name with. This year, I feel differently after much deliberation and careful consideration of those who are running across the board and the ways that I have seen them show up over the last 1.5 years.So what's different about Jay? Why am I endorsing him over the other candidates in the race?1\. Authentic Organizing & Connection with the CommunityI met Jay in July of last year and have since seen him make an intentional effort to connect with the people of Western North Carolina as more than just a candidate. Immediately after Tropical Storm Fred hit, while I was organizing relief efforts in Cruso, Jay got in touch and asked how he could be of support. Driving over from Hendersonville sometimes multiple days in a row to do the dirty work in the muck and mud, organizing fundraisers in his community to spread the abundance into the community that had just been devastated, and following the lead of those who were directly impacted on the ground. Trying to be a genuine support to those of us struggling to recover from the disaster, rather than use the opportunity to leverage his campaign or as a photo op. The first reason that I am endorsing Jay Carey is because he has proven his character to me. His character drives me to believe that he's willing to do the hard work to build deep relationships and show up with integrity and authenticity that we deserve from those who represent us. 2\. Walking the WalkJay Carey is the only candidate that I have seen out of the six show up to fight for the issues that impact our community outside of his campaign for congress: from recovery efforts in Cruso to direct actions related to the climate crisis, to supporting BLM, to holding our local electeds accountable.I know that if Jay Carey doesn't win, he will continue to show up in all of these ways and to walk next to us, to speak alongside of the voices of those who are currently being silenced by people in power. The second reason that I am endorsing Jay Carey is because I trust that Jay will continue to walk the walk in the same way that he has shown me already. 3\. The Only REAL Progressive in the Primary that Understands the Bold Solutions that Our Rural Communities Want & DeserveThere's a false narrative that our rural neighbors will only support moderates but, from my experience personally knocking on thousands of doors conducting listening surveys and deep canvasses among our neighbors from Murphy to Marshall and everywhere in between, that's the exact opposite of what I have heard from folks. (See more from one of these surveys in my 2017 report "[No One's Ever Asked Me Before" here:](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/86O29uwD2/c?w=NBRbrVtDvBbrdj63OMTfecjlILtd9PwTPSLcTCDU0IQ.) name: Wendy Davis
subject: I was up all night
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Wendy For US
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wdfcemail?refcode=5/3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wdfcemail?refcode=5/3]

Millions of women across America are staring at their phones, computers and televisions in disbelief – Roe overturned?! By the summer, abortion will be illegal in more than half of our country?!
We were warned, but too many of us thought that only in a dystopian novel would a nation as strong as America let itself be thrown back a half a century. Rest assured, American women will NOT go back to a world with less freedom and more limited horizons for our daughters.
It is hard to put into words how deeply personal these issues are to women. Who should the decision about whether to become a parent really be up to? Do we want a committee of legislators with us in the gynecologist’s office? Is a Governor or the President the person you want making the decision for your family about protecting the life of your wife or your child?
My mother was born in 1926 and was a woman of deep and abiding faith, who read her King James bible most nights before bed. She was a registered nurse who trained in a Baptist hospital in the late 1940’s in South Carolina. In our family, we didn’t talk about sex, contraception or abortions, so you could have knocked me over with a feather in 1983 when my mother presented her firmly held opinion about abortion laws.
There was a TV news story about the tenth anniversary of Roe, and they were showing a protest in DC of people who wanted that decision overturned. “That would be the worst thing we could possibly do,” my mother declared. She proceeded to share the story of “the most heartbreaking thing” she had ever witnessed, when a young woman died in her emergency room from a back-alley abortion. She went on the say that if abortions were illegal again that rich families would still find a way to get them, and poor women would be at greatest risk of literally losing their lives and compounding their poverty.
My mother in one short conversation told me what I needed to understand – protecting women is about giving them real choices. Did that understanding of the realities of our world make my mom “pro-abortion?” Not for one second – she was pro-woman.
Photo of Wendy's mom in nurse outfit [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90302/images/LOD%20nurse.jpg]
The modern world is full of complex problems, and simplistic solutions are not the right answer. Outlawing abortions will NOT end abortions. It will lead to more women dying and more families in poverty.
We can’t reduce reproductive health issues to a bumper sticker without casting aside the humanity of women. Many of us know women who have suffered the anguish of wanting to have a baby and being unable to conceive. I can’t fathom how difficult it was for my biological mother to place me up for adoption. Most of us know a woman who faced an unplanned pregnancy, and our hearts ached for her painful analysis of all the factors that were a part of her decision-making. Think about the gut-wrenching agony of being told that carrying your child to term would risk the mother’s life. Now factor in domestic violence, economic instability, lack of insurance, lack of access to doctors, no family support structure – are you seeing that these issues get complicated?
Like my mother, I am a fierce advocate for women. As your Congresswoman, I will work every day to give families more, not fewer paths to progress. Common sense and every study show that the best way to reduce abortions is to prevent unplanned pregnancies. Let’s expand programs that reduce unplanned pregnancies. And I haven’t met a person yet who wants teenagers to get pregnant; let’s find a way to turn this broad agreement into concrete action.
Our nation is the only industrialized country on this planet where the rate of maternal mortality is increasing, and Georgia is the number two state on this dreadful list. Which of you are proponents of MORE women dying? It’s time to reverse this trend, not accelerate it.
Striking down Roe will awaken the generations of women who have taken their freedoms for granted. We won’t go back, and the next generation of our nation’s leaders will rise from this turmoil. You can count on me to support without reservation federal legislation that protects reproductive freedoms.
How will I honor my late mother this Mother’s Day? By living the faith that she raised me in – I will continue loving my neighbors – all of them – those who agree with me on these issues and those who will scream and call me everything but a child of God. And I will continue to work to move our communities forward by creating conditions that will help women and families thrive.

- Wendy

body:
I know you’re angry, and I am too.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44879587/343493238/-2143054902?refcode=em_fr_2022.05.03_b1_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjlkZWU4My0xMGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wjZIfAwavqxu0ltp_xdxctalgVq9uI67RN6RFJvsdUg=) Last night, we learned that the Supreme Court is prepared to end the constitutional right to an abortion by overturning _Roe v. Wade._

I know you’re angry, and I am too. I’m angry for my wife, for my daughters, and for the millions of Americans who could be left without abortion access if extreme-right legislatures so choose. This isn’t a distant reality – right now, 26 states are poised to move quickly to ban abortions once this decision is issued.

**But you don’t have to have daughters or a wife as a man to be outraged: reproductive rights are fundamental human rights, and everyone should be able to make healthcare decisions without politicians getting in the way.** And let’s be clear, overturning _Roe_ will not stop abortions – it would just prevent people from getting the safe healthcare they need.

There’s no time to waste. The Senate needs to wake up and act swiftly to codify _Roe._ And if they don’t, after I hold PA-17, you better believe that I’ll fight in Washington to protect abortion rights and to get it done.

**[This is a reminder of how much is on the line this November, so today, I’m asking for your support to help win this race. If you’re able, will you chip in to my campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44879588/343493239/-2143054902?refcode=em_fr_2022.05.03_b1_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjlkZWU4My0xMGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wjZIfAwavqxu0ltp_xdxctalgVq9uI67RN6RFJvsdUg=)**

Thank you for your support.

Let’s keep fighting,

Chris __ | | Chris Deluzio is a voting rights lawyer and Iraq war veteran running for Congress in Pennsylvania's 17th District. This isn’t a distant reality – right now, 26 states are poised to move quickly to ban abortions once this decision is issued. But you don’t have to have daughters or a wife as a man to be outraged: reproductive rights are fundamental human rights, and everyone should be able to make healthcare decisions without politicians getting in the way. And let’s be clear, overturning Roe will not stop abortions – it would just prevent people from getting the safe healthcare they need. There’s no time to waste. The Senate needs to wake up and act swiftly to codify Roe. Reproductive rights for women in this country could disappear overnight.
| ACCESS REPRODUCTIVE JUSTICE is a California-based non-profit organization that promotes the freedom and resources necessary for everyone to make empowered decisions about their sexual and reproductive health. [**You can learn more here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44879667/343493529/-1506040834?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDY3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTM3ZTBkNi0xMGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dMmok2w4ZDA10SL3fG_6vQGCvPs90RCF-jwGxI4QCWI=&emci=5d0675ac-37ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=8137e0d6-10cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=14505483)

Team –
_Roe v. Wade_ is under attack, and this time, it’s coming from the Supreme Court. _Politico_ obtained a draft of a majority opinion written by Supreme Court Justice Alito that would strike down _Roe v. Wade_. If true, reproductive rights for women in this country could disappear overnight. Now, more than ever, we need to stand up and protect women’s reproductive rights.
_“We now overrule those decisions and return that authority to the people and their elected representatives”_
This quote stood out to me. Politicians should not have a say over what anyone does with their own body. Decisions about reproductive health should be between a person and their doctor – not their government. **The Supreme Court’s decision to reject long settled precedent, and overturn Roe is beyond alarming and an unprecedented assault on reproductive rights. At this point, we have no choice: we must codify access to abortion, and with haste.**
This is an incredibly difficult time for folks across the country, and the best thing we can do now is rely on our communities. [**Access Reproductive Justice**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44879668/343493530/-1506040834?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDY3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTM3ZTBkNi0xMGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dMmok2w4ZDA10SL3fG_6vQGCvPs90RCF-jwGxI4QCWI=&emci=5d0675ac-37ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=8137e0d6-10cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=14505483) offers resources like informational hotlines in English and Spanish, as well as advocating for much-needed policy changes around reproductive healthcare.
You’ve heard me say it a hundred times, and I’ll say it again: One team. One fight. I’ve promised I’ll stand for reproductive healthcare, and when elected, I will never break that promise.
In solidarity,
Quaye

Fellow activist,

Late last night, Politico released a now-confirmed leaked draft of the Supreme Court’s opinion on the _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ case. If the draft is made the official determination of the Court, then _Roe v. Wade_ will be overturned. **For the first time in almost 50 years, states will have the power to totally ban abortions.**

And, while the opinion would not directly affect any other rulings, it doesn’t stop at abortion. **Justice Alito made a deliberate choice to also criticize decisions on gay marriage and even same-sex intimacy as being based on the same principle the majority voted to reject — threatening to overturn those and any similar rulings that establish bodily autonomy.**

**_While this is not yet an official ruling, and abortion is still legal_ , this ruling would mean the battle for reproductive rights and bodily autonomy would need to be fought in all 50 states.** In many states, there are already laws on the books that would go into effect and ban abortion immediately upon this decision. **_Pennsylvania is not one of those states, and we are ready to fight like hell to make sure it stays that way._**

There will be a front of combat against these draconian bans for every branch of government of every state.

**That means our state courts will be more crucial than ever to safeguarding our rights. But politicians and moneyed special interests are trying to undermine their independence and improperly influence judges in order to get cases decided in their favor.**

State courts need to be free from outside influences from special interests and politicians so they can deliver equal justice, and every person can receive a ruling that is independent, impartial, and fair.

Approximately 95 percent of all the legal cases in the U.S. are decided in state courts, which is why our fight to have them maintain their independence is more important than ever.

Here at the New Pennsylvania Project we are committed to being a leader in this fight and will continue keeping you informed of our important and critical work.

name: Jay Inslee
subject: Not for a second
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JAY INSLEE FOR WASHINGTON (D)
body:
Here in Washington state, we'll protect reproductive rights.

| Friend -- Not here. While I am governor, abortion will remain legal and accessible for all people in the state of Washington. As long as I have anything to say about it, we will never waver on the right of every person to access a safe and affordable abortion. But the draft opinion from the Supreme Court that was made public last night is a painful reminder that our rights remain fragile. Republicans have been working at every level, in every state, to undermine a woman's right to choose -- and Washington state is no exception. If the Supreme Court goes through with overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , state legislatures and governors are our last, and only, line of defense. Here in Washington, we have been able to ensure access to abortion care because of Democratic leadership and Democratic legislative majorities. Last night's news proves why we can never take abortion and reproductive health care rights for granted. While Republicans in other states chipped away at abortion access, we passed the _Affirm Washington Abortion Access Act_ to expand access and ban junk lawsuits against people seeking an abortion and their medical providers. We know that Republicans are doing everything they can to erode women's rights, but here in Washington, at every turn, our Democratic elected officials have blocked them. We should be angry -- as angry as we've ever been. But we shouldn't give up. After all, that's exactly what they're hoping we'll do. We should demand to know where every single candidate stands on access to abortion. And we should vote. I'm fighting right alongside you, no matter what state you're in, to demand justice. This is not the final battle. Very truly yours, Jay

---

| | I am absolutely devastated to hear that the Supreme Court has all but overturned the _Roe v. Wade_ decision. For decades, this 1973 court ruling provided protection for families to make the most intimate, personal, and important decisions of their lives. **I'm furious that the Supreme Court would consider striking down the constitutional right for a woman to choose whether or when to start a family.** As we know, this decision will not result in fewer abortions. name: Tim
subject: re: JD Vance & Josh Mandel on abortion
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tim Ryan for Ohio
body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=3572%2E3611125%2Ep7YbRC ][IMG]

Folks, I need to make sure you saw my email from last night
about the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade.

Today is Ohio’s primary election and the stakes of our battleground Senate
race have never been higher. Every single one of my GOP opponents supports
dangerous, restrictive anti-abortion laws.

JD Vance called pregnancy from rape “inconvenient” and tweeted that he
hoped the news of the Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade was “true.”

Josh Mandel wants Roe overturned, and even supports Ohio’s extreme
heartbeat legislation and other dangerous bills across the country that
would allow people to sue anyone who helps someone get an abortion.

It’s despicable and we can’t let them anywhere near the United States
Senate. Our only choice to protect reproductive rights is to win this race
and expand our Democratic Senate majority.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11879?t=1008&amount=25&akid=3572%2E3611125%2Ep7YbRC ]Our fight has never been more important. Please, if you can, make a
contribution to our campaign at this critical moment. Every dollar you
give will go toward winning the Senate majority and protecting this right.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11879?t=1009&amount=25&akid=3572%2E3611125%2Ep7YbRC ]Donate

Thanks,

Tim

---------- Forwarded message --------
From: Tim <[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11879?t=1010&amount=25&akid=3572%2E3611125%2Ep7YbRC ]info@e.timforoh.com>
Date: Mon, May 2, 2022
Subject: Roe v. Wade
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Hello,

Moments ago, the Supreme Court’s draft decision to overturn Roe v. Wade
was leaked. This is incredibly difficult news and I’m outraged.

Overturning Roe would be catastrophic for Ohio, where Republicans have
introduced one extreme proposal after another to ban abortion before most
women even know they're pregnant.

Our work has never been more important than right now. A 50/50 Senate has
failed to protect abortion for people across the country. From the
minority, Republicans abused the filibuster to block the Women’s Health
Protection Act that would have codified Roe.

50/50 is not enough. If we want to make an impact on the issues that
really matter, we must expand our Democratic majority—and that means we
must win this race.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11879?t=1011&amount=25&akid=3572%2E3611125%2Ep7YbRC ]I wouldn’t say this if I didn’t mean it: one of the most important
things you can do to fight for reproductive rights is make a donation to
this campaign. If we can flip this seat, we can expand the Democratic
majority and protect the right to an abortion.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/11879?t=1012&amount=25&akid=3572%2E3611125%2Ep7YbRC ]Donate

Mitch McConnell and Senate Republicans have made their plan clear all
along: pack the courts with right-wing judges, empower state legislatures
across the country to pass extreme, dangerous anti-abortion bills, and
overturn Roe.

We cannot let them get away with it.

Women and their families deserve the freedom to make the best decision for
themselves.

I know you’re angry. I am too. But let’s turn this anger into action.

Thank you,

Tim

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last night, news broke of a draft SCOTUS opinion that would overturn Roe
v. Wade.

It’s devastating and scary news. What we can do right now is state clearly
that abortion is health care and everyone should be free to receive
abortion care. Justice Democrats and our candidates will always fight for
abortion rights.

Today, we can also send support to local abortion funds, especially
organizations in states where abortion care will be, or is already,
restricted or banned as a result of GOP state governments or the
right-wing SCOTUS overturning Roe.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105593?refcode=em20220503-23156&t=1002&akid=23156%2E1203867%2E5FQLMR ]Can you split a contribution to 15 abortion funds across the country?
Each organization works to remove financial and logistical barriers to
abortion access and they need our support today.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105593?refcode=em20220503-23156&t=1003&akid=23156%2E1203867%2E5FQLMR ]Contribute

All 15 abortion funds are member organizations of the National Network of
Abortion Funds. Some of them work with clinics to help pay for abortion
care. Some of them offer support such as transportation, childcare,
translation, doula services, and somewhere to stay for people who need to
travel to get abortion care.

As the Supreme Court and the right-wing ramp up their attacks on abortion
rights, we must be there to support folks who need abortion care.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Eric Lynn for Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP24/1/93680/images/lynn-email-logo.png]
As you may have seen, friend, a staffer of the Supreme Court of the United States leaked the majority opinion for Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health, revealing that the majority of the Justices voted to overturn Roe v. Wade .

The leaked release of this decision has rightfully triggered panic across the country. For the past fifty years, the Roe decision has protected the right to choose for millions of Americans, including Floridians who have faced attacks on abortions for years.

But as a reminder: this information was just a leak. The Supreme Court has not yet overturned Roe v. Wade , meaning the right to choose is still protected and constitutional in all 50 states across the country. If you need an abortion or have an appointment to access reproductive care, you are still protected by the ruling of Roe until the official decision of Dobbs is released.

In the meantime, it's imperative we do everything to protect the right to abortion and women’s healthcare in Florida and beyond. Here are two steps you can take to demand that reproductive freedom is a choice.

| | Peter, The news has leaked in the form of a draft opinion written by Justice Alito that the Supreme Court is poised to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ and overturn the constitutional protection for the right to access an abortion and most forms of birth control. **I am outraged. But I'm not surprised.** For decades, we've endured cynical schemes to overturn _Roe_ and turn the clock back to the time when birth control was illegal and back-alley abortions were the only way woman could end their pregnancies – cruel legislation, anti-science propaganda, and outright abuse of the judicial confirmation process, like when Mitch McConnell stole a Supreme Court seat from Barack Obama and Merrick Garland. _Roe_ was decided when I was eight years old and I watched my mother celebrate after fighting with the National Organization of Women to make access to birth control and abortion safe and legal. Last night's news has me reeling for my daughter and the generations of women who grew up with the protection provided by _Roe v. Wade_. My heart goes out to the millions of Americans who could lose their fundamental right to access reproductive health care overnight in states with trigger laws. We need to be clear about a few things, Peter: First, last night's news is that a _draft opinion_ was leaked, and not that the Supreme Court has made an official ruling. For the time being, _Roe v. Wade_ is still the law of the land and access to abortion care is still legal. Next, we have to stand with women, abortion providers, and anyone else whose life is about to get harder when _Roe_ is overturned. Here in Oregon, we are already seeing people come from Texas to seek abortion care because here in Oregon, we protected that fundamental right to access an abortion in our state constitution. We need to make sure that we stand ready to help those who can't access these basic and critical health services until we can pass legislation in Congress modeled on what we have done in Oregon. **Lastly, reproductive rights are on the ballot this election.** Every politician running for office at every level of government needs to affirm their commitment to protecting access to the full spectrum of reproductive health care. If a politician can't abide by that, they need to go. You're either pro-choice, or you're not. You either stand with women, or you don't. We can no longer afford half-measures, compromises, or hopes that today's GOP in partnership with anti-choice organizations will ever respect a woman's right to access most forms of birth control and abortion. Not in the case of incest, not in the case of rape and not in the case of severe and fatal fetal abnormality. In the state legislature I fought for a woman's right to choose and voted to expand access to birth control.**That's why the Planned Parenthood Action Fund has endorsed me in this election.** Today I am standing firm in my commitment to them and to women everywhere that I will never turn my back on you. **We are not losing the right to access reproductive health care including safe, legal abortions without a fight. We can't afford to lose the House or the Senate to people who will take us back to the time when women died from back-alley abortions. We need to fight with everything we have and leave nothing on the table. Let's give 'em hell this election.** _Val_ |

Peter,

After years of holding our breath, the unthinkable is happening. **According to a leaked draft opinion, the Supreme Court intends to overturn Roe v. Wade.**
For nearly 50 years, Roe v. Wade has protected the right to abortion across the country. This landmark case put an end to countless, unnecessary deaths from unsafe abortions and returned agency and empowerment over one's own life and body.
Today, we organize to fight back against this potential catastrophic loss of Roe – and acknowledge that the people who will be most harmed by this sickening decision are those who are always caught in the middle of the GOP’s culture wars: Black, brown, and poor communities.
**But, Peter, while this decision is going to be a devastating blow, know this: Our fight for reproductive rights is FAR from over.**
I will continue to hold other state attorneys general accountable for their attempts to roll back reproductive rights. I will continue to urge Congress to codify Roe into law. _**I will ensure that New York is a safe haven for people who need abortions – I called for the creation of a New York abortion fund just a few months ago.**_ I will continue to do everything in my power to protect our reproductive rights – because we have made too much progress to go back now.
**Friend, I just made a donation to the National Network of Abortion Funds to keep our reproductive rights protected and ensure that we never regress to the days of unsafe back-alley abortions.[If you would like to join me in this fight, please click here to make your donation. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44881198/343500826/716289324?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk497-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzQxYWNiMS0xNGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YqHURoHRp38TnQQqhbmT3wZLrO4v-fK6gapPpAkzb8U=)**
Thank you for staying in this fight with me. Together, we WILL ensure that we have the same reproductive rights that our mothers and grandmothers were granted.

Letitia James

Peter, This news is not surprising, but it remains shocking.

According to a report last night from _POLITICO_ , the "Supreme Court has voted to overturn abortion rights" in a private vote among the justices that could become final in just a few short weeks.

As a physician of over two decades, I have sat with pregnant people making incredibly difficult decisions and seen firsthand the challenges and stigma people face in accessing abortions and reproductive health care. And I can tell you, in no uncertain terms, that if the draft opinion leaked last night becomes final and Roe v. Wade is overturned, pregnant people will lose their lives, their health, and their bodily autonomy.

Right now, **abortion is still legal**. But for many, it is already difficult to access abortion and reproductive health care. Local abortion funds play a critical role in helping pregnant people receive the care they need, and they need your support now more than ever. **[Will you join me in helping pregnant people make their own decisions about abortion? Chip in now to support over 80 abortion funds across the country.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44881421/343501851/-1348740862?refcode=em22_220503_roersp_fndt_gq_act_arkoosh_va_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220503_roersp_fndt_gq_act_arkoosh_va_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWI5YjM2NC0xNWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1aOsp3UCHsCpfMdIWuOCHXqV1bajqcOgyrDcNbqCtFo=)** Anti-abortion politicians have spent decades distorting the facts and outright lying to push an agenda that punishes pregnant people and the medical professionals who care for them. We've known this could be coming, but this cannot be the end of our fight. We must use our voices and our vote to speak out for abortion rights and reproductive freedom.

It's more urgent than ever that Congress not only codify _Roe v. Wade_ but also expand abortion access by making it available at no cost to anyone who needs or wants it. We must also expand access to the full range of reproductive health care, including making contraception available over the counter at no cost, because we know this assault on reproductive rights won't stop at abortion access.

Whether as a physician or leading Pennsylvania's third-largest county, I have never backed away from defending abortion care and reproductive freedom. This is central to the fight to defend science and truth. We must stand together for abortion care and demand action to protect it. And we must elect more people to office, especially women, who will make this a priority.

Our fight is far from over, and I won't back down from this fight until anyone who needs or wants an abortion can access it free from barriers and stigma. Today that means I'm supporting abortion funds that ensure abortion is accessible to pregnant people across the country. **[Join me in making sure pregnant people can receive the care they need. Chip in to help abortion funds provide the resources to make abortion accessible to all.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44881422/343501852/-1348740862?refcode=em22_220503_roersp_fndt_gq_act_arkoosh_va_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220503_roersp_fndt_gq_act_arkoosh_va_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWI5YjM2NC0xNWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1aOsp3UCHsCpfMdIWuOCHXqV1bajqcOgyrDcNbqCtFo=)** With determination, Val

clean_body: Will you join me in helping pregnant people make their own decisions about abortion? | Peter, This news is not surprising, but it remains shocking. According to a report last night from POLITICO , the "Supreme Court has voted to overturn abortion rights" in a private vote among the justices that could become final in just a few short weeks. As a physician of over two decades, I have sat with pregnant people making incredibly difficult decisions and seen firsthand the challenges and stigma people face in accessing abortions and reproductive health care. And I can tell you, in no uncertain terms, that if the draft opinion leaked last night becomes final and Roe v. Wade is overturned, pregnant people will lose their lives, their health, and their bodily autonomy. Right now, abortion is still legal. But for many, it is already difficult to access abortion and reproductive health care. Local abortion funds play a critical role in helping pregnant people receive the care they need, and they need your support now more than ever. = Anti-abortion politicians have spent decades distorting the facts and outright lying to push an agenda that punishes pregnant people and the medical professionals who care for them. We've known this could be coming, but this cannot be the end of our fight. We must use our voices and our vote to speak out for abortion rights and reproductive freedom. It's more urgent than ever that Congress not only codify Roe v. Wade but also expand abortion access by making it available at no cost to anyone who needs or wants it. We must also expand access to the full range of reproductive health care, including making contraception available over the counter at no cost, because we know this assault on reproductive rights won't stop at abortion access. Whether as a physician or leading Pennsylvania's third-largest county, I have never backed away from defending abortion care and reproductive freedom. This is central to the fight to defend science and truth. We must stand together for abortion care and demand action to protect it. And we must elect more people to office, especially women, who will make this a priority. Our fight is far from over, and I won't back down from this fight until anyone who needs or wants an abortion can access it free from barriers and stigma. Today that means I'm supporting abortion funds that ensure abortion is accessible to pregnant people across the country. = With determination, Val Val Arkoosh for U.S. Senate P.O. Wade_** , the 1973 landmark case that protects the right to choose and access abortion in the United States. If true, this would be a devastating blow to the rights of millions of women across America, taking our country backward by decades and allowing Republican-controlled states to implement extreme, draconian abortion bans — even in cases of rape or threat to the mother’s life. **This is exactly what NM-02’s current far-right representative, Yvette Herrell, wants.** She’s long called for SCOTUS to overturn _Roe_ and take away bodily autonomy from the people of New Mexico. See her tweets for yourself: | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44881513/343502163/-1662882334?_ga=2.40026978.1185550101.1651592975-463872011.1651592975&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZTdmYWFlNC0xNWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Su6ODglM_m-O7oEN2RkzpXy6SOIm4CrIZfRGLZAutqU=&emci=01487cdd-15cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=4e7faae4-15cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4482565)

Here in New Mexico, Democrats recently took action to repeal our state’s dormant 1969 statute that outlawed abortion with few exceptions, in an effort to ensure abortion would continue to be safe and legal in our state even if _Roe_ were repealed. We stood out as one of the only states in 2021 to pass legislation supporting abortion rights, while more than 100 anti-choice laws were introduced across the country.
**Now, if SCOTUS repeals _Roe_ , extreme abortion bans in Republican-controlled states like Texas will go into effect, making it all the more important we protect safe, legal abortion access here in New Mexico.**

subject: Roe v. Wade overturned and what it means for SC-01→
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Annie Andrews for Congress
body:
| I am extremely troubled by this news.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Standing up for life
body:
I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9925%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=S3NCTbUoOzPnxBdhkGNskA&sysid=1)
|
---
| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20293%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5iEuOYZyqgh2uneLngv2pg&sysid=1)[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20294%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2lWOKiyXok8NOgbkTyKA5w&sysid=1)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20205%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KiJc1uhrsmA6eq1TUppQAQ&sysid=1) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20206%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=II1JRqqavPAsh3WbosMB%2bQ&sysid=1) Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

body:
The Supreme Court has failed us, Peter.

If Roe v Wade is overturned, the trigger law that Tennessee Republicans put into place would ban abortion in the first and second trimesters. With a Republican supermajority ruling our state policy, the people of Tennessee are rightfully terrified of what is to come — a half-century guarantee of federal constitutional protections of abortion rights could come to an end.

Democrats at the Federal level have the power to protect abortion rights, but they have to eliminate the filibuster to do so. Senators Kyrsten Sinema and Joe Mancin are standing in the way.

Sign up below to call them and demand that they abolish the filibuster to protect the right to an abortion →

Call Senators Manchin and Sinema [https://tndp.org/roevwade/?refcode=EM_P_220503Roe_RR_BB_30DO180DC_5_G_N_PT]

We don’t have time to waste. Millions of Tennesseans will be affected if Roe v. Wade is overturned. Join us in fighting back by calling Senators Manchin and Sinema now.

In solidarity,

Brit Bender

body:

---
Peter,

The news about _Roe v. Wade_ from yesterday is astounding and horrifying. This isn't just an attack on anyone who can get pregnant, but an egregious attack on medical privacy and the right to make choices for our own bodies.

The right to an abortion has been the law of the land for almost 50 years. We must not go backwards.

Let me be clear: **As Governor of Oregon, I will always defend reproductive rights. That is a promise.**

As your Speaker, I made sure that access to reproductive health care is enshrined in our laws. And no matter what happens at the U.S. Supreme Court – abortion is, and always will be, legal in Oregon.

No matter what happens on the national stage.

No matter what far-right activists have to say.

body:
