Last night, like so many others, I got a message from a friend asking if the news was true with a link to a story in Politico about a draft opinion overturning Roe v. Wade and Planned Parenthood v. Casey — and so much more. Today, the Supreme Court confirmed the draft opinion is real — although not yet the official opinion of the Court.
This is a day that we have heard might come for as long as I can remember. A lot of people didn’t believe it. And a lot of people still may not believe what it will mean, or know yet all that is at stake in overturning the rights to privacy and autonomy that Roe represents. What we have seen in the draft opinion, though, is as radical as it gets.
Whatever happens next in the Supreme Court, we know we cannot rely solely on the courts to protect the autonomy, dignity, and privacy of all Americans.
We have to elect people who will do so.
And we can. Last fall, the House passed the Women’s Health Protection Act (WHPA), legislation to make Roe v. Wade the law of the land in all 50 states. The bill has yet to pass the Senate — but we can’t give up the fight to pass it in both chambers and get it to President Biden’s desk. And we can, and must, do more than that.
I was proud to cast my vote for WHPA, carrying on the work of the many Texas women who have fought so hard for Roe and all it represents. And I will continue to fight in every way I can for the rights to abortion access, reproductive health care, and reproductive justice.
But to see WHPA become law, and remain law, we have to win elections. Starting with the elections going on right now: the 2022 midterms. We must vote as though our most cherished and fundamental freedoms are at stake, as though our lives are at stake. Because they are.
For months, many have said that the 2022 midterm elections will be an uphill battle for Democrats — that history and events make it hard to hold the House and the Senate. And I don’t need to tell you, it’s not just about Congress. It is about state legislatures and state-wide offices across the country, especially here in Texas.
There is no doubt the 2022 elections will be a hard battle. Last night’s news reminds us that these elections are ones we just can’t lose. It will take every single one of us participating in all the ways we can to make sure we don’t. But I am not giving up hope, and I’m not giving up the fight. Neither is an option.
Together, we can do anything,

Hey Peter,

I'm sure you've heard by now that the draft of the majority opinion in Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health SCOTUS case was leaked, and if this draft holds, this ruling will cause the imminent overturning of Roe v. Wade and the fundamental right for people to choose.

We're here to remind you that abortion has not yet been outlawed, and that means the right to abortion is still fundamentally protected in all 50 states . But sadly, we know the minute that Roe v. Wade is overturned, rural areas are going to be hit the hardest with restrictions.

Rural communities continue to remain under attack by shameless Republicans, and our team is dedicated to fighting for safe, legal, and accessible abortion for all rural folks.

But, we can't do this alone. If you are able to, please consider sending a donation to the Midwest Access Coalition , an abortion fund dedicated to providing the resources needed for midwesterners to access abortion care. Please click here to donate. [https://midwestaccesscoalition.org/pages/donate]

After the imminent overturning of Roe , it will be on state legislatures across the country to protect this right for all Americans. That's why our team will always be committed to electing pro-choice candidates who advocate for the rural places we call home. Thank you for being with us and the people of the Midwest.

In this together,

The URD Executive Team

I’m overwhelmed. I know first hand that the Supreme Court striking down Roe v. Wade is a life and death matter. I had an ectopic pregnancy in 2021.

With my husband and doctors at my side, I made the difficult, necessary decision to abort the pregnancy. It was my only hope to continue living and ultimately be in the joyful position I am today, pregnant with my daughter.

I felt tragedy and fear at every corner, grieving the miscarriage we had already suffered, and paying thousands of dollars out-of-pocket for proper treatment.

And yet, despite the pain and horrific trauma of this experience, I am one of the fortunate. I had access to doctors, health insurance, and a supportive partner who respects my right to control my own body — and I had the legal right to determine my own destiny.

name: Peter Welch
subject: An end to Roe
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
We must fight to enshrine the right to an abortion. We must act.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=340%2E61531%2EI-SkT0)
Hello,
For nearly five decades now, _Roe v. Wade_ has been the law of the land. The constitutional right to an abortion has helped make it possible for folks to shape their own futures, for families to decide how and when they grow, and for more people to have equity of opportunity.
Now, with a draft ruling leaked, it’s clear the the Supreme Court is ready to end the right to abortion and overturn Roe.
Congress must act. In the House, we passed the Women’s Health Protection Act, which would codify Roe into law nationwide. But Senate Republicans filibustered it. To defend abortion rights in every state, we must abolish the filibuster.
[**We need folks like you to take action right away. If you agree that we should abolish the filibuster and codify Roe, add your name.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-right-abortion/?source=em_20220503_p_p_roe&t=3&akid=340%2E61531%2EI-SkT0)
The Women’s Health Protection Act would protect the right to choose no matter what the Supreme Court decides.
When _Roe v. Wade_ falls, it will jeopardize the health of millions. And we know who will be harmed the most: people of color, people with disabilities, young people, immigrants, and those struggling to make ends meet.
As Senator, I will vote to end the filibuster to ensure every person in America has the right to an abortion.
[**Are you with me? Add your name to tell the Senate to codify Roe right away.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-protect-right-abortion/?source=em_20220503_p_p_roe&t=4&akid=340%2E61531%2EI-SkT0)
Together,
Peter

DeSantis and Republicans just signed one of the most restrictive anti-abortion laws in the country into law — and now, this SCOTUS decision has given them the greenlight to keep eroding the rights of Floridians.
And Jimmy Patronis’ reaction to all of this? He’s over the moon. Just this morning, he called Roe “a travesty” and said it should be overturned.
Patronis wants to control women. He wants to take your rights away. He doesn’t believe in personal privacy. He doesn’t think you’re smart enough to make your own decisions.
So much for the “Free State of Florida.”
We can’t let someone like Patronis continue to hold one of only FOUR statewide offices and wield power over our multi-billion budget.
Unlike Patronis, I’m committed to fighting back against this hyper-partisan agenda and working on the issues that matter to Floridians, like taking bold action to lower property insurance rates, addressing Florida’s skyrocketing cost of living, building more affordable housing, and helping Floridians buy homes.
If you’re ready to take action and take back Florida, please click here to learn more about our campaign. [https://www.adamforflorida.com/]
— Adam Hattersley

name: Charles Booker
subject: Roe v. Wade
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

This is serious,
Peter.

Late last night, news broke from a leaked Supreme Court opinion that Roe
v. Wade will be overturned as early as this month.

This draft opinion confirms our worst fears. In a radical act of
government overreach, the conservative majority of the United States
Supreme Court has all but confirmed that it intends to overturn decades of
settled legal precedent, which would deny millions of Americans their
agency, humanity, life-saving healthcare, and reproductive freedom.

I want to make my stance clear: Everyone deserves access to quality
healthcare and privacy to make deeply personal healthcare decisions with
their doctors. That includes medically necessary and often life-saving
procedures like abortion.

We can’t underestimate the urgency of this moment. If action isn’t taken
soon, abortion access will disappear all across the country — including in
Kentucky, where we are already fighting a law that would effectively ban
abortions in our Commonwealth.

The United States Supreme Court has tacitly agreed that the death of
millions of women — our daughters, our mothers, our loved ones — is not
too high a cost to pay to advance their radical, dangerous, and shameful
political agenda. It is absolutely critical that the Senate Majority show
the leadership to abolish the filibuster now, and codify the protections
of Roe v. Wade into law.

But here’s the thing,
Peter. The reality is that because
of senators like Rand Paul, it’s unlikely we’ll get the votes to take
action.

This is why we’re running against Rand Paul who has consistently upheld an
anti-woman, anti-family agenda and voted against the protections we need
to defend reproductive rights. This is why it’s so critical we expand our
Senate majority and end the destructive filibuster that has blocked so
many opportunities to protect abortion access in our country. And this is
why I’m reaching out to you, to ask for your support,
Peter.

I won’t stop fighting until Roe v. Wade is codified into law. But we must
expand the Senate majority to ensure that happens. The only way we’re
going to defeat Rand Paul, expand the Senate, and codify Roe v. Wade is if
we work together for the next 188 days up until Election Day.

No matter what, we won’t back down. Together, we will fight to make sure
everyone has the freedom to make deeply personal choices about their
healthcare and their lives.

In solidarity,

Charles

name: Greg Stanton
subject: My thoughts -- Roe v. Wade
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Stanton for Congress
body:
Dear friend,
It's a moment many of us feared would happen, but is still stunning when it becomes reality: The Supreme Court is set to overturn _Roe v. Wade _-- reversing the Court's recognition for nearly 50 years that having an abortion is a fundamental right.
In states across the country, the far-right is pushing to criminalize women who choose to have an abortion as well as doctors who provide them. Here in Arizona, Governor Ducey signed a cruel law that provides no exception for women who have been the victims of rape or incest. That's shameful.
This is the first time in our nation's history the Supreme Court will repeal a fundamental right, and Justice Alito's draft opinion leaves the door open to repealing more fundamental rights. It takes aim at Substantive Due Process altogether -- specifically jeopardizing the right to contraception, interracial marriage, and same-sex marriage.
Make no mistake: These rights are on the ballot this year. My opponents have made clear they support overturning _Roe_ and the Supreme Court justices who are actively taking us back to the 1950s.
In Congress, I voted to pass the Women's Health Protection Act to codify in federal statute the right to an abortion. And I've called on the Senate to end the filibuster on this monumental bill and send it to the President's desk.
I'll never stop fighting to protect abortion rights and the rights of women to make their own health care decisions.
There's a long road and a lot of work ahead of us. I'm ready.
\-- Greg

clean_body: I need to know if you’re with me in this fight, Peter. | | | | | Peter, Abortion is health care and a basic human right. But with the draft decision that leaked last night, the Supreme Court is poised to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is egregious, and it’s time for all of us to mobilize to protect the right to an abortion both here in Michigan and across the country. Right now, abortion is still legal — and we must fight to keep it that way. I don’t know about you, but I am ready for battle. We can call on the Senate to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act, which has already passed the House. We MUST end the filibuster so we can actually codify Roe into law. And we can act, right now, to help those who need an abortion across the country secure the resources they need. Here in Michigan, abortion will be restricted severly once the GOP – and the most conservative Supreme Court we’ve seen in our lifetimes — succeeds in overturning Roe. I will always stand for reproductive rights for all and defend abortion providers. All people deserve the right to an abortion, and providers must be able to provide this essential service safely. clean_body: Despite the news from SCOTUS last night, there is still a fire within us to fight for change. | | | Peter, We can’t count on the Supreme Court to protect our constitutional right to abortion. We need strong advocates in Congress to fight to codify Roe v. Wade now. Henry Cuellar was the only Democrat to vote with Republicans against codifying Roe v. Wade. Jessica will always stand for our health care and the right to choose. In 21 days, Cuellar and Jessica will face off in the Democratic runoff. With the future abortion rights on the line in Texas and nationally, we need a progressive champion in Congress like Jessica who will fight to codify Roe v. Wade by passing legislation to ensure that all people have unfettered access to abortion care, and who will repeal the Hyde Amendment to make abortion more affordable and accessible. While this is a dark time, we cannot despair. We have to fight for reproductive justice once and for all. But as long as anti-choice Democrats like Henry Cuellar remain in power, abortion rights will remain on the chopping block. His anti-choice record speaks for himself and we’re done with politicians like Cuellar legislating against our control of our own bodies. Let’s do this, Team Cisneros | To give by check: PO Box 660 Laredo, TX 78042

I’ve been clear about being pro-choice since day one.

According to a new report in _POLITICO_ , the Supreme Court is on the brink of overturning _Roe v. Wade_ — eliminating a woman’s right to choose. _It’s clearer now than ever before. There is one way to ensure we protect abortion rights in Pennsylvania — winning this Governor’s race._ **Please, will you donate $5 or whatever feels right to you in this moment to support our campaign? We cannot afford to elect a Republican Governor — because they won’t hesitate to take us backward.** **[joshshapiro.org/defendabortion](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44884511/343518157/1606389312?refcode=email_050322_fulllistreactroeoverturned&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGY2ZGEzMi0yMGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KqB3VHizrKCCi5vXrmwPOHcmlYCclUS67wASUoP4T7Q=)** I’ve never held back from stating the facts — but the stakes of this election could not be higher. A woman’s right to choose and make decisions over her own body is on the ballot in Pennsylvania. For nearly 50 years, _Roe v. Wade_ has been the law of the land — protecting women’s right to choose and reproductive health. But that right is under attack — and it will be up to each and every state to determine whether the women who reside there can have an abortion. **That is a heavy sentence to write, but it’s true. It is going to be up to the states to protect the right to choose — and we must make sure abortion stays legal and accessible in Pennsylvania.** I’ve been clear about being pro-choice since day one. As the People’s Attorney General, I took on the Trump Administration in federal court to protect access to contraception, won an injunction against the “gag rule,” and filed an amicus brief in support of the U.S. Department of Justice’s challenge to Texas’ early-term abortion ban. **As Governor, I will protect a woman’s right to choose. But first, we need to win this competitive race — because our GOP opponents all say they want to ban abortion in Pennsylvania.** **[Can you donate right now to help defend abortion rights in Pennsylvania?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44884512/343518158/1606389312?refcode=email_050322_fulllistreactroeoverturned&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGY2ZGEzMi0yMGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KqB3VHizrKCCi5vXrmwPOHcmlYCclUS67wASUoP4T7Q=)** This is a tough moment for many of us — and I am thinking especially of every woman who’s faced the choice the Supreme Court is now threatening. But together, we can ensure that abortion remains safe, legal, and accessible in Pennsylvania — and we will. Sincerely, Josh Shapiro **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** ****

name: Candace Hollingsworth
subject: Freedom must include reproductive freedom
body:
It would be a catastrophic failure for the Roe v. Wade decision to be overturned. Yet, if that becomes our reality, we must have leadership with the courage to stand in their truth and be driven by that truth and their values to make our lives better. | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zJ7b5wNyzKPLhTo-AgqfOTj9hmS-8LvnA8qY7ch-DzujPlp7IzPa2qCQOcgD0yhMtXFmmt-caIOecB6PCfd-Gkg2OB28htmbKLNCXfBTtJn8W8MtYCTKxpUYKES7oL222jVD9ByKDGoxwwREg4ITKggsEdkt7O4HGPSrv5k-mmvUYrG98VVQk6w023i-zmf_YfnlghrMIsBgwBhocqXflWhHTLv7S-behCS039vsOudIscDvTmrchyfn-cljS_ePGULdajVjHJFdUKCvCNSTWqLfytbdmk4HN32Rg4Y2FXj63x4LBKUOIBeVYu5iQRqsI/3lq/c2BD0B3uRGmeD2lCalLFrQ/h0/7KnFbWZRkxvR2TvV18KWvmbQeBvWxaPwQHJFxKQbnQE)

Friends, I worked as a counselor to women seeking abortion care at the same clinic that helped me just years before. I know my path in life would be drastically different without access to abortion and reproductive health services. Women like me are part of an undisclosed sisterhood and my heart aches for us and the many women we have yet to know. At our clinic, I held women's hands and wiped tears, and there's a woman who held mine. I witnessed time and time again that the right to choose, and choose safely, keeps women alive. **The United States should stand as a beacon of hope for freedom and that includes -- unequivocally -- reproductive freedom.** It would be a catastrophic failure for the _Roe v. Wade_ decision to be overturned. Yet, if that becomes our reality, we must have leadership with the courage to stand in their truth and be driven by that truth and their values to make our lives better. The only person who should be empowered to decide is the woman who inhabits the body. I know that and Doug knows that, too. Doug and I have demonstrated courage time and again throughout our lives, and we will continue to do that as Maryland's next Governor and Lieutenant Governor. When I say I will carry your voices with me to Annapolis, I mean it. **Help us show what Maryland is made of.** Thank you, Candace Hollingsworth

Yet, if that becomes our reality, we must have leadership with the courage to stand in their truth and be driven by that truth and their values to make our lives better. | | Friends, I worked as a counselor to women seeking abortion care at the same clinic that helped me just years before. I know my path in life would be drastically different without access to abortion and reproductive health services. Women like me are part of an undisclosed sisterhood and my heart aches for us and the many women we have yet to know. At our clinic, I held women's hands and wiped tears, and there's a woman who held mine. I witnessed time and time again that the right to choose, and choose safely, keeps women alive. The United States should stand as a beacon of hope for freedom and that includes -- unequivocally -- reproductive freedom. It would be a catastrophic failure for the Roe v. Wade decision to be overturned. Yet, if that becomes our reality, we must have leadership with the courage to stand in their truth and be driven by that truth and their values to make our lives better. The only person who should be empowered to decide is the woman who inhabits the body. I know that and Doug knows that, too. Doug and I have demonstrated courage time and again throughout our lives, and we will continue to do that as Maryland's next Governor and Lieutenant Governor. When I say I will carry your voices with me to Annapolis, I mean it. Help us show what Maryland is made of. Friends,

When the news broke last night, there were and are still not enough words to describe my anger, shock, and grief at this moment.

After nearly 50 years, the Supreme Court is poised to overturn the landmark ruling of _Roe v. Wade_ – this means that our right to choose has been overturned by a partisan Supreme Court, leaving access to safe and legal abortions up to state governments and legislatures.

In 2020, Bryan Steil joined three other Wisconsin Republicans in signing a legal brief asking the Supreme Court to consider overturning _Roe v. Wade_. As millions of people are fearing for the future, one thing is certain: We cannot trust him to protect our autonomy.

**I have always and will always support the right to choose, and this November, I'll take that fight to Congress on behalf of any Wisconsinite needing abortion services.**

**[I ask that you split a donation between my campaign and Planned Parenthood, one of the pillars of reproductive healthcare and advocacy across the country. The Supreme Court is making the wrong decision and this will have consequences for millions of people in our state and across the country, but we cannot sit by and let this happen. Democrats must do everything they can to codify abortion rights immediately.

Republicans have been waiting for this moment for decades, but **that doesn't mean it's over.** We cannot and will not stop fighting. I'm taking this fight to Congress, but there are many more wonderful pro-choice candidates joining the fight at all levels of state and national office. This is a dark time, but it will not last.

| Peter,

Thank you for your grassroots support! You always show up when we need it most, so I'm going to ask you to show up once more right now–but this time not for our campaign.

Instead, I'm asking you to step up for Planned Parenthood and the countless Americans whose rights are under attack.

As you’ve likely heard, a draft opinion released last night from the Supreme Court shows that _Roe v. Wade_ is about to be overturned, along with over 50 years of precedent. **Let’s be clear:** this would endanger lives and trample rights, and it would be out of touch with how the majority of Americans feel about abortion.

I am writing to you today to ask for your help fighting back against this potentially dangerous decision. We need to come together to protect women’s health care and reproductive freedom, including access to abortion. In Congress, I will support legislation to codify _Roe v. Wade_. Until then, I am asking if you will please make a contribution to Planned Parenthood today, one of the largest reproductive healthcare providers in the country.

Here’s how I'm fighting back.
#
Just checking in, Peter.
I know it’s been a tough night and a long day as we all wrap our heads around reports about the Supreme Court planning to overturn Roe v. Wade. I want you to know that I am doing everything I can to protect Roe v. Wade and the right to abortion–but I need your help.
I am talking to anyone and everyone in the Senate to build support for legislation to codify Roe v. Wade. Congress has got to take action–which I’ve been pushing to do with my bill, the Women’s Health Protection Act. We need to build support, and that’s what I’m working on.
**But to put it simply, we need to protect pro-choice Democrats in the Senate in November–and elect more of us–to secure the right to abortion once and for all. **
**[That’s where you come in – I’m up for reelection this year and I need your support as I continue the fight to protect reproductive rights. **These are the stakes.**

In a leaked draft opinion from last night, we saw the news that the Supreme Court will move to strip away federal constitutional protections for abortion rights. **This is appalling.**

In the majority opinion, Justice Samuel Alito stood against a woman’s fundamental rights to choice and wrote "We hold that _Roe and Casey_ must be overruled." **This is unacceptable.**

**Let's be clear – safe and equal access to abortion _is_ health care, and _everyone_ deserves equitable access to the care they need.** But we see now we cannot depend on our Trump nominated Supreme Court majority to protect healthcare access for millions across this country, so it's down to us.

Flipping this Senate seat blue is the last chance we have to save Roe. In the House, I voted to put Roe into law, I voted 100% pro-choice, and you know I'll be doing the same in the Senate.

We are now only two weeks away from the Primary, and the Supreme Court just raised the stakes of our race. It's not just about who can win on May 17th, it's about who can win on November 8th, and I've proven, _three consecutive times_ , that I'm the candidate to do just that.

| | Friend, Last night, a draft ruling confirmed what we’ve feared: The Supreme Court’s far-right majority is set to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , allowing states across the country to outlaw abortion. **This decision is horrific, heartbreaking, and dangerous. We will not accept it.** For the past 50 years, because of _Roe v. Wade_ , women in our country have had autonomy over their bodies and their futures. If Congress does not act to protect _Roe v. Wade_ , women across this country will have fewer rights than their mothers and grandmothers for the first time in history. **And right now, it’s crucial to remember that abortion is still legal in the United States.** Though we already know the likely outcome, the final ruling will not come until June. **If you need abortion care right now, it’s still your right to receive it. ** **** Once this decision goes into effect, the right to abortion care will be up to states to decide. It’s estimated that 26 states will likely ban abortion, and more will drastically restrict access to abortion care through new Republican-led legislation. The right to bodily autonomy should never be up for debate. The right to access abortion care should have never been up for debate. [Act now: Urge your senators to protect abortion rights by writing _Roe v. Wade_ into federal law through the Women’s Health Protect Act, so anyone can access abortion care — no matter their zip code.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44884800/343519770/-1442862440?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2FjODJmOS0yMWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dfbMh4jPFKF5n2MavUHm55HKJ4NPArFsk8w3DeD-9tA=&emci=0cc2d800-0acb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=e7ac82f9-21cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172) Young people across this country have worked tirelessly to elect Democratic leaders who promised to represent us into office, resulting in a Democratic trifecta. Now, they need to use the power of the offices we’ve elected them to and combat the draconian, anti-choice laws pushed forward by Republicans. For decades, Republicans have worked to bring the fight against abortion back to the Supreme Court. **Let’s make one thing clear: This draft decision from SCOTUS is the result of a decades-long Republican scheme to ban all abortions without exceptions.** Our representatives have sat on the sidelines and watched as abortion rights have been attacked. Now is the time for them to act — Congress must codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law now. **And if we need to abolish the filibuster to get this through the Senate, then it’s time for that, too.** The fight for reproductive justice is a fight for health care, gender, and racial justice. By failing to protect the right to an abortion, Congress has failed to protect Black and Indigenous people of color, women, trans and gender non-conforming folks, low-income, and young people. It’s time for our representatives to act on their promises. **Hold Congress accountable by ensuring they codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law through the WHPA, allowing all of us to make our own decisions for our bodies, and our futures. ** | [Write your senators](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44884801/343519771/-1039643449?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2FjODJmOS0yMWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dfbMh4jPFKF5n2MavUHm55HKJ4NPArFsk8w3DeD-9tA=&emci=0cc2d800-0acb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=e7ac82f9-21cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172 "CTA Button")

clean_body: | | Friend, Last night, a draft ruling confirmed what we’ve feared: The Supreme Court’s far-right majority is set to overturn Roe v. Wade , allowing states across the country to outlaw abortion. This decision is horrific, heartbreaking, and dangerous. We will not accept it. For the past 50 years, because of Roe v. Wade , women in our country have had autonomy over their bodies and their futures. If Congress does not act to protect Roe v. Wade , women across this country will have fewer rights than their mothers and grandmothers for the first time in history. And right now, it’s crucial to remember that abortion is still legal in the United States. Though we already know the likely outcome, the final ruling will not come until June. If you need abortion care right now, it’s still your right to receive it. ** Once this decision goes into effect, the right to abortion care will be up to states to decide. It’s estimated that 26 states will likely ban abortion, and more will drastically restrict access to abortion care through new Republican-led legislation. The right to bodily autonomy should never be up for debate. The right to access abortion care should have never been up for debate. Young people across this country have worked tirelessly to elect Democratic leaders who promised to represent us into office, resulting in a Democratic trifecta. Now, they need to use the power of the offices we’ve elected them to and combat the draconian, anti-choice laws pushed forward by Republicans. For decades, Republicans have worked to bring the fight against abortion back to the Supreme Court. Let’s make one thing clear: This draft decision from SCOTUS is the result of a decades-long Republican scheme to ban all abortions without exceptions. Our representatives have sat on the sidelines and watched as abortion rights have been attacked. Now is the time for them to act — Congress must codify Roe v. Wade into law now. And if we need to abolish the filibuster to get this through the Senate, then it’s time for that, too. The fight for reproductive justice is a fight for health care, gender, and racial justice. By failing to protect the right to an abortion, Congress has failed to protect Black and Indigenous people of color, women, trans and gender non-conforming folks, low-income, and young people. It’s time for our representatives to act on their promises. Hold Congress accountable by ensuring they codify Roe v. Wade into law through the WHPA, allowing all of us to make our own decisions for our bodies, and our futures. | "CTA Button" In this fight with you, NextGen America | NextGen America** 268 Bush St. #2919 San Francisco CA 94104-3503 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

We’ll be rallying to demand that Governor McKee and State House leadership pass the Equality in Abortion Coverage Act, which would remove abortion bans from RI’s insurance policy for State workers and Medicaid recipients. Here are the details for tonight’s event: When: May 3rd (tonight) at 8pm Where: Rhode Island State House (mall side) What: Rally with a set of speakers & a projection on the side of the State House Please if you’re able to make it. If you can’t join us tonight in-person, Matt and Cynthia are encouraging folks to chip in to The Womxn Project which has been leading the grassroots fight for reproductive justice in across our state. This is a tough day filled with a lot of emotion. We hope you are taking care of yourself and that we will get to be in community with you tonight. In solidarity, Matt Brown and Cynthia Mendes | | Sent via . To update your email address, change your name or address, or to stop receiving emails from Matt and Cynthia for RI, please .

body:

Friend,
Last night, we learned that the U.S. Supreme Court - thanks to its conservative majority cemented by Donald Trump - has reportedly voted to overturn abortion rights in this country. The protections of _Roe v. Wade_ and _Planned Parenthood v. Casey_ could soon be eviscerated.
What we must do now is clear: Congress must harness the anger being expressed today and take action. There is no question we must pass the Women's Health Protection Act. It has never been more urgent.
**This is perhaps the most important petition I 've asked you to sign. You've taken action before, and I'm counting on you again: [Please sign on to my petition to urge the Senate to pass the Women's Health Protection Act, which would enshrine the right to abortion into federal law.](https://petitions.signforgood.com/blumenthal-roe-petition?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1175-su-nd&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsurveys.signforgood.com%2Fblumenthal-roe-may-prio%3Fcode%3Djtk1175-su-nd)**
As I've said time and again, the abortion bans that have sprouted up across the country - which are now set to be greenlighted by the U.S. Supreme Court - are successful attempts to violate the fundamental human and civil rights of women. Egregiously, conservative justices are abandoning doctrine aligned with the 14th Amendment, which paved the way for landmark civil rights decisions to end segregation and legalize interracial marriage. **Instead, they are signaling that they will once again allow states to pass laws that trample all over civil rights.**
**If the Courts have abandoned our civil rights, then it is up to Congress to act urgently and swiftly. I need your help to compel action.**
Very soon, the health, well-being, and very lives of tens of millions of women will be at risk when the right to an abortion disappears overnight. We have the power to protect their human and civil rights. **[Please, sign on to my petition right now and DEMAND the Senate pass my legislation to protect the right to choose no matter what. The Women's Health Protection Act has already been passed by the Democratic House, so we must act quickly to send this legislation to the president's desk.](https://petitions.signforgood.com/blumenthal-roe-petition?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1175-su-nd&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsurveys.signforgood.com%2Fblumenthal-roe-may-prio%3Fcode%3Djtk1175-su-nd)**
Thank you for stepping up in this critical moment.
Dick

| Today on Teacher Appreciation Day, I want to share with you just how deep my appreciation is for teachers. **If I didn’t have Mr. Osterweil as a teacher, I would either be dead or in prison. Let me tell you a bit more...** After my mom passed away when I was 8, I lived with my father who was suffering from undiagnosed Alzheimer’s disease. With everything going on at home, school became a place where I could be a kid when outside of school I really couldn't. Mr. Osterweil, my fourth through sixth grade public school teacher, made that possible. He made school a safe, supportive, and engaging place. He showed us a world beyond our neighborhood, transforming our classroom into a space for self-expression and, sometimes, a Shakespearean stage. He was so deeply invested in all of the students, and the impact he made in my life during such a difficult period is really why I became a teacher myself. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44885487/343522933/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220503-b2_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220503-b2_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220503&&&&utm_content=b2_fr_full&&&&utm_term=JK_S1_C1&&&&amount=25&refcode2=941f4312-24cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDFmNDMxMi0yNGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E0v7FxAygCA645yiU6xZWJ9wGptWq_5rwhzPIzGP1NE=) **It was because of teachers like Mr. Osterweil who changed the trajectory of my childhood that I went on to become a high school social studies teacher, a principal, and the 10th U.S. Secretary of Education under President Obama.** In these roles, I tried to do for others what my teachers had done for me. Now, I’m running for governor of Maryland with an educator’s perspective guiding my vision to build a brighter, more equitable state. All students deserve to have a teacher like Mr. Osterweil and experience the transformative power of public institutions, and as governor I will fight to support our teachers and public schools with the resources to empower all Marylanders. If you believe it’s time we had a teacher for governor, I hope you’ll consider supporting our campaign with a donation today.

clean_body: With everything going on at home, school became a place where I could be a kid when outside of school I really couldn't. | = | Today on Teacher Appreciation Day, I want to share with you just how deep my appreciation is for teachers. If I didn’t have Mr. Osterweil as a teacher, I would either be dead or in prison. Let me tell you a bit more... After my mom passed away when I was 8, I lived with my father who was suffering from undiagnosed Alzheimer’s disease. With everything going on at home, school became a place where I could be a kid when outside of school I really couldn't. Mr. Osterweil, my fourth through sixth grade public school teacher, made that possible. He made school a safe, supportive, and engaging place. He showed us a world beyond our neighborhood, transforming our classroom into a space for self-expression and, sometimes, a Shakespearean stage. He was so deeply invested in all of the students, and the impact he made in my life during such a difficult period is really why I became a teacher myself. = It was because of teachers like Mr. Osterweil who changed the trajectory of my childhood that I went on to become a high school social studies teacher, a principal, and the 10th U.S. Secretary of Education under President Obama. In these roles, I tried to do for others what my teachers had done for me. Now, I’m running for governor of Maryland with an educator’s perspective guiding my vision to build a brighter, more equitable state. All students deserve to have a teacher like Mr. Osterweil and experience the transformative power of public institutions, and as governor I will fight to support our teachers and public schools with the resources to empower all Marylanders. If you believe it’s time we had a teacher for governor, I hope you’ll consider supporting our campaign with a donation today. | = This Teacher Appreciation Week, I want to thank all of the teachers who are providing constant support to their students. name: Alex Padilla
subject: California will always protect the right to have an abortion
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
We have got to act now and do what we can right away.
#

Hi there,
Like many of you, I was shocked by the news last night that the Supreme Court is poised to overturn Roe v. Wade and make it illegal to have an abortion in large swaths of this country.
I know it’s alarming, and we in the Congress must do everything we can to protect the right to choose — including eliminating the filibuster to pass legislation to that effect. But there are two important things to know right now:
1. This is just a _draft opinion_ , and as of today abortion is not illegal. But it does mean that a right-wing majority on the court is poised to destroy the right to an abortion — a right that has protected the health and safety of millions of American women for nearly 50 years.

2. Regardless of what happens with this opinion, _California will always protect the right to have an abortion._ I support Governor Newsom and the State Assembly’s plan to enshrine the right to an abortion in the state constitution, and my hope is that if the worst comes to pass and the Supreme Court does indeed strike down Roe, California will remain a safe haven for people seeking a safe abortion.

**But the urgency of this moment means we cannot afford to wait for this draft opinion to become law. We have got to act now and do what we can right away. That’s why today, I’m asking you to split a donation between the Planned Parenthood of California, and NARAL Pro-Choice California.**
[**Please split a donation between Planned Parenthood of California and NARAL Pro-Choice California. Every penny will go directly toward fighting to protect the right to choose, not a cent to my campaign.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-may22-ppnaral?refcode=em220503-1-b&t=1&refcode2=779_159979_d8RHod&akid=779%2E159979%2Ed8RHod)
Thank you. I know this fight is only just getting started, and my team and I will be in touch with more soon.
\- Alex Padilla

| We are in a moment of crisis. As I am sure you have likely heard, the Supreme Court is poised to reverse _Roe v. Wade_ and nearly 50 years of precedent along with it. Since the moment _Roe vs. Wade_ was decided, the effort to erode this fundamental right for all people has been unrelenting.

Let me be frank: this decision will endanger the lives of people across the country, and specifically in Arizona, which is considered a high-risk state to ban abortion if _Roe v. Wade_ is overturned. If that happens, then the distance Arizonans would have to travel to access safe reproductive healthcare **would increase by 1,352.9%.**

**It’s simple and terrifying: this decision will cost people their lives.**

If the Supreme Court decides to shamefully deprive people of their right to make decisions about their bodies, Congress must immediately codify the protections of _Roe_ into law. **I will always stand with Arizonans, and in Congress, I'll fight back** against attacks from politicians like David Schweikert, who have worked for years to chip away reproductive rights.

We need to come together and ensure that abortion remains accessible, legal, and safe. Which is why we need to fight to remove candidates like David Schweikert from office that seek to legislate control over people’s rights to healthcare. subject: We can’t go back to 1931

body:
Friend, it’s all the fight. The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice. And in Michigan, that’s a fight going back nearly a century.

In 1931, the state of Michigan passed a deeply unjust law criminalizing abortion in nearly every circumstance -- including for rape and incest.
If the U.S. Supreme Court overturns Roe v. Wade, millions of women here in Michigan lose nearly every right to their own bodies and futures -- and will be subject to a law that dates back nearly a century.

While it is possible the court's opinion will change in some way before it is final, we should not expect the ultimate decision to change. This is the cumulative effect of a 40-year assault on our rights by extremists on the far right. From the Federalist Society and law schools, to circuit courts and the three most recent appointees to the Supreme Court.

What is clear is that these extremists and their hand-picked judges will keep using states' rights as a shield to strip as many federal protections as possible from those who need them most. They will "return" these decisions to the states, where in many cases the deck is already stacked due to partisan gerrymandering, judicial appointments, and voter suppression. One of the arguments in the leaked opinion is that if a right "is not deeply rooted in the Nation’s history and traditions" (direct quote) then it should not be a right.

This apparent decision on Roe is far more ominous for that reason. It eliminates the right to privacy. It will probably also be used to overturn our rights to contraception and even marriage equality, and that's just for starters. It also sets the stage for a future opinion that voting itself is no longer a fundamental right, based on the court's opinion in this case. And while this sounds extreme, remember that this has been a long time coming. Each of these rights could be taken away in the next five to seven years.

In this new judicial climate, state and local elections will matter more than ever. And having fair, accurate elections takes on even more importance.
The preservation of every right we have left -- and clawing back what the extremists are able to take away via five unelected judges -- depends on whether we exercise the right to vote. And of course, if that vote is counted.

Supreme Court Justice Sotomayor has suggested that the Court would not survive the court of public opinion if it overturned Roe v. Wade. That the Court would no longer represent a distinct arm of our democracy and would instead be reading the Constitution as a political act.
Like I said: The fight for democracy is the fight for freedom is the fight for choice. It's -all- the fight.

Thank you for being with me -- and all the causes to protect our rights that you support.

Hi Peter,

I hope you're doing as well as you can be today. Last night, when I saw the leaked documents of a draft that revealed the Supreme Court had voted to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , I was outraged -- like most of you, I'm sure of it. This is a personal issue for my family, and it's one I don't take lightly. This is not hyperbole: My wife, Amber, would not be alive today without unfettered access to the care she needed. My child would have grown up without her mother, and I would be without my partner, wading through this life. My two later children, Brynlee and Braydon wouldn't exist at all. On October 25th, 2012, I had to make a decision for Amber (my wife) and myself. She was 20 weeks pregnant, and she was bleeding out on a hospital bed. Amber was pregnant with our second child, a little girl we would name Addison during our short time with her. Amber had suffered a placental abruption, and she was hemorrhaging blood faster than our dedicated healthcare team could replace it.

The care team informed me of our two options: hope and pray for a miracle while my wife and unborn child bled out, or induce labor, saving Amber and giving us the chance to hold Addison as she faded over the next few hours. Praying for a "miracle" wasn't an option while my wife lay at death's door. The choice was clear, and I told the doctors to administer Pitocin (the recommended drug used to induce early labor) to save my wife. So as I read about the SCOTUS draft to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , I thought of my wife and every other person who has been in an unbearable situation like ours. This experience shaped me and formed my opinion that there can be no restrictions or hurdles placed between a person and their access to medical care. All potential avenues of reproductive care must be accessible and offered to every patient in any situation at all times. Today, I want you to know I am standing in solidarity with you, and throughout this campaign, I will continue to fight for the right to choose. **[Will you join me in supporting The Northwest Abortion Access Fund, a group of trained, compassionate volunteer advocates who run a toll-free hotline that serves callers from Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and Alaska who need support?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/c511-KAjM3jU_4OIFtitbX_bEoMCkC2_rmPsoOP6tChfLCyn0WkRf0RCCtF_iL04euPQ5L1VjLI8cLx-hkugk8_OVndfwv7gdYtl7FIK1hxUtfOOdaOwijmjNTFJ1oj8NtYNSTPDsy1gc2KiNc8ad_XFu57mVRvNL9-fLEfU1O5R-zT5OhnvRFYVo3P4AjjKy_eUyMfTuhU3A8v6TLuQv_KhDHPzL7e1VnVxd6Wyku_3ubl43JEpj8Mo21kSjNaD/3lq/b6s5SYuaSLyuC4Bq5uXE-A/h1/lBaOO4lkCbZPTxdQgS3ZnmVIbiFVXSQOKGB0ev6tk04)** Thank you for reading my family's story today and joining me in this fight to protect a person's individual right to bodily autonomy. In solidarity,

Brent

clean_body: I’d like to share my family’s personal story with you today | | Hi Peter, I hope you're doing as well as you can be today. Last night, when I saw the leaked documents of a draft that revealed the Supreme Court had voted to overturn Roe v. Wade , I was outraged -- like most of you, I'm sure of it. This is a personal issue for my family, and it's one I don't take lightly. This is not hyperbole: My wife, Amber, would not be alive today without unfettered access to the care she needed. My child would have grown up without her mother, and I would be without my partner, wading through this life. My two later children, Brynlee and Braydon wouldn't exist at all. On October 25th, 2012, I had to make a decision for Amber (my wife) and myself. She was 20 weeks pregnant, and she was bleeding out on a hospital bed. Amber was pregnant with our second child, a little girl we would name Addison during our short time with her. Amber had suffered a placental abruption, and she was hemorrhaging blood faster than our dedicated healthcare team could replace it. The care team informed me of our two options: hope and pray for a miracle while my wife and unborn child bled out, or induce labor, saving Amber and giving us the chance to hold Addison as she faded over the next few hours. Praying for a "miracle" wasn't an option while my wife lay at death's door. The choice was clear, and I told the doctors to administer Pitocin (the recommended drug used to induce early labor) to save my wife. So as I read about the SCOTUS draft to overturn Roe v. Wade , I thought of my wife and every other person who has been in an unbearable situation like ours. This experience shaped me and formed my opinion that there can be no restrictions or hurdles placed between a person and their access to medical care. All potential avenues of reproductive care must be accessible and offered to every patient in any situation at all times. Today, I want you to know I am standing in solidarity with you, and throughout this campaign, I will continue to fight for the right to choose. Thank you for reading my family's story today and joining me in this fight to protect a person's individual right to bodily autonomy. Good morning! It is officially the primary election day for this US Senate race and there is still time to help!
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20220503-1034-footer-ak&t=2&akid=1034%2E90090%2Ezz3gQd)
Hi,
It’s officially primary day in Ohio! Our Morganizing team is out and about today, reaching out to voters and turning out the vote.
Last night’s news – that according to draft documents leaked to POLITICO, the Supreme Court is planning to overturn Roe v. Wade – makes today’s primary election even more critical. During this campaign, I’ve heard from people across Ohio who have been terrified that this decision was coming. Last night confirmed our worst fears.
We can’t let an extremist SCOTUS take away abortion access. Our bodies are our own. This is a fight I will never, ever waver on. **And I’m the only candidate in this race who supports expanding SCOTUS to protect our right to choose.**
So I wanted to send one last message before the polls close tonight. We have to leave it all out there and keep pushing for real progressive change in Ohio.
If you’re in Ohio, we need you to get out and vote today. The polls are open until 7:30pm. **[You can find more information on voting here, including how to find your polling place.](https://act.morganharper.org/go/33068?t=3&akid=1034%2E90090%2Ezz3gQd)**
And we still need your help. **There is still time this morning to invest in our organizing and GOTV efforts, and this is our last chance to do so before the polls close tonight.**
**[ If you can afford it, can you chip in $25 or any amount you can right now to help us make sure we have the resources we need to get out the vote on this important day? ](https://act.morganharper.org/go/33069?t=4&akid=1034%2E90090%2Ezz3gQd)**
Onwards,
Morgan Harper

I am the only woman in this Congressional race, a Catholic, and the mother of two teenagers. I understand the responsibilities of motherhood and I know first-hand the difficult reproductive choices women face. These are deeply personal decisions that every woman must be allowed to make for herself.

While the Supreme Court’s private vote to strike down Roe v. Wade and remove women’s right to abortion is not final, we can expect the justices to affirm this decision given the makeup of the court.

**Legislation is the solution.** We need the best, most authentic messengers in Congress to negotiate this uncharted territory. As your next Congresswoman, I will fight tirelessly to protect a woman’s right to control decisions about her own body.

subject: Campaign Update
body:
We are exactly two weeks out from Election Day and our momentum continues to grow. I cannot thank all of the volunteers and donors enough. Your | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jeremyshaffer/campaign-update53?e=32107e7cf1)
---
| |
---
| | Hello friends,

We are exactly two weeks out from Election Day and our momentum continues to grow. I cannot thank all of the volunteers and donors enough. Your overwhelming support is allowing us to take our positive, principled message to every corner of this district!

With the primary fast approaching, I wanted to send a quick update on new endorsements, upcoming events, ways to get involved, and more -- thanks for reading!
---
|
---
_Meeting & greeting voters outside the Pittsburgh Pirates game this past Saturday!_
|
---
| **_🤝 Endorsements ✅_** We are working hard to reach out to groups and individuals throughout the district. From early morning breakfasts, to one-on-one meetings, to phone banking, to fire department fundraisers, to community clean-ups, we are working non-stop to get our campaign’s message out and connect with individuals and groups.

This hard work is paying off with many individuals and groups expressing support! Our campaign has recently earned the endorsement of the Pittsburgh Fraternal Order of Police Lodge #1, the recommendations of Life PAC and Firearm Owners Against Crime, and received an 'AQ' from the National Rifle Association, the highest candidate rating possible.

And today we are proud to announce the endorsement of Aliquippa native and Allegheny County-based businessman Jason Richey!
_"Proud to endorse my friend Jeremy Shaffer for Congress. He brings excellent credentials as an engineer, entrepreneur, and community leader. Principled, honest and committed—Jeremy will be a powerful voice in Washington who'll get things done for the people of Western Pennsylvania." - Jason Richey_
---
|
---
|
---
| _**🎥 First TV Ad! 📺**_ Last week we launched our first TV ad of the Primary Election! It's called "Engineer" — engineering requires solutions, and America desperately needs those right now. If you haven't seen it already, watch below: [https://youtu.be/w0GFFwy0ppE](https://JeremyShaffer.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=168b3aab49521aba8263d07fe&id=2dd069dfd7&e=32107e7cf1)
---
| [ ](https://JeremyShaffer.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=168b3aab49521aba8263d07fe&id=861003fa0f&e=32107e7cf1)
---
|
---
| ✍️ _**Letter to the Editor **_📰 Our friend Vince Mercuri wrote a fantastic letter in support of our campaign that appeared in the Beaver County Times last week! You can read it below:

_I am writing this letter of support regarding the District 17 U.S. Congressional race.

I have known Jeremy & Stacey Shaffer for almost 10 years. And, since I was born and raised in the Beaver County area (Ellwood City), I can attest to the fact that Jeremy and his family reflect the foundational beliefs and virtues that have been the benchmark of our region.

These defining principles of God, family, community and a strong work ethic are embedded in Jeremy’s character. name: Beto for Texas
subject: We won’t back down
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
Every person deserves the freedom to make their own decisions about their body, health care, and future.
#
Last night, a leaked opinion draft written by Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito showed the Supreme Court has voted to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.
While the court's decision is not final, this draft ruling is a worst-case scenario, and if it were to become official as is, a blanket ban on abortions would go into effect in Texas.
Let's be clear: **Every person deserves the freedom to make their own decisions about their body, health care, and future.**
The disappearance of reproductive rights threatens the autonomy, health, and lives of every single person in this country. We must take action to put an end to this chaos and cruelty, so we're reaching out to ask:
**[Please, will you consider splitting a donation between Planned Parenthood Texas Votes and our campaign today to fund our fight to protect reproductive rights no matter what? As Governor, Beto will get to work right away to ensure every woman has the right to make their own health care decisions.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220503-1?refcode=ema20220503-187714&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&refcode2=187714_444211_FmJyCG&akid=187714%2E444211%2EFmJyCG)**
**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220503-1?refcode=ema20220503-187714&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&refcode2=187714_444211_FmJyCG&akid=187714%2E444211%2EFmJyCG)**
**At this defining moment, it’s never been more urgent to elect a governor who will always protect the right to an abortion and reproductive health care.**
Texas already leads the country and much of the developed world in our abysmal maternal mortality rate, and Greg Abbott's radical SB 8, along with the proposed end to _Roe v. Wade_ will only put more women in danger.
**We won't back down when it comes to fighting anti-choice efforts to roll back reproductive health care — the stakes are too high.[Consider splitting a $3 or more donation today between Beto and Planned Parenthood Texas Votes to defend the right of every Texan to make their own decisions about their own bodies.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220503-1?refcode=ema20220503-187714&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&refcode2=187714_444211_FmJyCG&akid=187714%2E444211%2EFmJyCG)**
Thank you,
Beto for Texas

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=231%2E5257348%2Ein6dZh ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek,

There are no words.

A reported draft decision from the Supreme Court outlawing reproductive
freedoms is devastating — for women, for our country, for us all.

And I want to take a moment to make a few things clear: A woman’s right to
choose is not something that a group of conservative justices should
decide. A woman’s right to make her own health care decisions is not up to
conservative lawmakers either. A woman’s decision to have an abortion is
her decision to make, and hers alone. That must not change.

Not now. Not ever.

We can’t go back. We cannot allow a partisan decision by a partisan court
to force us back to the days of back-alley abortions and state-mandated
restrictions on the freedoms of women. It is simply unacceptable.

As we process this news with anger, grief, and sadness, we must also use
it as a moment to strengthen our resolve.

This must be a moment for action. Action in Congress where our leaders
must codify reproductive freedoms into law and pass the Women’s Health
Protection Act. Action in our state houses and legislatures to beat back
each and every attempt by Republicans to ban abortions.

There is so much to be done. And I stand ready to ensure this partisan
decision from a partisan court does not stand.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/may2022_abs_em_abortion_funds?refcode=AU_ABS_FR_FOT_RES_AC_20220503_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&refcode2=231_5257348_in6dZh&akid=231%2E5257348%2Ein6dZh ]If you are with me, I’d encourage you today to support these
organizations working on the frontline for reproductive freedom with a
donation. I’ve included a list of courageous, pro-choice, pro-women,
pro-justice groups below that are doing important work on the ground in
the South where reproductive freedoms are most under attack and across the
country. 100% of your donation will go to these organizations.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/may2022_abs_em_abortion_funds?refcode=AU_ABS_FR_FOT_RES_AC_20220503_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&refcode2=231_5257348_in6dZh&akid=231%2E5257348%2Ein6dZh ]DONATE

* ARC-Southeast — an organization that provides support and resources to
women seeking abortion care in the South
* The Center for Reproductive Rights — a global organization protecting
the right to choose
* The Clinic Access Support Network — which helps connected women with
the reproductive support and resources they need
* Whole Woman’s Health Alliance — a collective that supports opening
health clinics across the country, especially in states with
restrictive laws
* SisterSong: Women of Color Reproductive Justice Collective — a
reproductive justice group helping women of color access equitable
care
* The National Latina Institute for Reproductive Justice — which works
to secure the right to reproductive health and justice

This list is not exhaustive, and there are so many individuals and
organizations helping secure the right to choose and the broader right to
equitable reproductive and health care. I hope you can find a moment to
support them as we continue the fight.

working for reproductive freedom at a time when they need it the most.
Thank you.

| | Last night's revelation of a draft Supreme Court opinion overturning _Roe v. Wade_ is jarring and, if it stands, will be an outrageous attack on women across America. In far too many states, automatic trigger laws will go into effect the moment _Roe v. Wade_ is overturned. In those states, abortion will go from a legal practice to a criminalized act in an instant. **I stand with the millions of women who are about to lose their constitutional right to abortion.** Last night's news was terrifying. It is unacceptable that a Supreme Court stacked by Donald Trump and Mitch McConell could rip up a long-standing constitutional precedent and eviscerate reproductive freedoms. **I was proud to vote in the House for a federal law protecting abortion nationwide.** Now, the Senate must join us in acting before the Supreme Court ruling becomes final. I have always steadfastly stood with women to protect the right to seek and have an abortion. Other long held rights could very well be on the chopping block, as right-wing activists look to the Supreme Court to attack marriage equality, access to birth control, and even interracial marriage. The Senate must join the House and act now. And we must all work, organize, and fight as hard as we can in this upcoming election. Other long held rights could very well be on the chopping block, as right-wing activists look to the Supreme Court to attack marriage equality, access to birth control, and even interracial marriage. The Senate must join the House and act now. And we must all work, organize, and fight as hard as we can in this upcoming election. | | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5q2pdnulv5n7vapk9mkvlbm2dupmbo1oc562sk0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdi6cob4cdh2bs)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zerki625m8v5u8qqav3mn92gftele1p4oc19e738_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdi6cob4cdh2bs) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgm422vgles33jevt283o1dvcn7ti2tvuikjial8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdi6cob4cdh2bs) Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson

Friend,

Just hours ago, The Supreme Court confirmed its decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade._ I’m sure you’ve seen the leaked majority opinion, written by Justice Samuel Alito, that will throw out 50 years of precedent and criminalize the reproductive choices of American citizens.

The opinion is political and it is repugnant. Moreover, the twisted logic of the decision, by throwing out the constitutional right to privacy, threatens other constitutional rights -- from access to contraceptives to gay marriage. The civil liberties that most Americans take for granted are vulnerable to a 6-3 judicial majority unbound by precedent, term limits, or elections.

This is what an “activist court” looks like. Fifty years of settled laws will be overturned by six unelected lawyers – three of whom were nominated by a President who subsequently tried to steal an election when he lost. The Republican Party is not “conservative” any longer. It is a party of right-wing radicalism. It is a disgrace.

This is an “all hands on deck” moment in our democracy. I’m not running to be a Supreme Court Justice, nor am I running for the Senate that confirms Supreme Court nominees. But we need to hold the House in 2022. We need to kick out seditionist GOP incumbents like LaMalfa. We need to send fighters to Washington.

body:
The right to choose is sacred, and I am going to stand up to defend that right against those who seek to take it away.

Friends —
If this draft Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe is true, it’s an enormous step backwards for our country.
Arizonans have the right to make their own choices about abortion and when to start a family.
Today, _Roe v. Wade_ is the law of the land and I’ll do everything I can to protect that right. But I cannot continue that fight if we lose this November.
So, I need to ask for your help:

Wade_ and set reproductive rights back decades.** Reproductive rights should not stop and start at state lines — but that’s exactly what has started happening in Texas and what we could see all across the country. Twenty-six states are likely or certain to ban abortions when _Roe_ is overturned. New Mexico will soon be the closest state to provide abortions for nearly 2 million people in Texas, Arizona, and other surrounding states. This decision will make the inequity in our country worse. And it’s the first step onto a slippery slope that threatens our fundamental and foundational right to privacy. Time is of the essence here. body:
There is not an issue being debated in politics that doesn’t affect veterans and military families.
#
Derek —
There is not a single issue debated in American politics that doesn’t affect veterans and military families. The same can be said for decisions by the United States Supreme Court.
Reproductive rights have long been in the crosshairs of the extreme right — in Congress, local legislatures, and in the courts.
If last night’s draft decision overturning Roe v. Wade is accurate, it would be a terrible step backward for our country — and have a devastating impact on the rights of veterans, active duty troops, and military families.
Veterans fought to protect the Constitution of the United States and we will not stand idly by while a handful of ultra right-wing judges chip away at protections afforded to all Americans.
We did not fight for freedom overseas only to have our own freedoms taken away at home.
So while Congress decides what to do next, it’s up to us to make our voices heard:

subject: BREAKING: The Supreme Court is set to strike down Roe v. Wade
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | |
---
This couldn't be more urgent, friend: **POLITICO is reporting that the Supreme Court will strike down Roe v. Wade, according to an initial draft majority opinion.**
In a world without Roe, Congress is the last line of defense for reproductive freedom. We need to pass legislation that protects abortion access under federal law, and we need to pass it _now_.

The future of reproductive freedom comes down to what we do in this moment. I know this news is scary, but this isn't the time to grow disheartened. This is the time to fight with everything we've got — and it's going to take all of us fighting together, side by side.
**I promise you this: I will be doing everything in my power to protect our most basic right to make _our own_ decisions about _our own_ bodies, but I need you standing with me. I'm counting on 15,000 people to add their voices with mine by midnight tonight, and I'm counting on you to be one of them?**

Wade._ It wasn't hysteria, it was a genuine fear about what his election could mean. Fear of going back to a time that I remember all too clearly -- when women who desperately needed an abortion had to do so in secret and at their own risk.

This is a dark moment for our nation, but we have to remember what we’re capable of. A woman-led movement helped change the makeup of Congress after Trump. Then, let's do everything we can to beat the Republicans in November, and make sure they never get the chance to attack our liberties again.

Marisa Wood

Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [Our Worst Nightmare](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziorJhU42VOSgzUxNLyomA311ripMe0kUgjUQtELT4CR20Q&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may3_final&n=1) Someone raised the question on Twitter: If Biden doesn’t run in 2024, who is most likely to get the Democratic nomination? Ben Smith, the former NY Times Writer and BuzzFeed Editor, replied: “Isn’t Gavin Newsom the obvious answer.” Newsom's delusional White House dreams are no secret. He basically used COVID as a campaign launch, believing if he could out-lockdown, out-mandate, and out-virtue-signal other blue state governors, that was his ticket to national glory. We saw the same playbook yesterday in response to the leaked Supreme Court opinion. Even though it would have literally no impact on California, Newsom wildly vowed to “fight like hell,” outdoing the histrionics of other politicians. For a time, it looked like Kamala Harris had boxed him out of the 2024 sweepstakes. But her absolute collapse on the national stage has opened the door – and Newsom is galloping through it in the most ungainly of fashions. One reason I’m running for Congress is to warn the nation against the disastrous policies Newsom has inflicted on California. Now, it seems that warning may have to be more specific: not to let Newsom inflict himself on America. In good news, several Democrats have [come out in favor](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8Trwmtk_uyVQ0nz6QZoJharPIi3Nt00otnybgSOdsBrS7BEhEYHWXY42rp7ecTVRnKA&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may3_final&n=2) of my proposal to suspend the gas tax. This is only happening after we forced the issue repeatedly. It's further proof: the way you get the Supermajority to act is not by asking nicely. And in other good news, a new poll shows parents plan to vote Republican by a 28-point margin. It seems the policy of causing kids nonstop misery for two years didn’t go over well. [_Help me stop Newsom’s policies – and Newsom himself – from going national_](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may3_final&n=3) [Share this Post on Facebook](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6lpHI-UVcODcFSdMgu5zpAwpEj2Mu0RkMuODG2XRCg4JbxlFxV93cwqci1h56Wk-ug&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may3_final&n=4) Kevin Kiley

body:
#
Friends —
Yesterday, we learned that the Supreme Court intends to strike down _Roe v. Wade._
If this is true, many states with Republican-majority legislatures will move to immediately make abortion completely illegal, including in cases of rape and incest.
This unprecedented leak is a seismic warning to all of us. Democrats in power must take action to suspend the filibuster and pass the Women’s Health Protection Act, legislation that would codify the right to an abortion on the federal level.
We codified _Roe_ here in New York in 2019, and I know we can get it done in Washington. I’ll be joining demonstrations in defense of _Roe_ and I urge you to do the same to put pressure on Congress to act.
And in the immediate, one of the best things we can do right now is to support individuals seeking abortions in states where the procedure will soon be illegal.
Abortion funds help ensure people access abortion care in states where access is limited and in peril.
**[Please, click here to donate to the National Network of Abortion Funds.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-nnaf22/?refcode=em220503-1-15&refcode2=752_59515_2KKWAt&akid=752%2E59515%2E2KKWAt)**
You can also use their **[locator tool](https://act.alessandrabiaggi.com/go/1545?t=1&akid=752%2E59515%2E2KKWAt)** to find local, independent abortion funds to donate to.
It is incredibly important that everyone who is able to contributes to support individuals in Republican-majority states seeking abortions.
**[Click here to make a contribution to the National Network of Abortion Funds.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-nnaf22/?refcode=em220503-1-15&refcode2=752_59515_2KKWAt&akid=752%2E59515%2E2KKWAt)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-nnaf22/?refcode=em220503-1-15&refcode2=752_59515_2KKWAt&akid=752%2E59515%2E2KKWAt)**
Thank you for reading, and I’ll be in touch with more updates soon on the importance of codifying Roe.
– Alessandra

## PRESS STATEMENT
---
| In an unprecedented breach of protocol, an internal draft of a United States Supreme Court legal opinion has been leaked to the public. This leaked document has the potential to threaten the historical separation of powers that is constitutionally provided to the US Supreme Court.

As news of this leak has now been widely spread, any threats or attempts at intimidation of Supreme Court Justices should be quickly and summarily stopped. In one egregious example, Planned Parenthood quickly went to twitter and, in a highly inflammatory manner stated, “Let's be clear: This is a draft opinion. It’s outrageous, it’s unprecedented, but it is not final.”

The U.S. Marshals Service is [responsible](https://bendaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ace2cfdb811af9316dec053d7&id=7933e99ac3&e=58a207e9d5) for the protection of the federal judicial process.**The Department of Justice should unequivocally declare they will investigate and prosecute any attempts by citizens, groups, or elected officials to impact by threats or violence the outcome of any pending decision by the United States Supreme Court.**

As our campaign has previously stated, those of us in the pro-life movement are anxiously and hopefully waiting for the U.S Supreme Court to overturn Roe v. Wade as part of its deliberations in the Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization case. President Trump’s appointment of Justices Gorsuch, Kavanaugh and Coney Barrett could decide this case in a way that will be felt for generations. We continue to pray for this outcome. ###
---
| _Matt Benda was born and raised on the family farm in Alpha, Minnesota and he and his family have deep connections to Minnesota’s agricultural community. For 25 years as an attorney, Benda has worked shoulder-to-shoulder with farmers, families and small business owners to help them succeed. Benda graduated from the University of Minnesota with a degree in Agricultural Business Management, and with honors from Drake University Law School. He has long been involved as an advocate for rural Minnesota and his hometown of Albert Lea._
