name: John Fetterman
subject: Don’t f*ck with Roe v. Wade
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Let me make this as clear as possible.
#
Derek,
I’m still reeling from last night’s news about the Supreme Court voting to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ , and I’m sure you are, too.
So let me make this as clear as possible.
**Don’t f*ck with _Roe v. Wade._ **
That message is not just for SCOTUS, but for my GOP opponents, as well.
Dr. Oz is doubling down on his anti-abortion beliefs. He couldn’t be more wrong.
Here’s what he said this morning:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220503-1?refcode=em20220503-5649&refcode2=5649_434096_kOWVKn&akid=5649%2E434096%2EkOWVKn)
**Derek, we cannot let someone with such dangerous views even get close to the U.S. Senate.**
The right to abortion is sacred, and we *must* move quickly to protect it.
Democrats control the presidency, the House, and the Senate. It's time for us to get rid of the filibuster to pass the Women's Health Protection Act + finally codify _Roe_ into law. **We cannot afford to wait.**
[**Derek, send me to Washington and I’ll be that 51st Democratic vote to codify _Roe_ into law. Make a donation of any amount today to help us win this race, flip this seat, and protect the right to an abortion.**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47503?refcode=em20220503-5649&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5649%2E434096%2EkOWVKn)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220503-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220503-5649&refcode2=5649_434096_kOWVKn&akid=5649%2E434096%2EkOWVKn)**
We won’t go back. We’re going to fight with everything we have.
John

John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
P.S. _Please note that the ruling hasn’t been made public yet, and isn’t final until that happens. Abortion is still legal in the United States._

I have never shied away from letting people know I am a Christian. As a Christian we value life and especially the life of the unborn. Folks, I am a Pro-Life Conservative. Wade decision that has protected the right to abortion in this country for the last 50 years. For decades, Republicans have made their intention clear and now their wish is coming true. For this to happen while Democrats have control of the White House and both chambers of Congress is unacceptable — full stop. If we have any chance of stopping this nationwide roll-back on abortion rights, we must act NOW. That means demanding the current Democratic-controlled Senate abolish the filibuster, expand the Supreme Court and pass legislation to codify Roe v. Wade. We know the truth: Ending access to abortion won’t end abortion. It never has. It will end safe abortion and put thousands of women, non-binary individuals and trans men at risk. People’s lives are literally on the line. We must start organizing to put pressure on SCOTUS by showing up at rallies and events, supporting abortion funds and reproductive justice organizations, and electing unabashed, pro-choice champions to Congress. Please, take action in one of the following ways today to fight back against this grave attack on reproductive freedom: We will not sit in silence as this ultra-right-wing Supreme Court attempts to roll back our fundamental rights. Peter,
As one of the one in four women in this country who have chosen to have an abortion, I am outraged and disgusted by the reported draft SCOTUS opinion overturning _Roe v. Wade_.
**The purpose of our Supreme Court is to uphold freedom and respect precedent — not to take away the fundamental freedom for pregnant people to make choices about their own bodies and futures.**
Right now, the Senate can pass an exception to the filibuster and codify _Roe v. Wade_. NOW is the moment to act, not next month or after the midterms. [**Will you add your name to our grassroots petition calling on the Senate to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act without delay?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/senate-whpa-2022/?source=em20220503-1235&t=1&akid=1235%2E420207%2EAd7gtn)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/senate-whpa-2022/?source=em20220503-1235&t=2&akid=1235%2E420207%2EAd7gtn)**
Let’s not forget that _Roe v. Wade_ was a 7-2 decision. The SCOTUS majority who voted to overturn it has no respect for precedent. No respect for pregnant people. No respect for voting rights. No respect for our democratic institutions.
The decision to have an abortion is an intensely personal choice about control of our own bodies. And the consequences of that choice are ones that only WE will have to live with — SCOTUS and Republican state legislatures have no business restricting our choices about our bodies.
[**The Senate can protect abortion rights right now, but only if it ends the filibuster and passes the Women’s Health Protection Act. We can’t wait any longer. If you agree, add your name to our petition today.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/senate-whpa-2022/?source=em20220503-1235&t=3&akid=1235%2E420207%2EAd7gtn)
I will continue to fight tooth and nail for every single person’s right to have a legal and safe abortion in this country. We will not accept this sitting down, and we WILL take this to the streets and the voting booth.
People are right to be scared by this news, but please remember: this is still a draft opinion, not a ruling. _Roe v. Wade_ is still the law of the land, and abortion is legal here in Washington State. **Take care of yourselves and each other.**
In solidarity,
Pramila

As a doctor, I’ve been in the room for those difficult conversations as families decide whether to keep a pregnancy. My exam room is a safe space for us to talk about what is in the best interest of your health, and your needs. Medical decisions are between a patient and their provider — _**it’s not the government’s place to be involved.**_ Our nation’s highest court is poised to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , effectively ending the right to abortion as we know it. After Justices Alito and Roberts joined the bench in 2007, I wrote a series of articles on Huffington Post explaining the tremendous import of their decisions in Carhart and Parents Involved. It was just a few years after I’d graduated from Stanford Law School, but I’d already had the chance to represent Jason West in a groundbreaking marriage equality case in the State of New York and was working on the senior staff of the American Constitution Society for Law and Policy in Washington, DC. My series with a proposal for Congress to end judicial life tenure in order to force turnover on the bench. In the years since then, has attracted support from figures including Rep. Ro Khanna (D-CA). I’ve tried for years to warn Americans about the issues that millions are coming to recognize only now. Today's attacks on Roe are not the end. Having worked in the courts to establish LGBTQ marriage equality long before Obergef el l v. Hodg es finally put an end to our struggle and enshrined marriage equality as the law of the land, I have no doubt that the right-wing has its sights on Obergefell next. Its attacks on voting rights are already well-established: the Shelby County v. Holder decision (which in 2013 struck down the Voting Rights Act’s enforcement provisions) plays a key role in insulating the political establishment in Washington from electoral accountability. From women’s rights to LGBTQ rights, and from voting rights to other civil rights, all of our rights are threatened today. Thanks for standing with us! Having fought for the future for over 20 years, I’m grateful to see more and more Americans coming to recognize our concerns every day. In solidarity, Shahid PS -- Not in the Bay Area? Even if you can't join us today at the federal building, you can in a range of other ways, from phone banking (to inform either voters about their choices on the ballot, or local volunteers about upcoming events) to writing emails inviting journalists to cover our race, supporting hosts of virtual outreach gatherings, and more! to make sure you receive updates & invitations going forward. | ---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Shahid Buttar for Congress Committee, 1390 Market St., Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94102 | | Sent via . #### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq**
**The Leak **
What could be more devastating than today's Indiana primaries? Answer: The news that the Supreme Court will overturn Roe v. Wade.

In an unprecedented leak of documents, the draft opinion revealed the Court will side with Mississippi this summer in Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization, allowing states to ban a woman's right to choose. It's unbelievable!

It was long speculated that the Court would strike the landmark 1973 decision, but it's still shocking that in 2022, the Court would roll back decades of progress and turn a blind eye to thousands of women who die each year from terminating their own pregnancies at home out of fear.
**What does this mean? **
For now, nothing officially changes. A leaked document does not constitute a final ruling. However, in about two months, we will know for sure if the draft opinion was a sign of what was to come.
**What is a draft opinion? **
A draft opinion typically takes place after oral arguments cease. There's a conference among justices where they talk and take a vote. Then comes the drafting of the opinion. This process can take several weeks to months and justices can change their minds as the draft circulates. In this case, someone got their hands on the draft and gave it to a reporter.
**What happens next? **
While many conservatives may be celebrating this news, women across the country are pulling out their maps to see how far a more liberal-leaning state is from them. But the women suffering the most are the poorest among us who lack choices and resources. Statistically, poor women are subjected to more abuse and other forms of sexual crime and mistreatment than any other group.
**The Truth**
Now, here's the truth. This leaked draft opinion by the Court to strip women of their right to a safe, sound, and legal abortion foreshadows a dangerous attempt by a shrinking party to strip the American people of so much more!

The Indiana Democrats have more reason to fight now than ever before, but they haven't won a statewide race since 2012. A decade is more than enough time for contemplation. It's time we start winning again.

When we're on the same side as more than half the country when it comes to reproductive rights and so many other issues, how can we still lose? It's time we renew our efforts, mobilize on a unified front, put off laziness, and for goodness' sake, shred ourselves of naysayers who continue to jeopardize our potential to lead this great state.

Our friends across the aisle have taken a dangerous path. They have chosen to fight tooth and nail against fundamental freedoms that every American should have. As they look toward Hungary as their new example of what democracy should look like, we must keep our eyes on the Statue of Liberty and be unafraid to point them in that same direction!
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform them that I meant what I said in the beginning of my campaign when I said I would run for the Senate until **_we_** won!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=c5dd0696fa&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=6498f85b9d&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=acfaeb4619&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate

subject: URGENT SENATE UPDATE: We Must Codify Roe NOW
body:
| | | [Click here to open this e-mail in its own browser window](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet//view_newsletter_setup.aspx?link=SenVanHollen%2501158775%2501100583%2b-%2b05-03-2022%2beNewsletter%250115531.33434737.5731757.7517223%2501dpwillis67%2540gmail.com%2501Friend%2501dpwillis67%2540gmail.com%2501Silver%2bSpring%252c%2bMD%2b20906%2501Friend%2501) | [Click here to open a plain text version of this email](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet//view_newsletter_setup.aspx?plain_text=Y&link=SenVanHollen%2501158775%2501100583%2b-%2b05-03-2022%2beNewsletter%250115531.33434737.5731757.7517223%2501dpwillis67%2540gmail.com%2501Friend%2501dpwillis67%2540gmail.com%2501Silver%2bSpring%252c%2bMD%2b20906%2501Friend%2501)
---|---
| | | **May 3, 2022** |
---|---|---|---
| | | Last night, I joined Marylanders and folks across the country in shock as I read the draft Supreme Court opinion in _Dobbs v. Jackson Women 's Health Organization_, which strikes down _Roe v. Wade_ and guts abortion protections in the United States. If this draft decision stands, [the Supreme Court will strip Americans of their reproductive rights and put at risk the lives and health of tens of millions of women](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15531.33434737.5731757.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1521308789475094528&redir_log=559074111293374). This deeply damaging and draconian opinion would overturn almost fifty years of precedent - following the Supreme Court's decision in _Roe v. Wade_ to uphold a woman's constitutional right to choose - and would undermine the will of the American people.

Today, the Supreme Court verified the authenticity of the leaked opinion authored by Associate Justice Samuel Alito on behalf of himself and four other Justices - three of whom were appointed by Donald Trump. Trump's nominees to the Supreme Court claimed to respect precedent. It's now clear that they lied.

Even if this draft decision doesn't reflect the final judgment of the Court, the right to choose will still be under threat. So long as this ultra-conservative majority holds power on the bench, the future of reproductive freedom in our country hangs in the balance. Five Justices could throw nearly fifty years of settled law out the window at any moment and snuff out the rights of people in America to make their own choices about their bodies.

I am determined to fight with everything we've got to protect reproductive rights in our nation. [We must act immediately to codify _Roe v. Wade_](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15531.33434737.5731757.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-statement-on-supreme-court-draft-opinion-overturning-roe-v-wade&redir_log=50849578143897), and we can't let anything stand in our way. Chris Van Hollen

subject: Supreme Court plans to overturn Roe v. Wade. Here's what you can do.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
Dear Friend,

The Supreme Court is preparing to overturn Roe v. Wade. But we refuse to go back to the Dark Ages.

Last night, Politico broke the news on a leaked document that shows the Supreme Court is planning to end our constitutional right to abortion. When this happens, 26 states will move to ban abortion and 36 million women and many others who can become pregnant will lose access to abortion care in their states.

In PA, our abortion rights are hanging on by a thread and the governor's veto. And while abortion is still legal in our state, if Roe is overturned, the Guttmacher Institute notes an 1,169% increase in women in the country whose nearest abortion provider would be in PA. Providers in our state will have to step up our services for those women.

Keystone Progress is part of a coalition, the Pennsylvania Abortion Liberation+ (PAAL+), that mobilizes voters and communities to fight for accessible abortion for everyone, always, and to amplify abortion liberation work in our state. Today, we want to lift up our partners at the Abortion Liberation Fund of PA and others across the state and nation. Please donate and give abortion funds the support that patients and providers need right now.
The greatest impact you can make right now is through supporting your local abortion fund.

Find a fund in your state here: https://abortionfunds.org/funds/ [https://abortionfunds.org/funds/]
Eastern PA: https://abortionfundpa.org/donate [https://abortionfundpa.org/donate]
Western PA: https://www.wpafundforchoice.org/donate [https://www.wpafundforchoice.org/donate]

Abortion is a human right. Abortion is health care. We must take action today!

Thank you for standing with us and with everyone who can become pregnant at this critical moment.

Angela Valvano
Keystone Progress

# I need your help!
**Our primary elections are coming up in 21 days here in Georgia,
and I’m asking for your help! **
Will you forward this email to 5 of your friends and let them know you want them to join you in supporting me for election to Congress?
If you haven't already, please follow us on FaceBook and our other social media platforms.

[](https://alansimsforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5abbc295c801dfce747b6d100&id=a5bd687241&e=bcd0e72a5a)

Look, we’re all concerned with what’s happening to our nation right now. As a fellow conservative and as a 34-year military veteran, “concerned” is putting it mildly!

For one thing, the Biden Administration has forfeited our Energy Independence, and has made us dependent on foreign oil. We’re all paying for these terrible policy decisions at the pump, and higher energy costs are driving the highest inflation rate in more than 40 years.

As former Director of Energy Policy for the Air Force, I know how important sound policy is to ensuring an energy advantage that benefits all Americans. At the Pentagon, I helped America achieve the energy independence we recently knew.

In Congress, it will be one of my top priorities to return America to Energy Independence once again. This is critical to stabilizing our economy, getting inflation under control, and assuring our national security.

Early voting started yesterday, with the last day for primary voting on May 24th. I’m asking you to vote for me during this primary and to send me to Congress. Together, let’s restore Energy Independence to our nation – Let’s make America strong again!

Alan

clean_body: the downfall of Roe v. Wade is imminent. | | , Late last night America was shocked to learn that a leaked draft opinion from the US Supreme Court indicated what we've all been fearing for months: the downfall of Roe v. Wade is imminent. Like so many women I know, I feel like I've had the wind knocked out of me. It's hard to process the historic nature of what is happening - the conservative US Supreme Court is throwing out a law that has stood for 50 years. This is deeply concerning for women and families across America. If and when Roe is overturned, you can be certain it will only be a matter of time before Governor McMaster and the Republican legislature ban all abortions in South Carolina. Defeating McMaster and his anti-woman agenda has truly never been more important. Our June 14th Democratic Primary just became the most important fight for women's rights in South Carolina, and my track record of leading on this issue proves I'm the woman for the job. We need a Governor who is unwavering in her support of access to legal abortions. I have repeatedly stood up against Republicans trying to tell women what we can and cannot do with our bodies. Electing a pro-choice Governor is the only way that we can help protect the right of every woman in this state to make decisions about her own health care. In Solidarity, Mia About Senator Mia McLeod: Senator Mia McLeod is a working mom, small business owner, and seventh-generation South Carolinian from Bennettsville, South Carolina. She is a former State Representative, current State Senator representing District 22, and is running as a Democratic candidate for Governor. | | | Please, disregard if you are a registered lobbyist. subject: Roe v. Wade
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RICHARD PAINTER FOR CONGRESS**
body:
| | |
---
| |

Friend, Ever since Vladimir Putin helped put Donald Trump in the White House, we knew that Roe v. Wade was in danger. With the appointment of three Trump justices to the Court the end of Roe v. Wade was all but a certainty.

In sum, a President who openly boasted of grabbing women by the genitals (that's called rape) was elected and then followed through on his campaign pledge to the extreme right that he would take away a woman's right to choose.

**The time for Congress to act is NOW.** Congress must pass legislation ensuring a woman's right to choose nationwide, codifying the fundamental liberties in Roe v. Wade that American women have relied upon for 49 years.

It's nonsensical for a politician, particularly a male politician, such as one of my Primary opponents, to say he is "personally pro-life", but that he still supports Roe v. Wade. Roe is about to be reversed.

_We need representatives in Congress who understand that this is an issue for women themselves to decide, and who are 100% committed to federal legislation protecting that fundamental right from partisan activists._ Congress also has the constitutional right to expand the Supreme Court and should consider using that right if necessary to protect fundamental liberties that have been enshrined in constitutional law for decades.

If Congress doesn't act now (they should) I will make this a No. 1 priority as soon as I arrive in Washington after the special election in August.

[Can you help me get to Washington and fight for a women’s right to choose? A contribution of $5, $25, $50, $100 or whatever you’re comfortable with will help in our campaign and get our message out to the voters.](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=445239bee5&e=8914b14955)

There’s a lot at stake.

Thank you,

Richard

---
| |
---
| |
# Two Big Endorsements

Friends,

I wanted to let you know about two big endorsements.

My good friend and America-first candidate, Anthony Sabatini, has endorsed our race for Congress. _**Anthony is a fighter and running to defeat the Radical Left in Florida**_. He is supporting me because he needs strong, conservative fighters to join him against the radical Democrats in Washington.
---
|
---
| |
---
"I have known Matthew since middle school.**_We later served together as Soldiers, and now we are taking our fight to Congress._ **Join me in supporting a true America First patriot as he battles alongside me and countless other combat veterans to flip the House in 2022."

\- Anthony Sabatini, Florida State Representative (FL-32)
---
|
---
| I'm also honored to receive the endorsement of NOVA Tea Pary Leader Ron Wilcox. Ron has been at the forefront of our fight for Conservative principles in Northern Virginia for years, and I'm happy to have his support. "Matthew will be a great Congressman because of his real-world experiences that inform his decisions. Matthew is approachable and listens to his constituents. **_He is a combat veteran and dedicated to protecting the U.S. Constitution, the Bill of Rights, and the founding principles of our country. He has a passion for reducing the size and scope of the Federal Government._** I hope you will join me in supporting Matthew as your #1 choice on May 7, 2022. He has the capacity to run the aggressive race that we need to beat Gerry Connolly in November!" Ronald Wilcox has served as Organizer of the Northern Virginia Tea Party since 2009, a statewide leader of the Virginia Tea Party Executive Committee and was elected 2020 National Delegate Virginia At-Large pledged to Donald Trump and is a long-time member of Fairfax GOP.
---
|
---
| | |
# How can you support our campaign?

1\. Show up and vote for our grassroots campaign on May 7. We can't take back the 11th District without your support.

Details for the May 7 Party Canvass (Commonly referred to as a Firehouse Primary), can be found
[**BY CLICKING HERE**](https://chappellforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2bbb67d628f97b4388ee28de&id=7d57cc0e2a&e=9ee2863374)

2\. DONATE - We can't do this without your support. If you can chip in **[$25, $50, $75, or $100](https://chappellforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2bbb67d628f97b4388ee28de&id=b08e10003c&e=9ee2863374)** to our cause.
---
|
Thank you again for all the support we've received to date. I look forward to working with all of you to defeat Gerry Connolly in November!

Onward,

Matthew Chappell

body:
Dear friend,
The Supreme Court is on its way to overturning Roe v. Wade, and the people of Missouri are in danger. Roe has been precedent in the United States for 50 years and has protected women all over the country by ensuring access to safe abortion services.
Now, an extreme and partisan SCOTUS is set to overturn that decision. Let me be clear, this is a war on women, and it will put lives in danger. No decision by the Supreme Court will stop abortion. All this will do is stop SAFE abortion.
Throughout my career, I have proudly worked for TWO pro-choice officials and have always stood in solidarity with the fight for reproductive freedom and justice. From here on out, we all must do everything we can to defend the right to bodily autonomy.
Missouri is one of the 13 “trigger” states that is positioned to immediately ban abortion the moment Roe falls. It has never been more crucial to elect Democrats up and down the ballot. We need to win the power to take back the Supreme Court, as well as win control of every possible local office to protect the right to abortion in Missouri.
The right to make reproductive choices must be between a woman and her doctor. Full stop. Abortion is healthcare, and no government should have the right to interfere in medical decisions. It is a matter of freedom and safety for millions of Americans.
Ann Wagner is proudly anti-choice. Now is the moment to get her OUT of power. If you are able to help say goodbye to anti-choice extremist Wagner, now is the moment when I need you on my side. Please donate to my campaign! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2205-q2-bs-roe?refcode=220503-email]
If you or someone you know is in need of abortion healthcare services please check out this guide [https://www.plancpills.org/guide-how-to-get-abortion-pills#find-pills] .
Solidarity forever,
–Ben
Ben Samuels is a businessperson, an economic policy expert, and a bipartisan problem-solver running for Congress in Missouri’s 2nd Congressional District to bring jobs and opportunities back to the St. Louis area.

subject: Freedom Caucuses Now In 4 States
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Patriots,

**We are excited to share great news with you in the ongoing effort to restore and advance freedom throughout our great nation!**

The State Freedom Caucus Network is **proud to officially announce the launch** of our two newest affiliates: the **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** and the**Nevada Freedom Caucus**! They are our 3rd and 4th states, respectively, after our successful launches in Georgia and Mississippi a few months ago.

For far too long, deep-red states like South Carolina have struggled to enact conservative, liberty-minded policies due to entrenched establishment forces in both parties who care more about empowering well-connected special interests than protecting everyday citizens and hardworking taxpayers.

**Those days are now coming to an end.**

On April 20, former congressman and White House Chief of Staff, Mark Meadows, as well as South Carolina Congressman Ralph Norman, participated in the official unveiling of the South Carolina Freedom Caucus at an event in Columbia.
---
|
---
Members of the South Carolina Freedom Caucus with Congressman Ralph Norman and Mark Meadows.
| Led by State Rep. Adam Morgan, who serves as chairman, and State Rep. R.J. May, who serves as vice-chair, the thirteen-member strong caucus will [prioritize key initiatives](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=3dfc7ee59e&e=64ecec6d03) to eliminate the state income tax, advance school choice, and bolster the Second Amendment in the Palmetto State. Evan Newman will help to advance these efforts, among many others, as our state director.
---
|
---
SFCN President, Andrew Roth (right), with incoming SC State Director, Evan Newman (left).
| In Nevada, the Left’s stranglehold upon the state legislature is loosening as fierce advocates and defenders of freedom stand ready to restrain spending, empower parents, and roll back the heavy hand of government.

On April 25, Congressmen Andy Biggs and Bob Good, two of the most prominent leaders of the House Freedom Caucus, participated in the official unveiling of the Nevada Freedom Caucus at an [event in Las Vegas](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=af66c7d4f9&e=64ecec6d03).
---
|
---
Jim Wheeler, Chairman of the Nevada Freedom Caucus, speaks before his fellow caucus members along with Congressmen Andy Biggs (AZ) and Bob Good (VA).
|
---
---
| Led by State Rep. Jim Wheeler, who serves as chairman, and State Rep. Jill Dickman, who serves as vice-chair, the half-dozen freedom fighters in the Nevada Freedom Caucus already represent one-seventh of the entire state house. Daniel Honchariw will work side-by-side with these courageous legislators as our state director.

The State Freedom Caucus Network will continue to create, cultivate, and develop networks of freedom-loving, liberty-minded state lawmakers all over the nation to equip them with the tools and resources they need to defeat the rising, radical Left and their enablers in the GOP establishment.

Your support for these efforts is vital if we are to succeed in restoring and advancing freedom in our great nation. Every dollar counts and every contribution matters. If you wish to help us in this fight, [you can contribute here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=ab29327f53&e=64ecec6d03).

Please join me in welcoming our new friends from South Carolina and Nevada and stay tuned for more states to launch in the days ahead.

The battle for freedom continues and the work has only just begun!

Keep Fighting,

Andy Roth
President, State Freedom Caucus Network

P.S. Again, your help is absolutely critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation’s state capitols. Please consider a [contribution here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=885f988047&e=64ecec6d03) and join us as together we work to advance the cause of freedom.
---
|
---
|
---

body:
As a former judge and Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, I want to be absolutely clear: abortion is a constitutional right.
#

As a former judge and Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, I want to be absolutely clear: abortion is a constitutional right that cannot be rolled back.
But reporting indicates that a politicized, right-wing majority of the Supreme Court intends to overturn Roe in full.
That is shameful, terrifying and unconstitutional. It is a direct attack on our freedom that demands urgent action.
The Senate’s failure to eliminate the filibuster and codify Roe v. Wade to protect our rights is unacceptable. And we cannot back down. With our rights at stake, we must elect Senators who will expand our majority and protect our rights – and North Carolina is the best opportunity to do that.

| | Dear Peter,

This is serious. I’m sure by now you’ve seen [**the shameful draft Supreme Court opinion that would overturn Roe v. Wade**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44892184/343577845/284309175?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDFmMTBkNC00YWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wCn37LtPhiDk7np-gbug4TbJmrWJYki1Az9Sskc0DIc=&emci=f9e40fbd-48cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b01f10d4-4acb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=30662126). We always feared it could come to this, but I hoped against hope that our collective efforts would be enough to protect women’s rights against right-wing attacks. My team knows I hate using this word, but **we have to fight**.

In Oregon, we’ll continue to protect the right of every woman to make her own reproductive decisions. If I have the privilege of being your next Governor, I will _never_ shy away from defending this essential right.

And we’ll take the steps necessary to ensure that Oregon will be a safe place for people who are living in states where Republicans go ahead with their plans to take away abortion rights. It’s critical that the Senate Democrats end the filibuster and codify Roe v. Wade into law – to make sure that the courts can never again take away reproductive rights.

**But regardless of what happens in Washington D.C., Oregon will always be a safe place for reproductive care, and you can write that down.**

Let’s also commit ourselves **to electing pro-choice Democrats across the country**.

[**In making that commitment, I’m going to be supporting abortion access through the National Network of Abortion Funds, which supports the work of over 80 organizations. I hope you will too. This work is too important to wait until the morning.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44892185/343577846/-1348740862?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDFmMTBkNC00YWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wCn37LtPhiDk7np-gbug4TbJmrWJYki1Az9Sskc0DIc=)

Keep fighting,

**[Now, can I count on you to chip in $5 right now to kick off the general election against Mike DeWine with the strongest start possible?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44892229/343578176/1913516763?refcode=nw_em_220503_2_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZTQxYzU0OS00ZGNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0QErT1KZ9QN9osirq0IOaZH3-m2T74Y7NJnFiWPmDgI=)**

**Ohio. Deserves. Better. **
I refuse to accept the status quo. I refuse to accept rampant corruption. I refuse to accept that folks who work hard still can’t pay their bills. I refuse to accept leaving behind any community in Ohio. And I refuse to be ashamed of our state.

Ohio should be a state that we can all be proud of. A state that people from across the country and around the world want to move to, just like I did. A state where you have a real shot at opportunity.
Let’s get to work,
Nan

Protecting all Americans’ privacy is imperative | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/750b94a9755c/i-am-running-for-congress-8981353?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=85b53fd90b&e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | Folks, I’m sure you’ve seen the news. The draft SCOTUS decision leaked yesterday is incredibly disturbing — we all have loved ones who will be affected if this becomes law.

**Overturning Roe v Wade would be catastrophic for Wisconsin and this nation as a whole.** And I can’t help but think how we could have prevented this.

**For years our elected officials have failed at protecting all of our rights to privacy.** The decision whether to proceed with a pregnancy is deeply personal and belongs solely to the person making it. The government should have an incredibly limited say in that decision.

Fitzgerald has shown us that his work in Congress is entirely self-serving, having no interest in working for and protecting ALL hard-working Wisconsinites.

In fact, if this draft decision stands, the right to access birth control and marry whom you love may very well be next because all of these rights hinge on the right to privacy articulated by Roe.

**Our work to #FireFitz is important — now more than ever — and your support will help me defeat him in November as we work to preserve and protect our rights. **
---
| [Donate](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=1c8658a8af&e=356c0699dd "Donate")
---
| Let me be really clear: If the draft SCOTUS decision does take effect, it will be because Congress refused to do its job and pass a law codifying Roe and the right to privacy as the law of the land.

The right of women to make their own health care decisions has been the law of the land for almost 50 years, and it is well past time for Congress to do its job and pass legislation affirming that people have the right to decide what will happen with their own bodies.

Thank you,

Mike

Friends,

The American experience is what we make of it. When our founding fathers established our great republic, they left behind arguably one of **the most important governing documents ever written - the Constitution of the United States.**

Throughout its preamble, seven articles, and 27 amendments, our Constitution outlines the institutions that our country relies on. **But who do _these_ institutions rely on? They rely on the American people. People like you and me.**

Like any true republic, our nation relies on committed members of our communities to support and defend what it stands for. Its survival depends on people of character putting duty to country and commitment to the defense of freedom above partisan interests.

clean_body: It’s our responsibility | | Friends, The American experience is what we make of it. When our founding fathers established our great republic, they left behind arguably one of the most important governing documents ever written - the Constitution of the United States. Throughout its preamble, seven articles, and 27 amendments, our Constitution outlines the institutions that our country relies on. But who do these institutions rely on? They rely on the American people. People like you and me. Like any true republic, our nation relies on committed members of our communities to support and defend what it stands for. Its survival depends on people of character putting duty to country and commitment to the defense of freedom above partisan interests. Liz was raised on strong, patriotic principles that have helped guide her throughout her time in public service. Please click below to show your support: Thank you for your generosity and support. Friend,

By now you’ve no doubt heard that a leaked draft opinion by Justice Alito which shows that, if issued, the Supreme Court intends to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ in full defiance of the American people. A.G. Holder recently said the Court’s political decisions are putting its legitimacy at risk, and this opinion is just more evidence of that.

If and when this decision is made final, it will mean protections for abortion rights will fall to the states. And it will make our work to end the gerrymandering that protects unearned Republican majorities in state legislatures more urgent than ever. **_[Will you pitch in now to help us keep up the fight for fair maps?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44892338/343578743/-356414180?amount=20&refcode=20220503r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIwMGZkZGM3LTUwY2ItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Jk9nPXgz_EMxkXqSSfknTXTdfN7L5j5UfDskxJnx0OM=)_**

Map manipulation allows Republicans to disregard public opinion – that’s why they fight so hard to gerrymander the maps. Make no mistake: If they succeed, they can use their gerrymandered majorities to further restrict abortion rights, voting rights, and so many other of the issues that matter most. This is exactly the type of anti-democratic behavior the NDRC exists to stop – and it’s why it’s _critical_ to ensure we have the resources to keep up our work.

When elections are fought on fair maps, we’re more likely to get policies that reflect the will of the voters. That means ending gerrymandering and protecting our democracy is critical to protecting and advancing basic human rights that a majority of Americans support, _including_ abortion rights.

**This fight can’t wait, friend. | | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

name: Official AOC Campaign
subject: Roe
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
It’s time to be decisive, lead with confidence, fight for a prosperous future for all and protect the vulnerable.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220503-2997-header&t=1&akid=2997%2E2526796%2EomPerp)
People elected Democrats precisely so we could lead in perilous moments like these.
**It’s high time we codify Roe.**
If we don’t, what message does that send? We can’t sit around, finger point, and hand wring as people’s futures and equality are on the line.
The Supreme Court isn’t just coming for abortion – they’re coming for the right to privacy Roe rests on, which includes gay marriage and civil rights.
It’s time to be decisive, lead with confidence, fight for a prosperous future for all and protect the vulnerable.
Leave it all on the field.
[While we put pressure on Congress to act, if you’re able to, please split a donation between Midwest Access Coalition, Fund Texas Choice, Feminist Women's Health Center, Mississippi Reproductive Freedom Fund, and Michigan Reproductive Freedom for All – local abortion funds working to keep abortion safe and accessible. 100% of your donation will be split between these groups. ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abortion-aoc-email-20220503?refcode=em20220503-2997-P_FND_CHA_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2997_2526796_omPerp&akid=2997%2E2526796%2EomPerp)
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abortion-aoc-email-20220503?refcode=em20220503-2997-P_FND_CHA_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&refcode2=2997_2526796_omPerp&akid=2997%2E2526796%2EomPerp)**
We’re focused on supporting local, on-the-ground abortion funds that help arrange and pay for abortion care for patients who need it. In states where access has been whittled away almost entirely, these funds also help pay for transportation and lodging for patients who have to travel hours, sometimes crossing state lines, just to access health care.
We’re also proud to support Michigan Reproductive Freedom for All – a grassroots campaign to amend the state constitution and enshrine access to abortion.
With resolve,
Team AOC

Today is a dark day, team.

Last night, a draft opinion of a Supreme Court ruling was leaked showing that the conservative majority intends to end nearly 50 years of precedent and overturn _Roe v. Wade_ \-- **paving the way for Republicans to make abortion illegal in the United States.**

[**I won't beat around the bush: Expanding our Senate majority to protect reproductive rights has never been more urgent. So I’m personally asking: Can you take action today by chipping in $5 or more to help us defend and expand our razor-thin Democratic majority?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/7616?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20220503-ChuckSchumer-RoeOverturnFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20220503-ChuckSchumer-RoeOverturnFR-Pros-sl1&akid=4078%2E9716520%2EZM17n4)

This attack on reproductive health care by Republicans will have life-altering effects on _millions_ of people across the country.

It is my intention for the Senate to hold a vote to codify the right to abortion into law, **but we know Republicans will fight tooth and nail to stop that from happening.**
